Title: Business Analytics Manager
Description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Business Analytics Managerto own the analytical agenda for our Germany market– one of our most complex and strategically vital European hubs.

This is a senior Individual Contributor (IC) role with a clear mandate: use data to drive commercial decisions. You will be embedded with the Germany commercial team.

You are not a back-office reporting function. You are the analytical co-pilotfor Category, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Merchant Operations – translating complex data into clear, actionable business recommendations that shape P&L outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Performance

Own the Germany market performance narrative – delivering weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews to the Germany Country Manager.
Define and monitor key performance indicators across GMV, orders, revenue, conversion, fulfillment, customer experience, and contribution margin.
Identify growth opportunities and operational bottlenecks through rigorous data analysis – providing clear, data-backed recommendations.
Lead scenario planning and "what-if" modeling to support annual planning, budget allocation, and strategic investments.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Category teams to optimize assortment, pricing architecture, and promotional calendars.
Collaborate with Marketing to evaluate channel efficiency, customer acquisition costs, and lifetime value.
Work with Supply Chain & Logistics to balance delivery speed, cost, and customer satisfaction.
Advise Merchant Operations on seller segmentation, incentive design, and supply-side retention strategies.
Align with Product & Engineering to prioritize Germany-specific data requirements and instrumentation.

Advanced Analytics & Modeling

Build forecasting models for demand, revenue, and supply – incorporating seasonality, promotions, and macroeconomic indicators.
Design and execute causal inference analyses to measure incrementality of pricing changes, promotions, and marketing investments.
Develop customer segmentation, cohort analysis, and lifetime value models to inform commercial strategy.
Lead strategic deep-dives on high-priority topics – from fulfillment optimization to category expansion and competitive positioning.

Data Infrastructure & Automation

Architect and maintain the Germany market data layer – from automated ETL pipelines to executive dashboards.
Drive automation of recurring reporting, reducing manual effort and enabling focus on high-value strategic work.
Establish self-service data capabilities for local commercial teams.
Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance with GDPR and German data protection regulations.




Qualifications

8 years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Strategy, Data Science, or Management Consulting with a quantitative focus, includingat least 2 years directly focused on the German or DACH eCommerce, retail, or marketplacesector.
Master's Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
Expert-level SQL– ability to write complex, optimized queries across petabyte-scale data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift).
Advanced proficiency in Python – with demonstrated experience in forecasting, causal inference, cohort analysis, segmentation, and automation.
Expert-level BI skills– Looker, Tableau, or Power BI – building decision-making tools that commercial teams actually use daily.
Proven track record of directly influencing P&L outcomes– measurable impact on GMV growth, margin improvement, or cost efficiency through data-driven recommendations.
Strong business communication skills– ability to synthesize complex data into executive-ready narratives, board presentations, and actionable recommendations.
Fluent English and required to lead meetings and present to local stakeholders in German. Based in Berlin, with a hybrid working model.

Title: Staff Data Analyst, Paid Search
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

This specific position sits within our Growth Analytics team, whose objective is to scale marketing investment toward the most incremental and loyal customers. The role is focused on our paid search channel where black-box auction dynamics, branded vs non-branded incrementality, and elasticity modelling define the analytical problem. The successful candidate will also contribute to cross-channel measurement questions as they arise.

Your mission


Develop quantitative analysis and statistical models to evaluate and steer marketing decisions
Propose and defend strategic recommendations to our top marketing leads
Setup and analyse marketing experiments to drive strategic decision making
Explore large datasets, give meaning to data and numbers, identify opportunities and issues, and present findings to stakeholders
Maintain and improve our marketing measurement tools (Attribution, experimentation framework, Customer lifetime value…)
Serve as a liaison between the marketing teams and the data engineering team
Mentor others in the skills needed for this role
Use AI to accelerate end-to-end analysis — from framing the question to delivering the insight — while holding a high bar for methodological rigor and validation


Your toolkit


8+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or data science role
Prior experience analysing paid search and/or SEO performance, using platforms such as Google Ads/Search.
Strong knowledge of SQL and Python for analysis (eg, pandas, scikit-learn, pyspark)
Hands-on experience with causal inference methods (e.g. geo experiments, difference-in-differences, synthetic controls) and/or elasticity modelling applied to marketing spend decisions.
Ability to understand user behavior and meaning behind the numbers and a track record in sharing insights to business stakeholders.
Experience identifying where AI could meaningfully improve your team's analytics workflows or tooling, not just your own output.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Databricks).
Desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction and with highly engaged individuals
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
Monthly transportation and fitness budget
Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
Language reimbursement program
Health and wellness benefits


And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Title: (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) in Berlin
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Corporate Functions - Performance & Reward ein attraktives, motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld gestalten? Unser Team entwickelt Konzepte und Programme rund um die Themen Karriere, Benefits, Recognition oder (leistungsbezogene) Vergütung. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d).

Standorte: Düsseldorf, Berlin, Dresden, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, Leipzig, Magdeburg, Mannheim, München, Nürnberg und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) erwartet dich eine anspruchsvolle Rolle als Data Scientist zur Entwicklung datengestützter Modelle zur Aufbereitung und Interpretation entscheidungsrelevanter Daten.


Konzeption: Du entwickelst geeignete Algorithmen und Modelle zur Aufbereitung entscheidungsrelevanter Daten und erschaffst individuelle Dashboards anhand moderner Business-Intelligence-Tools.
Verifizierung: Um deine aufgestellten Hypothesen zu prüfen, identifizierst du Zusammenhänge und Muster in deinen Daten.
Entwicklung: Gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern entwickelst du Reporting und Analysetools.
Präsentation: Strukturierte Aufbereitung der Inhalte für verschiedene Zielgruppen und Reporting-Anforderungen.
Management: Selbstständig identifizierst und entwickelst du Schritt für Schritt den notwendigen Prozess zur Entwicklung der gesamte Wertschöpfungs- und Engagementkette.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do


Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.


What You'll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.


Nice To Have


Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).


What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services.

Job Description



At Scalable, we use data to make better decisions across our business, including People. As our first dedicated People Analytics hire, you will build the foundations for a data-driven People function.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will bring together People data, create reliable reporting, improve our People Tech stack, and turn data into insights that help leaders make informed decisions.





Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning
Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders to translate business questions into meaningful analyses
Develop clear, actionable recommendations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders
Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth


Qualifications


Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience working with HR systems and integrating data from multiple sources
A sound understanding of data architecture, data quality, data governance, and privacy principles
Ability to explain complex data clearly and turn findings into practical recommendations
Experience with Python or R is a plus, especially for advanced analytics
Fluent English skills. German is a plus
This role requires you to be based in Munich or Berlin and work from one of our office locations


Additional Information


Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers
Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients
Be productive with the latest hardware and tools
Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing or career development sessions and spending your individual Education Budget

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist, you will work in a cross-functional Payments Intelligence team that supports all Payments Business Unit across different domains. This role is part of the Data Science & Analytics (DSA) function, reporting to the DSA Manager for Payments Intelligence. You will play a key role in shaping our payments products by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.

Currently, Payments is a quickly growing business area, which brings its own challenges and opportunities. To be successful and satisfied in this role, you need to be comfortable with a fast pace and continuous change. In return, you get to build something really big together with other driven and caring colleagues.

In this position, you’ll


Partner with your team and stakeholders at Vinted, to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations, as well as answer critical business questions.
Test and analyse developed opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools
Select, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact
Familiarity with SQL and Python
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Fluent in English, both written and spoken


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€69.600—€100.100 EUR

Title: Finance Data & Systems Analyst (FP&A)
Description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are currently looking for a Finance Data & Systems Analyst who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with Finance, FP&A, and Data teams, your focus will be on enabling better decision-making through reliable data, advanced analytics, and digital solutions. In this role, you will combine your understanding of Finance processes with your analytical expertise and ability to drive automation, AI adoption, and continuous improvement across Finance.

What You Will Do

Finance Data & Analytics:


Act as the Finance representative and key business partner for collaboration with the Data team, ensuring Finance requirements are understood and translated into scalable data solutions.
Partner with stakeholders across Finance to identify data needs, improve reporting capabilities, and enable data-driven decision-making.
Develop, maintain, and optimise Finance datasets, reports, and dashboards to provide accurate and actionable insights.
Support data quality, governance, and documentation initiatives to ensure consistency and transparency of Finance data.
As part of the payment processing commercial team, lead the development of KPI dashboards and ensure that insights, drivers and performance trends are communicated to stakeholders regularly.



FP&A Systems / Pigment:


Own the development and maintenance of Pigment models, including understanding and managing infrastructure, data flows, and dimensions.
Manage and prioritize Pigment tickets and improvement requests from the FP&A team, ensuring timely resolution and continuous improvement of the platform.
Support the team in leveraging Pigment capabilities effectively for budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis.
Run regular reporting from Pigment.



Automation & AI:


Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency through data solutions and technology.
Drive the adoption and responsible use of AI within Finance by identifying relevant use cases, supporting implementation, and promoting AI-enabled ways of working.



What You Should Bring

Essential:


Understanding of Finance processes and business performance management.
Experience building and maintaining BI solutions and dashboards.
Experience acting as a bridge between Finance teams and Data/Technology teams.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with data platforms and analytical tools.
Understanding of data flows, data models, and reporting infrastructure.
Experience managing priorities, resolving issues, and supporting users of digital platforms.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Structured, problem-solving mindset with a continuous improvement approach.



Desirable:


Experience of FP&A and hands-on experience with FP&A systems (such as Pigment, Anaplan, Workday, Vena, etc), including model structure, dimensions, and data integrations.
Experience of working with ERP data would be beneficial.
Interest and experience in applying AI and automation to improve business processes.
Payment processing reporting experience.



What We Can Offer You


A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.



Our interview process


CV review
Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
Hiring Manager Interview (MS Teams)
Hiring Team Interview, including tasks (onsite)
Leadership Interview (MS Teams)



Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

We currently have a hybrid work model supporting a blend of in-office and remote work (3 days per week in-office).

If we sparked your interest and you are open to embarking on your professional path with us, please visit our Lovehoney careers page to apply: https://jobs.eu.lever.co/lovehoneygroup

Our privacy policy is available here: https://www.lovehoneygroup.com/privacy-policy/

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Marketing Data Analyst (18-month contract)
Description:
Our Story

Founded in 2009, we're one of the world's leading game studios, and proud of our extremely international team, consisting of more than 50 different nations. We are part of Playtika and the global leader in the category of Hidden Object Games. With June's Journey, we're providing joy for millions of players around the world every day.

How we work

Our aim is to keep doing so for many more years, if not decades. In order to be able to do so, we've defined a distinct way of how we're working at Wooga, so that all relevant aspects intertwine and have a positive impact on the game. No matter if you're part of a game team or support the success of Wooga as part of a central team, all 250+ employees from around the world can make an impact. We're proud of the environment we've built, and believe you'll enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry.

Our drivers: Speed, Focus, Ownership, and Impact, guide our working style at Wooga and help us make a deliberate choice to focus on what is important to us, while working towards a shared goal.

These drivers shape how we work together and what we expect from ourselves and our leaders.

As a Marketing Data Analyst, you will analyze large-scale data across user acquisition touchpoints in order to generate insightful metrics, custom dashboards, and deep-dive analyses to measure marketing performance.

Our marketing teams aim for best-in-class user acquisition strategies, bringing high-quality players to our games while driving innovation around performance marketing and targeted campaigns. We're looking for a passionate, results-oriented talent to join our team, develop new insights to shape data-driven decisions, continuously improve marketing efficiency, and help drive business growth for years to come.

About The Job


Design, build, and maintain automated, interactive dashboards in Tableau to give the Marketing team up-to-date visibility into performance and KPIs.
Dive deep into large-scale marketing data to identify key insights that will inform user acquisition strategies and business growth.
Help define how best to measure and monitor our marketing channels, creatives, budget allocation, and overall campaign performance.
Help to develop an analysis strategy and perform analysis of complex campaigns and A/B tests, both systematically and on a one-off basis.
Provide data-driven recommendations to help Marketing Managers optimize their campaigns across various channels (e.g., Facebook Audience Network, Snapchat, TikTok).
Partner with Data Engineering on data gathering and signal sharing, integrating 3rd-party data providers (e.g., AppsFlyer, Kochava), democratizing data with reporting tools, AI Agents, and innovating workflows.
Communicate actionable results and data-driven findings across the organization clearly and concisely.


About You


You have recent experience in a data analyst role, preferably in digital advertising, performance marketing, or the app industry.
You have experience with (app) Attribution Services (eg: AppsFlyer or Kochava).
Literacy on Agentic Workflows, and other productivity and modern self-service data innovations.
You can use SQL effectively within an enterprise data environment and you have a good understanding of commonly applied statistical techniques. Basic understanding of programming is not required, but is appreciated.
You have strong experience using Tableau (or similar) to build interactive dashboards and visualizations.
You have good problem-solving skills and can look for logical connections between marketing spend, consumer behavior, and data.
You have a deep understanding of the digital advertising market,including communication patterns as they relate to consumer marketing. You are in tune with user acquisition patterns, and you understand mobile app growth.
You know your way around designing, communicating, visualizing, or reporting your results/analysis so they are clear and unambiguous to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Please note: Research has shown that some under-represented groups in the gaming industry (eg: women) tend to apply only if they meet every single requirement. Here at Wooga, the desire to learn and the willingness to solve problems are more important to us than your experience on paper. We encourage you to apply even if you do not think that you tick all the boxes - thinking outside of such boxes and embracing the diversity of mindsets and backgrounds is what we believe makes our teams thrive.

Our Promise


Shape the future! Challenge the status quo and team up with a diverse group of experts (over 50 nationalities!) working on crafting the world's best games.
We offer a generous relocation package and home search support if you are not already located in Berlin. Did we mention that we also cooperate with Kindergartens?
Make use of a significant education budget and extra days off for self-development. Join our meet-ups, talks, brown bag lunches, internal trainings, workshops and many others.
Enjoy the yoga, mindfulness app, sports and transport subsidies. And a Purpose Day to donate your time to a worthy cause!
Did you know that German is the third most commonly taught language worldwide? Learn it too! We offer German language classes for you and your significant other.
With our hybrid work model you will work in the office with your teams twice a week, to encourage in-person collaboration and team bonding The other three days you can choose if you want to work from home or from the office. We also offer 10 days a year to work from abroad.


At Wooga we are committed to providing a friendly, safe and welcoming environment for everyone who works here or with us, regardless of gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, religion (or lack thereof) and game preferences. Be yourself, we like you that way!

Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders
Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity
Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio


What We're Looking For


2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses
Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations
Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying)
A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives
Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner
Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible

Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data

Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset


Nice to Have


Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools alongside Snowflake

Title: Retail Media Campaign Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a Retail Media Campaign Analyst, you form the analytical and operational backbone of our local Retail Media team in Germany. Working closely with our Retail Media Managers, you own the data-driven planning, tracking, optimization, and evaluation of advertising campaigns for FMCG brands, restaurant partners, and advertisers. Operating in a dynamic, high-growth environment, you translate complex performance datasets into actionable insights, maximize campaign revenue, and prove the ROI of our partners with hard facts. Through high-quality performance reporting, you proactively surface upselling opportunities and support the team with compelling insights for both internal reviews and external client meetings. To excel in this role, you bring deep ad-tech understanding, outstanding analytical skills, and a strong collaborative mindset.

Location: Berlin (Hybrid)

Reports to: Manager Retail Media

Key Responsibilities Of The Role


Analytical support, performance monitoring, and continuous data-led optimization of Retail Media and digital advertising campaigns to consistently hit client KPIs
Serving as the primary analytical partner for our Retail Media Managers regarding campaign performance, custom reporting requests, and ad-tech topics
Generating actionable insights from campaign performance and market data to drive long-term partner success
Systematically evaluating performance data to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities that support Commercial Managers in their business reviews
Building, automating, and maintaining performance dashboards, while preparing and occasionally co-delivering performance presentations for key accounts
Conducting closed-loop and attribution analyses
Collaborating closely with central Ad Operations, Data, and Product teams to continuously improve local campaign reporting standards and analytics infrastructure


What You Bring To The Team


Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, Data Science, Marketing, or a related field
Proven expertise in campaign analytics, reporting, and optimization across Retail Media, Search (SEA), Display Advertising, or related digital channels
Deep understanding of ad serving, DSP, SSP, and analytics platforms, as well as Programmatic Advertising and data-driven advertising solutions
Strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience querying and visualizing complex datasets (e.g., using SQL, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI)
Excellent organizational skills to efficiently prioritize and manage requests across multiple stakeholders (Retail Media Managers) and active campaigns
Operational agility, quick comprehension, and adaptability within a fast-paced, high-growth business environment
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, commercial stories for internal teams and clients
Native/fluent German skills and professional fluency in English (written and spoken)


Our Offer

Like a well-balanced recipe: your skills and our offer are a perfect match! Here is what awaits you with us:

💰 A competitive compensation package that recognizes your performance – complemented by an open feedback culture and regular performance reviews.

📝 A permanent employment contract with hybrid working options: three days a week in our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and two days working from home – entirely at your convenience.

🏋️‍♀️ Urban Sports Club membership – for your work-life balance and a fresh mind in your day-to-day routine.

🍽️ Additional perks: a monthly travel allowance of €59 and a €90 monthly Lieferando Pay credit to have delicious food delivered straight to your workplace.

🏠 Company pension scheme with a 20% employer contribution.

🌐 A diverse and inclusive team with colleagues from over 99 nations, as well as the opportunity to become part of our varied communities and ERGs (Employee Resource Groups).

😎 Shared experiences: after-work drinks, regular team events, social engagement initiatives, as well as our summer and/or winter parties.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Lieferando. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else is cooking?

Title: Manager Commercial Analytics (f/m/d)
Description:
Berlin | Full time | As soon as possible

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Specialist to strengthen our Commercial team and build the data foundation that supports informed sales and customer decisions. In this role, you will turn complex sales, market, usage, and customer data into reliable dashboards, reports, and actionable insights using Power BI and Excel. Working closely with Tech, Sales, and Sales Operations teams worldwide, you will ensure that commercial teams have accurate, accessible, and sales-ready data. This is a great opportunity for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with a structured, business-oriented approach to data.




This is a fixed-term contract for two years.




Your tasks




Build and maintain the commercial data foundation by consolidating, integrating, standardizing, and modelling data from multiple sources in close collaboration with the Tech department
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and Excel solutions that transform raw sales, market, customer, and usage data into clear, actionable business intelligence
Translate business requirements into reliable BI solutions, working closely with Commercial, Sales, and Sales Operations to deliver effective dashboards, reports, and data tools
Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity by identifying discrepancies, data gaps, and inconsistencies and implementing scalable solutions to improve data reliability
Act as the in-house data expert for usage data, COUNTER statistics, holdings, denials, and authorship reporting, supporting colleagues with data-related questions and requirements
Support global users and stakeholders by documenting BI solutions, communicating data availability and functionality, and providing training where required. The role does not include responsibility for revenue-related or order reporting.




Your profile




Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Informatics, Library & Information Science, Business Administration with a clear BI focus, or a comparable field, ideally combined with 3+ years of relevant professional experience
Strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI, including data modelling, dashboard development, and BI best practices
Advanced Excel skills, including PowerPivot, data modelling, automation, and working with complex datasets
Proven ability to integrate, consolidate, standardize, and validate data from multiple sources, with strong technical troubleshooting skills
Structured, detail-oriented, and solution-focused, with the ability to translate business requirements from non-technical stakeholders into reliable, scalable BI solutions
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English; German and knowledge of scholarly publishing data standards such as COUNTER are a plus




We offer you




An exciting professional challenge for one of the innovation drivers of the publishing industry
Family-friendly working time models, flexitime, and flexible home office arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, alongside a substantial vacation allowance and additional special leave days
Extensive benefits and allowances for a healthy, balanced life
Development budget and opportunities for training and personal development
Passionate colleagues in diverse, international teams; joint team events and company parties




At De Gruyter Brill, we are dedicated to diversity, equal opportunity, and building an inclusive culture where everyone belongs. We believe in individual potential, so please apply even if you don’t meet every requirement—passion and a willingness to learn matter as much as qualifications. We look forward to hearing from you!

The company built on breakthroughs.   

Join us.  

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.    

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.   

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.   

Come break through with us. 

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

For our EMEA commercial organization headquartered in Berlin, Germany, we are currently looking for a

Sales Operations Analyst, Enterprise and Data Center EMEA (m/f/d)

Purpose Of The Position

The Sales Operations Analyst will support the EMEA Enterprise and Data Center commercial organization by maintaining accurate sales data, preparing standard reports and dashboards, supporting pipeline and forecast processes, administering sales operations tools, and assisting with sales incentive program (SIP) activities. This B-band analyst role is focused on reliable execution, data quality, reporting support, process coordination, and practical analysis that helps sales teams and managers make timely business decisions.

Position Responsibilities


Prepare and maintain recurring sales reports, dashboards, and performance summaries to support visibility into sales results, pipeline health, forecast status, and commercial activity.
Support pipeline and forecast processes by collecting inputs, validating data, highlighting gaps or inconsistencies, and following up on agreed actions with sales teams and managers.
Improve CRM data quality by monitoring Salesforce entries, identifying incomplete or inconsistent information, and supporting users with basic guidance on sales process expectations.
Support sales effectiveness by helping identify process issues, reporting pain points, and opportunities to reduce non-selling administrative effort.
Translate sales data into clear summaries, charts, and presentations that help stakeholders understand trends, risks, opportunities, and required follow-up.
Support administration of the sales incentive program (SIP), including data preparation, performance tracking, report distribution, validation support, issue follow-up, and coordination with Sales, Finance, HR, and SIP program stakeholders.
Assist with sales compensation and incentive-related reporting by supporting credit assignment checks, attainment reporting, exclusions, accrual inputs, and related communications.
Support adoption of sales tools and processes by preparing user guidance, maintaining training materials, assisting with onboarding, and sharing standard work instructions.
Document process steps, maintain sales operations reference materials, and support continuous improvement activities under the guidance of sales operations or commercial leadership.
Partner with Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Customer Operations, HR, and IT colleagues to support consistent reporting, data accuracy, and timely execution of sales operations activities.


Required Education And Experience


Degree in business, economics, analytics, information systems, or a comparable field, or equivalent professional experience.
Early career experience in sales operations, commercial operations, finance, business analytics, customer operations, or a related business support function.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to organize data, create basic analyses, and prepare clear management-ready materials.
Experience with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, or willingness and ability to quickly learn sales operations tools and processes.
Strong attention to detail, comfort working with data, and ability to follow defined processes accurately and consistently.
Ability to communicate clearly in written and spoken English and work effectively with colleagues across countries and functions.


Preferred Skills


Exposure to sales incentive, quota, attainment, commission, or sales compensation reporting processes.
Experience using Salesforce, Power BI, SAP, SharePoint, or similar reporting, workflow, or business systems.
Understanding of B2B sales processes, pipeline management, forecasting, customer segmentation, or commercial planning.
Interest in process improvement, automation, standard work, and practical simplification of recurring business activities.
Additional European language skills may be helpful but are not required.


Key Competencies


Analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on accuracy, consistency, and data quality.
Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and follow through on open items.
Curious and proactive, with a willingness to learn business processes, tools, and commercial data structures.
Collaborative and service-minded, with the ability to support sales teams and cross-functional stakeholders professionally.
Able to work independently on assigned tasks while knowing when to escalate questions, risks, or exceptions.


Travel Requirements

Limited travel may be required for team meetings, training, or regional business reviews.

A job that shapes a life.

Corning offers you the total package.

Your well-being is our top priority. Our Compensation & Benefits package supports your health and well-being, your financial goals, and your career—from day one.


Company-wide bonuses and long-term incentive programs are linked to key business results, ensuring you're rewarded when the company succeeds. When Corning wins, we all win.
Our health and well-being benefits include company-funded retirement plan, paid leave, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family.
Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling valued and recognized motivates us even more. That's why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate achievements and recognize colleagues who deliver exceptional performance.


Corning is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers requests for reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. Individuals with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs may request reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other benefits and privileges of employment. To submit a request for reasonable accommodation related to disability or religion, please contact us at accommodations@corning.com .

Title: Expert Data Analytics (m/f/d)
Description:
Beschreibung

Bei Appsfactory, Deutschlands führender Agentur für Digitale Transformation, haben wir uns zum Ziel gesetzt, maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen für Kund:innen aus verschiedenen Bereichen wie Gesundheit, Medien, öffentlicher Sektor, u.v.m. zu entwickeln - auch im Bereich Artificial Intelligence, beispielsweise Chatbots und Voicebots, Recommendation, Sentiment-Analyse, Content Creation und Aufbau von Knowledge Datenbanken.

Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für Tracking & Analytics hast und sicher im Umgang mit Datenstrukturen sowie SQL bist, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir bieten dir ein inspirierendes Umfeld, in dem du das Thema Data Intelligence in der Appsfactory maßgeblich vorantreiben kannst.

Wir suchen keine:n reine:n Data Scientist:in oder theoretische:n Researcher:in, sondern eine starke, beratungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die Lust hat, ganzheitliche Tracking-Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen von der ersten Technologieentscheidung über das Event-Konzept bis hin zum fertigen Dashboard umzusetzen. Du schließt die Lücke zwischen reiner Entwicklung und strategischer Beratung und stellst sicher, dass unsere Projekte nicht nur technisch funktionieren, sondern echten datengetriebenen Mehrwert liefern.

Deine Aufgaben


Du bist zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für Tracking & Analytics und berätst unsere Kund:innen sowie internen Teams bei der Auswahl der passenden Tracking-Infrastruktur (z. B. Google Analytics vs. Matomo vs. Piano)
Du entscheidest, wie wir Tools optimal aufsetzen, welche Features wir „out of the box“ nutzen können und wo individuelle Analyse-Lösungen (Custom Tracking) notwendig sind
Du entwickelst smarte Tracking-Konzepte, definierst Eventstrukturen sowie Parameter und wählst die passenden KPIs aus
Du begleitest die Entwicklung bei der technischen Umsetzung und stellst als Quality Gate gemeinsam mit der QA eine exzellente Datenqualität sicher
Du pflegst und erweiterst bestehende Tracking-Setups und erstellst automatisierte Queries sowie Data Blends (z. B. in BigQuery / SQL)
Du analysierst quantitative Daten und verwandelst sie in visuell ansprechende Dashboards (z. B. in Looker), die klare Handlungsempfehlungen liefern
Du förderst datengetriebenes Arbeiten innerhalb der Appsfactory und begeisterst Kund:innen sowie interne Teams für das Potenzial valider Daten


Dein Profil


Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium mit einem Schwerpunkt auf quantitativer Datenanalyse (Informatik, Naturwissenschaften, Data Science o. Ä.)
Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Web / App Analytics sowie technisches Tracking-Know-how
Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Tracking-Tools (z. B. Google Analytics, Piano, Matomo) und kannst fundierte Empfehlungen für unterschiedliche Projektbedarfe aussprechen
Du beherrschst SQL für Abfragen in Data Warehouses (z. B. BigQuery) und hast idealerweise Grundkenntnisse in R oder Python
Du hast ein exzellentes Gespür für die grafische Aufbereitung von Daten (z. B. in Looker), kannst komplexe Datenmengen durchdringen und die "Story" hinter den Zahlen verständlich kommunizieren
Du trittst sicher vor Kund:innen auf und hast Freude daran, technisches Wissen in Business-Mehrwert zu übersetzen
Du liebst es, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, arbeitest strukturiert und hast einen hohen Anspruch an die Validität deiner Daten
Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mind. C1 Niveau
Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mind. B2 Niveau


Was wir dir bieten

Das erwartet dich


Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Projekte für viele Global Player
Ein umfassendes Onboarding-Programm mit Einblick in alle Abteilungen
Leistungsstarkes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
Multikulturelle Teams, in denen gegenseitiger Respekt eine Selbstverständlichkeit ist


So arbeitest du


Flexible Arbeitszeiten dank Kernarbeitszeiten von 09:30 bis 15:00 Uhr
Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 3 Teamtagen pro Woche in einem unserer Offices (während der 12-wöchigen Einarbeitung: 4 Tage Präsenz)
Möglichkeit, Teilzeit zu arbeiten (mind. 32h/Woche)
30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub und die Möglichkeit, bis zu 4 Wochen pro Jahr im Ausland zu arbeiten
Moderne Büros mit Community-Bereichen und gut ausgestattete Küchen für Pausen und After-Work-Events


Deine Entwicklung ist uns wichtig


Transparente Kommunikation durch regelmäßige All-Hands Meetings, 1on1s sowie jährliche Feedbackgespräche
Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten im Rahmen unserer Af Academy
Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Entwickler:innen
Ab Senior Level als Mentor:in fungieren und andere Entwickler:innen begleiten, um ihnen eine steile Lernkurve zu ermöglichen
Teilnahme an Konferenzen und (Inhouse-)Workshops


Das sind unsere weiteren Benefits


Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
Exklusive Einkaufsvorteile & Rabatte über unser Mitarbeiterportal (Corporate Benefits)
Regelmäßige Company Events wie Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeiern, Movie Nights und Newbie-Abende
Wir möchten, dass du fit bleibst: leih dir ein Fahrrad deiner Wahl über unser Bike Leasing-Angebot & nutze unseren EGYM Wellpass (nach bestandener Probezeit)


Mehr Informationen rund um die Arbeit bei Appsfactory findest du bei LinkedIn.

Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen!

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Beeinträchtigung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Angabe des möglichen Eintrittstermins

Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg und München.

Dein Impact:

Als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d) berätst du Mandanten bei komplexen M&A-Transaktionen – und kombinierst dabei Finance-Expertise mit Data Analytics, um nachhaltige Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen.


Data Analytics: Mit Hilfe modernster Analytics-Methoden bereitest du große Datenmengen effizient auf, erkennst Muster und prüfst Hypothesen datenbasiert – unterstützt durch unsere etablierten Best Practices.
Datenmuster: Du identifizierst Datenmuster, um aufgestellte Hypothesen zu prüfen, und verknüpfst entscheidungsrelevante Daten und Informationen.
Visualisierung: Interaktive Dashboards konzipierst du mit Business-Intelligence-Tools, sodass komplexe Finanzinformationen für Stakeholder verständlich dargestellt werden.
Stakeholder-Kommunikation: In deinen Projekten generierst du gemeinsam mit Data-Science-Experten wertschaffende Einblicke und kommunizierst datenbasierte Entscheidungsvorlagen an ausgewählte Stakeholder.
Dokumentation & Weiterbildung: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Investor Documents wie Data Books und Due-Diligence-Berichten und entwickelst dein Wissen zu neuen Technologien und Methoden kontinuierlich weiter.


Dein Skillset:


Sehr guter Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Accounting oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang sowie fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Fachwissen
Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A oder Corporate Finance, idealerweise auch Carve-out- oder komplexe Deal-Erfahrungen
Fundiertes Wissen in Accounting, Financial Modeling und Unternehmensbewertung
Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie R, Python, SQL sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Power BI oder Qlik Sense
Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift, Kommunikationsstärke und Präsentationssicherheit


Deine Chance:


Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr
Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents
Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Title: Senior Sales Analyst (d/f/m) 1-year fixed-term contract
Description:
Job Description

In the Kleinanzeagen PRO Business Unit, we are scaling a high-growth SMB powerhouse. To achieve our ambitious growth targets, we are looking for a Senior Sales Analyst who will closely collaborate with PRO Sales leadership to bring our reporting and insight generation to the next level.

This role is designed for an independent decision-enabler who can challenge senior stakeholders while maintaining tight organization over their backlog and execution.

Job requirements

Your Profile


Experience: 4–5+ years of hands-on experience in mid-to-senior sales analytics roles, ideally within a marketplace (e.g., Amazon, eBay, Allegro), SaaS, or E-Commerce environment.
Core technical stack: Advanced SQL skills (code optimization) alongside proven hands-on experience with Salesforce data (must) and Databricks (must). Proficiency with Python, dbt, and CI/CD workflows is a strong plus.
Modern data architecture: Solid understanding of modern data flows (Salesforce -> Databricks -> dbt -> BI/Products) and analytics infrastructure. Ability to partner with Data Engineering and Platform teams to design scalable solutions.
Advanced & predictive analytics: Proven track record with advanced analytical techniques and statistical forecasting methods to convert complex datasets into predictive insights.
Visualization & reporting: Demonstrated experience with data visualization platforms; Tableau and Databricks Dashboards are a major plus.
Modern AI integration: Practical experience with AI tools in analytical workflows. Knowing when to automate versus when to perform deep manual analysis. Using agentic AI as a daily companion, with a proven track record of leveraging AI tooling (especially Claude) to execute both tedious administrative tasks and high-value deliverables efficiently.
Stakeholder management & ownership mindset: Decision-focused with a strong sense of end-to-end ownership, accountability, and backlog prioritization. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders and translating complex data for non-technical audiences.
Languages: Fluency in English is required; German is a strong advantage.


Job responsibilities

Your Role


Drive partner & professional sellers’ self-service analytics: Build a robust, scalable self-service reporting base for our professional sellers, as well as partners and associations.
Automate sales campaign reporting: Restructure campaign management and reporting, driving the shift toward automated, self-service channel data.
Lead data Integration & modeling: Ingest, model, and integrate third-party partner data streams directly into internal systems alongside data engineers, platform teams, and external Salesforce consultants.
Cross-functional collaboration & sales enablement: Act as a sparring partner for sales stakeholders by providing access to critical data, translating business requirements into scalable solutions, and leading cross-functional alignment.
Attribution & performance intelligence: Deliver revenue reconciliation, attribution models, market intelligence, and risk/opportunity recommendations to optimize sales performance.
Advanced analytics & future foundations: Lay the analytics foundations for forward-looking predictions and sales forecasting models to support strategic decision-making.
AI Integration: Integrate AI tools into your analytical workflows and help stakeholders do the same. Automate where it creates leverage; go deep where it matters.


Job benefits

At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive.

✨ Flexibility


Flexible working time (hybrid)
20 days “work from anywhere”
Paid additional parental leave for both parents
Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move)


❤️‍🩹 Wellbeing & Support


Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones
Annual company sports events
Pension and life insurance


📚 Growth & Development


Personal development budget
Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career


🛍️ Perks & Everyday benefits


Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts
An attractive referral program
Transportation allowance
Free shipping on Kleinanzeigen Direktkauf


Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability.

If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway.

Title: Senior Campaign Analyst
Description:
Who we are

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. From the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events, and best-selling console games. Not only are we entertainment obsessives ourselves, but we also own the world's largest streaming guide, which gives us unparalleled data and insights on audience behaviours and content tastes.




From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth.




Who we need

Our Campaign team consists of more than 75+ specialists - and it keeps growing: As our new Senior Campaign Analyst, you are the go-to person for all kinds of data-related requests, reports, and their automation. Your expertise will ensure that our campaigns are fueled by accurate data, actionable insights, and efficient reporting processes.




Learn where your talents can be developed, deliver at your peak, and create value in your work.

Join us and experience a workplace that's the perfect fit for your talent.




What you will be doing

Collaborate with our Business Intelligence department to maintain correct and clearly defined data and KPIs in campaign dashboards.
Stay informed about exceptions made for different clients, reflecting them in reports and analyses.
Accelerate the reporting process for the campaigns team.
Design and provide dashboards, along with data for weekly and monthly reports.
Ensure data sanity in our tools, Thoughtspot/Lightdash, and maintain data quality in external dashboards.
Proactively detect the optimisation potential in our media campaigns.
Conducting benchmarking and forecasting activities.




What we need from you

Proven experience in marketing analytics or a related field, with a deep understanding of business models and digital marketing channels.
Deep understanding of the channels we use (Meta, TikTok, DV360) and their relevant KPIs, including their definition.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex datasets, KPIs, and benchmarks.
Exceptional skills in Excel and Google Spreadsheets, with the ability to quickly set up reports with data from various sources efficiently.
Excellent communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders effectively, and simplify complex scenarios, bringing clarity and focus.
Ability to remain composed and deliver error-free reports and dashboards even in high-pressure, stressful situations with tight deadlines, when faced with obstacles.
A can-do attitude and positive mindset with a proactive approach to overcoming challenges and a passion for driving continuous improvement.
Great conduct in English. German is a plus.
Constant learning, delivering results, and creating value are the core characteristics of everyone at JustWatch, and we are looking for these values in every person we hire.




What we offer you

An open-minded and international team that loves to collaborate to reach our goals.
We prioritise meaningful work over perks, and that true fulfilment comes from intrinsic motivation, personal growth, and making a lasting impact.
We believe in a permission-less environment that lets us focus on delivering value without overcomplicating things.
We trust our skilled professionals to maintain a no-nonsense attitude and create an environment that promotes innovation.
We are committed to helping you achieve your personal and professional goals, and we offer a collaborative and supportive environment to do so.
Truly a hybrid work environment. You are not required to come to the office, but you will want to.




Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality.




If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

A company culture that really works
Audience as a Service
Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog




How to apply

Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.




Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.




If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.




Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

Title: Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen

Die IGES GmbH ist auf gesundheitsökonomische und strategische Forschungs- und Beratungsdienstleistungen für internationale Arzneimittel- und Medizinproduktehersteller spezialisiert. Das Unternehmen ist in Frankreich, Deutschland, Italien, Spanien, Schweden, der Schweiz und Großbritannien vertreten und unterstützt auch bei multinationalen Produkteinführungen. IGES ist Teil der Athagoras Gruppe, die verschiedene Beratungsunternehmen für die Lifescience-Branche vereint.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Value Strategy & RWE suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt an unserem Standort in Berlin einen Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen

Ihre Aufgaben


Konzeption, Durchführung, Auswertung und Interpretation von Analysen auf Basis von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – von der Datenaufbereitung über die Kohortendefinition bis zur Ergebnisaufarbeitung
Interpretation und Einordnung der Analyseergebnisse zur Generierung belastbarer Real World Evidence sowie deren Übersetzung in strategische Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden
Strategische Beratung von Market-Access-, HE&OR- und RWE-Abteilungen führender Pharmaunternehmen und Emerging Biotechs
Fachliche Steuerung und Qualitätssicherung von Analysen in interdisziplinären Projekten sowie Anleitung weniger erfahrener Kolleginnen und Kollegen
Unterstützung bei HTA-relevanten Fragestellungen (z. B. Evidenzanforderungen, PICO-Scoping, Analysestrategien) sowie Transfer der Ergebnisse in Publikationen, Präsentationen und Projektberichte
Durchführung systematischer Literaturrecherchen und strukturierte Auswertung zur Ergänzung der Befunde aus Abrechnungsdaten
Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung interner Daten- und Methodenkompetenz, für Analysen von Gesundheitsdaten des FDZ-Gesundheit
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen, z. B. in wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften, Projektberichten und Ergebnispräsentationen


Ihre Qualifikation


Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Master/Diplom) in Versorgungsforschung, Public Health, Gesundheitsökonomie, Statistik, Epidemiologie oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – im industriellen oder akademischen Umfeld
Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Analyseergebnisse eigenständig zu interpretieren, zu Real World Evidence zu verdichten und adressatengerecht aufzubereiten
Sicherer Umgang mit epidemiologischen und statistischen Methoden, soweit für die anwendungsnahe Auswertung von Abrechnungsdaten erforderlich
Erfahrung in der Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Dokumente, z. B. Studienprotokolle, Studienberichte oder Publikationen
Programmierkenntnisse in R oder Python von Vorteil
Kenntnisse in HTA-/Market-Access-Anforderungen sind willkommen, aber nicht Voraussetzung
Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
Aufgeschlossene und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit Team- und Kundenorientierung
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (wissenschaftliches Niveau)


Unser Angebot


Mitarbeit in abwechslungsreichen Projekten zu hochinnovativen Arzneimitteln an der Schnittstelle von Versorgungsforschung, Real-World-Evidence und strategischer Beratung
Ein interdisziplinäres, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und guten Entwicklungsperspektiven
Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch anspruchsvolle Projektarbeit, viel Raum für eigene Ideen und individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen (z. B. Konferenzen)
Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung großer Abrechnungsdatensätze sowie frühzeitiger Kompetenzaufbau im Hinblick auf das FDZ Gesundheit
Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung nach einer strukturierten Einarbeitung am Standort Berlin, inklusive Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
Unbefristete Festanstellung mit marktgerechter Vergütung, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tagen Urlaub sowie zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester


Kontaktinformation
