Title: Senior Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data.

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll:


Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role (3+ years).
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy [[DELETE IF NOT RELEVANT]]

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€74.000—€100.100 EUR

Title: Senior Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
Description:
We're looking for


you as a Senior Analytics Engineer, to make an important contribution to climate neutrality together with us at thermondo. With your interest in renewable energies and your identification with our values, We do what we say, Better everyday, Stronger together, you will create real added value for us all.


As a certified professional with at least 5 years of experience in the field, you are passionate about transforming data into strategic insights and driving impactful business decisions. At thermondo, a leading clean tech company, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where your unique perspectives are valued.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will be able to lead the development of cutting-edge data solutions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to a sustainable future. If you're ready to make a difference and thrive in a dynamic environment, Thermondo is the place for you to join our innovative journey towards a sustainable future.

If you enjoy this


Connecting and integrating various data sources, including APIs, to ensure data quality and reliability.
Performing exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and actionable insights.
Creating dashboards and visualizations using tools like Looker or Tableau.
Collaborate with business and tech stakeholders to prioritize tasks and deliver analytics solutions that meet business needs.
Monitoring and validating analytics systems for performance and accuracy
Extending existing data pipelines on GCP (BigQuery, Airflow, PubSub).


And recognise yourself here


Bringing at least 5 years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar role within a tech company
Demonstrating advanced skills in Python, SQL, and data modeling.
Possessing strong knowledge of API connections and integrations.
Experienced with data visualization platforms like Looker or Power BI.
First experience with using GCP tools such as BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.
Excellent communication skills, effectively connecting data and business teams by translating business strategies into actionable technical insights, with fluency in English.


What We Have To Offer


Join a team of dynamic, data-driven, and enthusiastic people who excel at their craft and are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow with them.
We offer a challenge with purpose - the better our tech, the more people will live climate-neutral and the better the world will become for future generations
A corporate culture that brings people from all walks of life together - regardless of gender, origin, age, or background.
A modern office in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg with a roof terrace, where dogs are also welcome.
Work flexibly from the mobile office - up to 3 days a week.
Monthly company events such as Lunch & Learn and Drinks & Action.
Further your education! Regular opportunities for training and further education from our own Learning & Development team or external coaches.
A contribution to the company pension scheme.
Your well-being is important to us, which is why we invest in your physical and mental health and offer you 30 days of vacation, a permanent employment contract, and numerous other benefits via Corporate Benefits, as well as a discounted Urban Sports membership and access to nilo.health, a platform for mental health care.
Get around the city in a climate-friendly way with your JobRad.


About Us

Every application is welcome here - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, ideology, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity. We are convinced that everyone is valuable and deserves a fair chance.

Software has always been part of thermondo’s DNA. We have been the first to digitize trade a decade ago. Today, our proprietary software enables 800 thermondinos to scale the heating transition in Germany. But we want more. We want to enable a fully digitized and smooth customer journey ensuring that all processes are coming together: commercial funnel, procurement, product, supply chain, project management, finance, dispatch, HR planning as well as customer-facing offerings for maintenance and home energy management.

Our product & tech teams in Xberg - the heart of Berlin - are a highly diverse and multicultural bunch. They make sure that we can make a difference and scale the energy transition in Germany and work closely together with all departments.

Join our product & tech teams and pave the way for climate-neutral living.

An initial interview with your Talent Acquisition Manager, Svetlana
If we are both on the positive side, you will talk with Dominique, our VP Commercial Product & Data
The next step is to meet with your to-be teammates
Finally, Become a thermondino!

Title: Consultant Data Analytics ERP Migrations (w/m/d)
Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Wirtschaftsprüfung und prüfungsnahe Beratung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Consultant Data Analytics (w/m/d).

 

Das erwartet dich

Beratung – Als Teil unseres Teams berätst und/oder prüfst du national und international agierende Unternehmen verschiedener Branchen und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung.

IT-Lösungen – Du entwickelst mit deinem Team innovative IT-Lösungen zur Analyse von großen Datenmengen. Dies schließt die Konzeption und die Umsetzung von nachhaltigen Business Intelligence und Big Data Lösungen zur Prüfung und Durchführung von ERP-Transformationsprojekten ein.

Projektarbeit – Du arbeitest in vielseitigen Projekten bei führenden Industrieunternehmen, Banken und Versicherungen im internationalen Kontext. Dabei entwickelst du innovative Produkte und kundenspezifische Lösungen im Bereich Analytics, Reporting und Big Data – Du betreust Kunden und hilfst bei der Neukundenakquise.

Technologieerklärung – Du kennst die Welt der Datenanalyse und kannst Kunden verständlich näherbringen, welche Möglichkeiten ihnen moderne Analytics Methoden und -Werkzeuge im SAP-Umfeld eröffnen und wie sie diese in bestehende BI & Analytics Landschaften integrieren.

 

Das bringst du mit

Dein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem, informationstechnischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA in den Bereichen Data & Analytics, Reporting, Planung oder Data Management.
Darüber hinaus bringst du Know-how in Business Intelligence sowie modernen Analysemethoden wie Data Mining, Predictive Analytics oder Machine Learning mit.
Ebenso hast du bereits Erfahrungen im Prüfungs-/Beratungsumfeld gesammelt.
Du kannst sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch einwandfrei kommunizieren und sicher präsentieren, da wir als Team international aufgestellt sind.

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.

Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. 

Gesundheit –  Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft

Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

 

Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Digital Assurance & Transparency (DAT) Teams unterstützt du unsere Kunden – sowohl prüferisch als auch beratend – bei der Bewältigung unternehmerischer Herausforderungen in Zeiten der Digitalisierung und Transformation. Gemeinsam helfen wir dabei, Technologie-, Prozess-, Kontroll- und Projektrisiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu minimieren. Dabei verbinden wir regulatorisches Know-how mit technologischer Expertise und begleiten Unternehmen bei Themen rund um IT- und Prozessprüfungen, interne Kontrollsysteme sowie digitale Transformationsprojekte. So schaffen wir Transparenz, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Lösungen in einer zunehmend digitalen Wirtschaft.

Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

Title: Celonis Process Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir sind Proxius. Ein dynamisches Start-up mit einer großen Leidenschaft für Process Intelligence! Unsere Mission: Komplexe Prozesse transparent machen, Potenziale aufdecken und mit Automatisierung und KI echte Verbesserungen schaffen.




Wir arbeiten vor allem mit großen Kunden aus der Telekommunikations- und Energiewirtschaft, deutschlandweit sowie international. Vielleicht kennt man uns außerhalb der Process-Mining-Bubble noch nicht, unsere Kunden aber ziemlich sicher. Proxius ist Celonis Platinum Partner und gehört damit zu den führenden spezialisierten Beratungen in diesem Bereich.




Für unser Team suchen wir ab sofort Consultants (m/w/d) für Process Intelligence & Celonis, die Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns richtig durchzustarten.




Aufgaben




Bei uns bist du nicht einfach ein technischer Umsetzer. Du willst verstehen, wie Prozesse wirklich funktionieren, wo Potenziale liegen und wie wir sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden heben können.




Dafür arbeitest du mit Daten, entwickelst Analysen und Lösungen und bringst Automatisierung und KI dort ins Spiel, wo sie echten Mehrwert schaffen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst Anforderungen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.




Process Intelligence & Consulting




Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden an Celonis- und Process-Intelligence-Projekten von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Lösung.
Du analysierst Prozesse und Daten, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und wirst mit wachsender Erfahrung zum Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden.
Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Prozesse unserer Kunden und wirst zum Spezialisten für deine Themen und Branchen.




Data, Automation & AI




Du entwickelst Dashboards, Analysen, Automatisierungs-Flows und AI Solutions, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern tatsächlich etwas verändern.
Du entwickelst und optimierst Datenmodelle und Datenanbindungen (ETL) und sorgst dafür, dass aus Rohdaten nutzbares Prozesswissen wird.
Du beschäftigst dich mit der Frage, wie wir Prozesswissen mit Automatisierung und KI verbinden können und entwickelst daraus neue Lösungen.




Proxius weiterentwickeln




Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Standards und Produkte auf der Celonis-Plattform, die wir international einsetzen und vertreiben können.
Du bringst deine Ideen ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir Projekte umsetzen, Lösungen entwickeln und als Unternehmen besser werden.




Profil




Wir suchen einen Charakter!

Natürlich brauchen wir für den Job bestimmte fachliche Skills. Mindestens genauso wichtig ist uns aber, wie du an Dinge herangehst.




Du willst verstehen, warum etwas funktioniert oder eben nicht. Du kannst dich in Daten und Prozesse verbeißen, verlierst dabei aber nicht aus den Augen, welches Problem wir eigentlich lösen wollen. Title: Sales Ops and Strategy Analyst, Global Sales operations (GSO)
Description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) enables customers of all sizes to run their applications on Amazon’s industry-leading cloud computing infrastructure. AWS is growing very rapidly with hundreds of thousands of companies in over 190 countries on the platform.

We're looking for a detailed, motivated, and structured Sales Operations and Strategy Analyst to partner with the DACH sales teams to define, land and execute against our strategic priorities for the business. This role will partner with the EMEA central operations team in the strategic planning process, the annual and monthly rhythm of business and the annual Territory Planning process.

The successful candidate (m/f) will need to collaborate effectively with internal end-users and cross-functional data teams to solve problems, implement new reporting solutions, and deliver successfully against high standards.

This position will be responsible for supporting the rhythm of the business activities such as Monthly Business Reviews, Pipeline Reviews, and other cadenced reporting and metrics. The position will assist Sales Managers in evaluating and forecasting attainment against quotas, utilizing various CRM tools to derive well-vetted analysis, and other ad-hoc requests and analysis as needed. This individual will support the day-to-day execution of the business including commission and quota plans, managing the territory definitions and account movements, and providing reporting and insights to sales leaders.

The successful candidate must be able to roll-up their sleeves and dive deep into unclearly defined spaces and instill proper levels of structure and control. They will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, analytical, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. The individual must have the ability to communicate effectively across multiple technical and non-technical business units, as well as across other geographies.

This role is a Fix Term Contract (FTC) for 12 months and the preferred location for this position is Berlin, the alternative can be Munich.

Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: - Develop key sales support systems/processes required to meet the rapid growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives


Analyze data and trends and make informed recommendations to the sales teams and managers
Manage continuously-evolving forecast models and methodologies, owning the quantitative analysis of the performance of our sales team
Develop relationships and work with sales, partner, sales operations, and other stakeholders to create and refine the tools and processes needed to drive productivity increases.
Assist Sales Managers in all aspects of evaluating their teams’ performance
Ensure accurate and timely sales commission calculations
Identify reporting issues, gaps in processes, and drive timely resolution
Prepare ad hoc analysis & participate on projects as needed


Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. By submitting your resume and application information, you authorize Amazon to transmit and store your information in the Amazon group of companies' world-wide recruitment database, and to circulate that information as necessary for the purpose of evaluating your qualifications for this or other job vacancies.

Key job responsibilities

Revenue Forecasting & Planning – Support the ISV EMEA revenue forecasting process by analysing trends, identifying risks and opportunities, and ensuring forecast accuracy. Partner with ISV sales managers to validate inputs and drive accountability in the forecasting cadence.

Territory & Coverage Optimisation – Assist in the design and analysis of territory plans, account assignments, and coverage models across EMEA ISV segments, ensuring equitable distribution of opportunity and alignment with strategic priorities.

Operational Process Improvement – Identify and implement process improvements that increase ISV sales team productivity and operational efficiency. Streamline reporting workflows, automate recurring analyses, and champion best practices across the ISV EMEA sales organisation.

Strategic Project Support – Contribute to cross-functional strategic projects that drive business growth across ISV EMEA, including supporting go-to-market plans for new ISV segments or verticals, providing analytical input during account planning cycles to identify whitespace opportunities, building business cases for strategic partnerships, analysing the effectiveness of sales incentive programmes, and supporting organisational design initiatives such as the integration of new geographies or ISV segments into existing structures.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
Experience developing and implementing systems/tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, Salesforce automation, etc.
Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent


Preferred Qualifications


Experience using Salesforce (or other CRM tool) or BI tools
Experience presenting to senior leadership
nice to have - AI tooling skills

Du überwachst die Entwicklung der vertraglich vereinbarten Leistungskennzahlen für den Betrieb autonomer Fahrzeuge
Du identifizierst anhand der Kennzahlen operative Schwachstellen, wiederkehrende Störungen und Performanceverluste und erkennst frühzeitig kritische Entwicklungen

Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Verkehrswesen, Data Analytics oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Berufserfahrung im Performance- / Vertrags- / Qualitätsreporting oder im Controlling, idealerweise im Mobilitäts-, Verkehrs- oder Technologiebereich
Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und ein sicherer Umgang mit Kennzahlen, Daten und Performance-Auswertungen
Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Pflege von regelmäßigen Reports, Dashboards und datenbasierten Auswertungen
Fähigkeit, Kennzahlen und operative Sachverhalte strukturiert zu analysieren und wirtschaftlich sowie vertraglich einzuordnen

Title: Business Analytics Manager
Description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Business Analytics Managerto own the analytical agenda for our Germany market– one of our most complex and strategically vital European hubs.

This is a senior Individual Contributor (IC) role with a clear mandate: use data to drive commercial decisions. You will be embedded with the Germany commercial team.

You are not a back-office reporting function. You are the analytical co-pilotfor Category, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Merchant Operations – translating complex data into clear, actionable business recommendations that shape P&L outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Performance

Own the Germany market performance narrative – delivering weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews to the Germany Country Manager.
Define and monitor key performance indicators across GMV, orders, revenue, conversion, fulfillment, customer experience, and contribution margin.
Identify growth opportunities and operational bottlenecks through rigorous data analysis – providing clear, data-backed recommendations.
Lead scenario planning and "what-if" modeling to support annual planning, budget allocation, and strategic investments.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Category teams to optimize assortment, pricing architecture, and promotional calendars.
Collaborate with Marketing to evaluate channel efficiency, customer acquisition costs, and lifetime value.
Work with Supply Chain & Logistics to balance delivery speed, cost, and customer satisfaction.
Advise Merchant Operations on seller segmentation, incentive design, and supply-side retention strategies.
Align with Product & Engineering to prioritize Germany-specific data requirements and instrumentation.

Advanced Analytics & Modeling

Build forecasting models for demand, revenue, and supply – incorporating seasonality, promotions, and macroeconomic indicators.
Design and execute causal inference analyses to measure incrementality of pricing changes, promotions, and marketing investments.
Develop customer segmentation, cohort analysis, and lifetime value models to inform commercial strategy.
Lead strategic deep-dives on high-priority topics – from fulfillment optimization to category expansion and competitive positioning.

Data Infrastructure & Automation

Architect and maintain the Germany market data layer – from automated ETL pipelines to executive dashboards.
Drive automation of recurring reporting, reducing manual effort and enabling focus on high-value strategic work.
Establish self-service data capabilities for local commercial teams.
Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance with GDPR and German data protection regulations.




Qualifications

8 years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Strategy, Data Science, or Management Consulting with a quantitative focus, includingat least 2 years directly focused on the German or DACH eCommerce, retail, or marketplacesector.
Master's Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
Expert-level SQL– ability to write complex, optimized queries across petabyte-scale data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift).
Advanced proficiency in Python – with demonstrated experience in forecasting, causal inference, cohort analysis, segmentation, and automation.
Expert-level BI skills– Looker, Tableau, or Power BI – building decision-making tools that commercial teams actually use daily.
Proven track record of directly influencing P&L outcomes– measurable impact on GMV growth, margin improvement, or cost efficiency through data-driven recommendations.
Strong business communication skills– ability to synthesize complex data into executive-ready narratives, board presentations, and actionable recommendations.
Fluent English and required to lead meetings and present to local stakeholders in German. Based in Berlin, with a hybrid working model.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do


Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.


What You'll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.


Nice To Have


Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).


What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you up for the challenge?

Job Description

Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning

Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth


Qualifications


Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience working with HR systems and integrating data from multiple sources
A sound understanding of data architecture, data quality, data governance, and privacy principles
Ability to explain complex data clearly and turn findings into practical recommendations
Experience with Python or R is a plus, especially for advanced analytics
Fluent English skills. German is a plus
This role requires you to be based in Munich or Berlin and work from one of our office locations


Additional Information


Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers
Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients
Be productive with the latest hardware and tools
Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing or career development sessions and spending your individual Education Budget

Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark
Description:
WhyBrilliant is sourcing applicants for this role on behalf of a leading Berlin-based productivity software scale-up.

The company's identity may stay confidential until first contact.

Atlas, our AI Recruiter, is running this search and will pick the best candidates from Nova's network. The next step is to speak to Nova.

The Role

Job Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark

Location: Berlin, Germany

Why this role matters

Our email client is scaling fast, and we need to move from tracking data to aggressively predicting and validating what drives growth. Without this role, our product and marketing teams cannot rapidly iterate, run quasi-experiments, or build the deep causal inference models needed to unlock our next stage of subscription revenue. You will be the critical engine that turns raw user touchpoints into strategic, high-impact product decisions.

What You'll Do

You will own the entire growth loop analytics for our email client, ensuring every stage from first ad impression to long-term subscription renewal is fully measurable.


Design robust event tracking structures and instrumentation to ensure flawless measurement across the entire user journey.
Build and maintain growth dashboards in Tableau or Looker that make acquisition and retention performance crystal clear for cross-functional teams.
Uncover growth opportunities by digging deep into funnels, user cohorts, and subscription metrics like churn and LTV.
Design and execute A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and causal inference models to validate marketing and product hypotheses.
Deploy advanced forecasting models using Python or R to predict long-term subscription dynamics and trend lines.


What success looks like

Month 1: You will deeply integrate with the product and marketing teams, audit our current data pipelines in BigQuery and tracking setups in Amplitude and AppsFlyer, and identify immediate tracking improvements.

Month 2-3: You will take full ownership of our growth dashboards, design and launch your first batch of A/B tests and quasi-experiments, and establish a standardized methodology for measuring marketing attribution.

By end of Q1: You will have built a reliable, end-to-end subscription analytics framework that clearly connects first-click marketing attribution to long-term cohort retention, enabling swift, data-backed product decisions.

Who This Is a Fit For


Have 5+ years of analytics experience in B2C mobile apps or subscription SaaS.
Expert-level SQL wizard with hands-on experience in cloud data warehouses like BigQuery.
Fluent in visualization and product analytics tools like Tableau, Looker, and Amplitude.
Experienced with mobile marketing attribution mechanics using platforms like AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Proficient in Python or R for time-series forecasting and causal inference.
Thrive on high autonomy, taking full personal responsibility for product outcomes.


What it's like to work here

The company's culture is rooted in deep customer-centricity and continuous professional growth, with a massive emphasis on individual autonomy and ownership. Team members are expected to drive their own initiatives and take full responsibility for product outcomes. Decision-making is highly collaborative yet swift, heavily guided by data analysis, rapid iteration, and continuous experimentation to validate product hypotheses. This role sits at the intersection of product and marketing, demanding a proactive builder who thrives on fast feedback loops and constant adaptation.

The offer


Work in our Berlin office within a culture that prioritizes your professional growth.
Massive autonomy to drive your own initiatives and experiments.
A highly collaborative environment that values data-backed, swift decision-making.


This probably isn't for you if


You prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned rather than proactively finding growth opportunities.
You struggle to make decisions without absolute certainty or dislike rapid, constant iteration.
You want a pure modeling role without getting your hands dirty with event-tracking design.


Who are Atlas & Nova?

I'll go first. I'm Nova, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call — what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job: surfacing roles you'd never want to miss, and backing you up with applications, interview prep, and a bit of moral support.

And I'm Atlas, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand exactly who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Nova's network and make an introduction the moment I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Nova is an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. She works for you.

Atlas is the AI recruiter working for the company. He recruits from Nova's network.

If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Nova will keep sending you strong alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. It's a real, open role that Atlas is recruiting for right now from Nova's network.

Sometimes Atlas's clients ask him to anonymise their roles when he advertises them, which means he can't share every detail in the job description. We know that can make a post look a little vague — but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Nova a try. You could land this role. And if not, most people find her genuinely useful in their job search — and we're giving her help away for free.

Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are currently looking for a Finance Data & Systems Analyst who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with Finance, FP&A, and Data teams, your focus will be on enabling better decision-making through reliable data, advanced analytics, and digital solutions. What You Will Do

Act as the Finance representative and key business partner for collaboration with the Data team, ensuring Finance requirements are understood and translated into scalable data solutions.
Partner with stakeholders across Finance to identify data needs, improve reporting capabilities, and enable data-driven decision-making.
Develop, maintain, and optimise Finance datasets, reports, and dashboards to provide accurate and actionable insights.
Support data quality, governance, and documentation initiatives to ensure consistency and transparency of Finance data.
As part of the payment processing commercial team, lead the development of KPI dashboards and ensure that insights, drivers and performance trends are communicated to stakeholders regularly.



FP&A Systems / Pigment:


Own the development and maintenance of Pigment models, including understanding and managing infrastructure, data flows, and dimensions.
Manage and prioritize Pigment tickets and improvement requests from the FP&A team, ensuring timely resolution and continuous improvement of the platform.
Support the team in leveraging Pigment capabilities effectively for budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis.
Run regular reporting from Pigment.



Automation & AI:


Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency through data solutions and technology.
Drive the adoption and responsible use of AI within Finance by identifying relevant use cases, supporting implementation, and promoting AI-enabled ways of working.



What You Should Bring

Essential:


Understanding of Finance processes and business performance management.
Experience building and maintaining BI solutions and dashboards.
Experience acting as a bridge between Finance teams and Data/Technology teams.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with data platforms and analytical tools.
Understanding of data flows, data models, and reporting infrastructure.
Experience managing priorities, resolving issues, and supporting users of digital platforms.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Structured, problem-solving mindset with a continuous improvement approach.



Desirable:


Experience of FP&A and hands-on experience with FP&A systems (such as Pigment, Anaplan, Workday, Vena, etc), including model structure, dimensions, and data integrations.
Experience of working with ERP data would be beneficial.
Interest and experience in applying AI and automation to improve business processes.
Payment processing reporting experience.

A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.



Our interview process


CV review
Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
Hiring Manager Interview (MS Teams)
Hiring Team Interview, including tasks (onsite)
Leadership Interview (MS Teams)



Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset

Title: Senior Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data.

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll:


Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role (3+ years).
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy [[DELETE IF NOT RELEVANT]]

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€74.000—€100.100 EUR

Title: Senior Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
Description:
We're looking for


you as a Senior Analytics Engineer, to make an important contribution to climate neutrality together with us at thermondo. With your interest in renewable energies and your identification with our values, We do what we say, Better everyday, Stronger together, you will create real added value for us all.


As a certified professional with at least 5 years of experience in the field, you are passionate about transforming data into strategic insights and driving impactful business decisions. At thermondo, a leading clean tech company, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where your unique perspectives are valued.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will be able to lead the development of cutting-edge data solutions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to a sustainable future. If you're ready to make a difference and thrive in a dynamic environment, Thermondo is the place for you to join our innovative journey towards a sustainable future.

If you enjoy this


Connecting and integrating various data sources, including APIs, to ensure data quality and reliability.
Performing exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and actionable insights.
Creating dashboards and visualizations using tools like Looker or Tableau.
Collaborate with business and tech stakeholders to prioritize tasks and deliver analytics solutions that meet business needs.
Monitoring and validating analytics systems for performance and accuracy
Extending existing data pipelines on GCP (BigQuery, Airflow, PubSub).


And recognise yourself here


Bringing at least 5 years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar role within a tech company
Demonstrating advanced skills in Python, SQL, and data modeling.
Possessing strong knowledge of API connections and integrations.
Experienced with data visualization platforms like Looker or Power BI.
First experience with using GCP tools such as BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.
Excellent communication skills, effectively connecting data and business teams by translating business strategies into actionable technical insights, with fluency in English.


What We Have To Offer


Join a team of dynamic, data-driven, and enthusiastic people who excel at their craft and are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow with them.
We offer a challenge with purpose - the better our tech, the more people will live climate-neutral and the better the world will become for future generations
A corporate culture that brings people from all walks of life together - regardless of gender, origin, age, or background.
A modern office in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg with a roof terrace, where dogs are also welcome.
Work flexibly from the mobile office - up to 3 days a week.
Monthly company events such as Lunch & Learn and Drinks & Action.
Further your education! Regular opportunities for training and further education from our own Learning & Development team or external coaches.
A contribution to the company pension scheme.
Your well-being is important to us, which is why we invest in your physical and mental health and offer you 30 days of vacation, a permanent employment contract, and numerous other benefits via Corporate Benefits, as well as a discounted Urban Sports membership and access to nilo.health, a platform for mental health care.
Get around the city in a climate-friendly way with your JobRad.


About Us

Every application is welcome here - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, ideology, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity. We are convinced that everyone is valuable and deserves a fair chance.

Software has always been part of thermondo’s DNA. We have been the first to digitize trade a decade ago. Today, our proprietary software enables 800 thermondinos to scale the heating transition in Germany. But we want more. We want to enable a fully digitized and smooth customer journey ensuring that all processes are coming together: commercial funnel, procurement, product, supply chain, project management, finance, dispatch, HR planning as well as customer-facing offerings for maintenance and home energy management.

Our product & tech teams in Xberg - the heart of Berlin - are a highly diverse and multicultural bunch. They make sure that we can make a difference and scale the energy transition in Germany and work closely together with all departments.

Title: Retail Pricing Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
BESTSECRET ist die führende europäische Online-Plattform für Premium- und Luxusmarken im Off-Price-Segment. Die Gruppe bietet ihren Mitgliedern in 28 Ländern Europas ein hochwertiges Sortiment an exklusiven Modemarken zusammen mit einem Premium-Einkaufserlebnis. Gleichzeitig ermöglicht BESTSECRET seinen Markenpartnern, Überbestände im großen Umfang abzubauen – mit minimaler Sichtbarkeit und maximalem Schutz des Markenwerts. Das einzigartige Geschäftsmodell basiert auf einem geschlossenen Charakter, mit einer exklusiven Mitgliedschaft auf Einladung, langjährigen Beziehungen zu Markenpartnern und Kunden, sowie einer technologieorientierten Denkweise. BESTSECRET kann auf eine langjährige Erfolgsbilanz profitablen Wachstums zurückblicken und erwirtschaftete im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von 1,5 Milliarden Euro und beschäftigt ca. 2.200 Mitarbeitende aus über 90 Nationen. Die Gruppe blickt auf eine 100-jährige Tradition in der Textil- und Modeindustrie zurück und befindet sich heute im Besitz von Permira Funds und den Gründerfamilien Schustermann und Borenstein.

Kurz zusammengefasst

In dieser Position verantwortest du die Entwicklung, Steuerung und Optimierung der Preisstrategie für den stationären Einzelhandel. Du analysierst Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Bestandsdaten, leitest datenbasierte Preisentscheidungen ab und arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Einkauf, Retail Operations, Supply und Analytics zusammen. Gesucht wird eine analytisch starke Persönlichkeit mit Erfahrung im Pricing oder Revenue Management, die komplexe Daten in wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Maßnahmen übersetzen kann.

Deine Aufgaben


Steuerung und Koordination der wöchentlichen kurz- und mittelfristigen Preisaktivitäten für Filialen in enger Abstimmung mit der aktuellen Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Bestandssituation
Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung länder-, kategorie- und filialspezifischer Preisstrategien unter Berücksichtigung lokaler Marktgegebenheiten und der Besonderheiten des stationären Handels
Sicherstellung eines effizienten, skalierbaren und sicheren End-to-End-Preisprozesses mit mehreren Zehntausend Preisänderungen pro Woche über das gesamte Filialnetz
Überwachung und Analyse der Preisgestaltung von Wettbewerbern im stationären Handel sowie Ableitung konkreter Preismaßnahmen zur Balance von Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und Profitabilität
Analyse und Interpretation von Preiselastizitäten und Nachfrageverhalten im Einzelhandel sowie proaktive Nutzung der gewonnenen Erkenntnisse zur Steuerung von Preisentscheidungen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams Einkauf, Retail Operations, Supply und Analytics, um sicherzustellen, dass Preisentscheidungen verstanden und erfolgreich in den Filialen umgesetzt werden


Dein Profil


Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Pricing, Revenue Management oder einer vergleichbaren analytischen Funktion im B2C-Modeeinzelhandel oder E-Commerce; praktische Erfahrung im stationären Einzelhandel ist ein großer Vorteil
Ausgeprägte analytische und quantitative Fähigkeiten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Preisanalyse, Forecasting, Szenariosimulation und Optimierung
Nachweisliche Erfahrung im Umgang mit großen, komplexen Datensätzen sowie in der Ableitung umsetzbarer Geschäftsempfehlungen (z. B. mit Power BI oder SQL)
Fundiertes Verständnis relevanter kommerzieller KPIs sowie der Zielkonflikte zwischen Marge, Abverkaufsquote, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und Bestandsrisiken
Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Proaktivität mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten, Prioritäten effektiv zu setzen und Themen in einer komplexen Organisation erfolgreich voranzutreiben
Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Kompetenzen sowie die Fähigkeit, analytische Erkenntnisse verständlich an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen – einschließlich des Senior Managements – zu vermitteln
Verhandlungssicheres Business-Englisch in Wort und Schrift; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, insbesondere im Einzelhandelsumfeld



Bei BESTSECRET ist Vielfalt nicht nur ein Trend – es ist unsere Philosophie. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem die einzigartigen Talente und Hintergründe aller gefeiert werden. Bewerberinnen und Bewerber aus allen Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven sind herzlich eingeladen, sich unserer Mission für eine lebendigere und inklusivere Zukunft anzuschließen.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

This is an exciting opportunity to join our Data & Digital team as a Data Analyst, helping organisations turn data into meaningful insights that drive operational and strategic decision-making. You'll work with a range of stakeholders to understand business challenges, analyse complex data and deliver clear, actionable reporting that supports better outcomes across government, defence and highly regulated environments.

Whether your experience has been gained through business intelligence, reporting, analytics or data-focused delivery roles, you'll have the opportunity to develop your skills while working on impactful projects. If you're passionate about solving problems, uncovering insights and helping organisations make evidence-based decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

Day to Day


Gather, cleanse, validate and transform data from multiple internal and external sources to support reporting and analysis requirements
Create, develop and maintain reports, dashboards and visualisations using Power BI, Tableau or equivalent reporting tools
Apply analytical techniques to identify trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities for improvement.
Produce regular and ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support decision-making
Write efficient SQL queries to extract, manipulate, validate and analyse data from structured and semi-structured sources
Support the creation and maintenance of performance measures, KPIs and management information reporting
Document analytical methodologies, assumptions, calculations, definitions and data sources
Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Support data quality, governance and information management activities to ensure trusted and reliable reporting
Work collaboratively within agile, multidisciplinary delivery teams to deliver analytical outputs
Assist in identifying opportunities to improve reporting, processes and analytical capabilities
Communicate progress, risks and insights effectively with project teams, stakeholders and clients



What's In It For You


Work on meaningful data and analytics projects that support critical services and organisations across the UK
Develop expertise in data analysis, reporting, visualisation and business intelligence tools
Gain hands-on experience working with large and complex datasets across diverse client environments
Collaborate with experienced analysts, engineers, architects and business stakeholders
Build your technical capabilities across SQL, Power BI, Tableau and modern analytics practices
Access mentoring, knowledge sharing and professional development opportunities to support your career growth.
Contribute to data-driven solutions that deliver measurable business value and positive outcomes
Progress through clearly defined technical and professional development pathways as your experience grows



Benefits


A global network of expertise and opportunity
A culture founded on safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging
Flexible working arrangements that support your well-being and potential
Investment in your development through training, certifications and access to experienced mentors
Opportunities to contribute to communities of practice and internal data and analytics initiatives
Exposure to a variety of projects, sectors and analytical challenges
Competitive benefits package including pension, holiday allowance and additional perks
An inclusive environment where diverse perspectives, backgrounds and experiences are valued and encouraged



We welcome applications from candidates with varied backgrounds and experiences. If you don't meet every requirement listed but believe you can bring value to the role, we encourage you to apply.

#DigitalUKI

Here's what you'll need


Strong SQL skills, including joins, filtering, aggregation and data validation techniques.
Experience creating dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau or equivalent visualisation tools.
Advanced Excel skills for analysis, reporting and data manipulation.
Experience cleansing, reconciling and validating data from multiple sources.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, root causes and actionable insights.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience managing assigned tasks, documenting approaches and delivering to agreed deadlines.
Eligibility for SC Clearance



Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees.

With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs.

We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here.

Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles.

As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Your Mission

At Wise, we’ve got a clear mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. As a FinTech company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise needs bulletproof financials & insights into the growth of the company. We need timely, accurate and scalable financial data to make accurate business decisions inside the company.

Due to continued and rapid growth we’re on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Growth and Strategic Finance Team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

What You’ll Be Doing


Your principal responsibility will be to generate insights that lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers
Curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company
Depending on the project you’re working on, you’ll doing the following:
Helping us understand what’s driving our growth at a company or regional level
Understand our customer segments and cohorts, and how they contribute to our growth
Tie our customer acquisition and activity to marketing or product initiatives, to measure the realised financial return of those initiatives

Who You Are


3 years experience in similar roles
Mathematical or quantitative background
Strong SQL skills
Familiarity with Python/R
Strong analytical ability
Decent understanding of stats and statistical modelling
Data visualisation and storytelling ability
Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders
Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements


Desirable


DBT
Data modelling in a warehouse context
Understanding of testing and experimental design
Legally authorised to work in the UK


Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

Some Of Our Benefits

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

‍♀️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
