Date Posted:

2026-08-04

Country:

Canada

Emplacement / Location:

CA-QC-LONGUEUIL-J01 ~ 1000 Blvd Marie-Victorin ~ J01 BLDG

À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’industrie aérospatiale établi à Longueuil, au Québec. Nous fabriquons des moteurs de nouvelle génération qui équipent la plus grande flotte d’avions et d’hélicoptères au monde dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

En près de 100 ans, nous avons réalisé de nombreuses percées dans le développement de moteurs qui assurent le transport de marchandises et de matériel, luttent contre les feux de forêt et effectuent le transport de passagers.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l'un des 10 meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2025 selon Forbes, en plus d’être classée au premier rang des employeurs dans l'industrie de l'aérospatiale et de la défense au pays! Notre siège social figure sur le palmarès des meilleurs employeurs dans la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d'employeur de choix dans la région de Montréal, au Canada et dans le monde.

Nos attentes :

L’Analyste de données au département des pièces de rechange est responsable de l'automatisation et de l’optimisation de divers rapports. Il développe également des outils d’analyse pour détecter ou anticiper des enjeux. Il assume la responsabilité de plusieurs composantes d'un projet ou d'une composante complexe d'un projet plus vaste. Il contribue à son équipe ou à son département en mettant à profit ses connaissances dans plusieurs domaines fonctionnels.

Si vous êtes un professionnel capable de travailler de manière assez autonome et que vous avez une connaissance approfondie de la discipline et de la fonction, nous vous invitons à poser votre candidature.

Le poste est à temps plein du lundi au vendredi selon des horaires flexibles à Longueuil et s’effectue exclusivement en présentiel.

À quoi ressemblera votre travail quotidien :


Automatiser et améliorer les rapports existants
Développer avec Power BI, des outils et des rapports pour aider à la prise de décision pour l'organisation des pièces de rechange
Développer le processus et des méthodes pour améliorer la qualité des données (codes ELM , model family group,...)
Contribuer à l’amélioration des modèles d’intelligence artificielle (modélisation, visualisation, …)


Ce dont vous avez besoin pour réussir :

Les incontournables :


Baccalauréat en ingénierie, sciences appliquées, science de la gestion;
7 années d’expérience pertinente
Connaissance de langages de programmation (idéalement Python)
Connaissance d’outils de visualisation (idéalement Power BI)
Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais (parlé/écrit) et idéalement en français.
Excellente connaissance d’Excel (VBA)
Sens de l'organisation et capacité à travailler sous pression avec des priorités concurrentes et variables
Compétences en gestion des données
Esprit d’analyse développé (débogage)
Compétences en matière de gestion de projet
Compétences en analyste d’affaire (communication)


Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une très bonne connaissance de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre, sur une base quotidienne, de la documentation et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Ce que nous offrons


Programme de régime de retraite et d’épargne avec cotisation de l’employeur
Programme d’assurance collective
Possibilités d’avancement (progression de carrière)
Programme de mérite ou programme de reconnaissance
Programme de santé et bien-être, y compris la télémédecine
Club récréatif et sportif
Garderies à proximité
Accessibilité en transport ou programme de transport en commun et stationnement gratuit


Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada

Le masculin est utilisé sans discrimination et uniquement dans le but d'alléger le texte. Nous étudierons la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde. Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connecte les communautés et protègent les libertés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, vous avez l’occasion de faire une différence tous les jours; il suffit de lever les yeux. Êtes-vous prêt à vous dépasser?

About Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is a global leader in the aerospace industry, headquartered in Longueuil, Quebec. We manufacture next-generation engines that power the world’s largest fleet of business, general aviation, and regional aircraft and helicopters.

For nearly 100 years, we have pioneered advancements in engine development, supporting cargo and equipment, transportation, wildfire suppression, and passenger travel.

An Employer of Choice

Pratt & Whitney Canada was recognized as one of Canada’s Top 10 Employers in 2025 by Forbes and ranked #1 in the aerospace and defense industry in the country. Our headquarters is also listed among the top employers in the Montreal region. These accolades reinforce our reputation as an employer of choice in Montreal, Canada, and worldwide.

Our expectations:

The Data analyst in the Spare parts department is responsible for automation and improvement of various reports. He also develops data analytics tools to detect and anticipate issues. He assumes responsibility for several components of a project or a complex component of a larger project. He contributes to his team or department by applying his knowledge of several functional areas.

If you are a professional able to work quite independently and have a thorough knowledge of the discipline and the role, we invite you to apply.

This is a full-time position from Monday to Friday with flexible hours, based in Longueuil, and performed exclusively on-site

What your day to day will look like:


Automate and improve existing reports
Develop through Power BI, tools and reports to enable better decision-making in Spare parts organisation
Develop processes and methodology to improve the quality of the master data (Pricing, ELM codes, model family group, ...)
Contribute at improving the artificial intelligence (AI) models (modeling, visualisation, …)


What you need to be successful:

Must haves:


Bachelor's degree in engineering, applied science, management science or another relevant domain
7 years of relevant experience
Knowledge in programming (ideally Python)
Knowledge of visualisation tools (ideally Power BI)
Excellent knowledge of Excel (VBA)
Organizational skills and ability to work under pressure with competing and varying priorities
Data management skills
Developed analytical mindset (debugging)

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Lookout, Inc. is the leader in mobile AI security, delivering continuous threat exposure management for the modern, mobile-driven enterprise. Built on over 15 years of specialized expertise and informed by a global dataset analyzing hundreds of millions of mobile devices and applications, Lookout protects organizations against both behavioral and structural mobile risk.

Through its unified platform, featuring AI Visibility & Governance and the Mobile Software Exposure Center (MSEC), Lookout secures both sides of the mobile AI equation: governing user-to-AI interactions to prevent outbound data leakage while illuminating the mobile software supply chain to neutralize inbound, machine-speed vulnerabilities. By seamlessly feeding real-time mobile telemetry into broader enterprise CTEM and SOC workflows, Lookout closes the mobile exposure blind spot, enabling organizations to reduce risk and operate with confidence. To learn more, visit www.lookout.com and follow Lookout on LinkedIn and X.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead the company's reporting and analytics function. As the sole Data Analyst, this role serves as an internal analytics consultant, partnering with teams across the organization to turn business, product, and security data into actionable insights.

The Senior Data Analyst analyzes business operations, customer behavior, mobile application telemetry, and security event data to support decision-making, measure product performance, identify trends, and inform strategic planning. They also contribute to financial reporting, assisting with quarter-end close, invoicing and reconciliation. Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, independence, and excellent communication skills.

What You'll Do

Business, Product & Security Analytics


Develop and maintain executive dashboards and operational reports using Tableau.
Analyze and contextualize:
business metrics including revenue, customer growth, subscriptions, retention, product adoption, and operational performance.
mobile application telemetry, customer behavior, product usage, and feature adoption.
security event data to monitor threats, trends, anomalies, and product effectiveness.


Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Security Intelligence to address recurring and ad hoc analytical needs.
Define and monitor KPIs and identify trends and opportunities for business and product improvement.
Translate complex data findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.



Data & Reporting


Write efficient SQL queries in AWS Athena to extract and analyze large datasets stored in Amazon S3.
Integrate data from multiple internal systems to develop meaningful reporting and analytical solutions.
Design, develop, publish, and maintain Tableau dashboards used throughout the organization.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Document data sources, business rules, report definitions, and analytical methodologies.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and analysis.




Qualifications

Required


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence solutions in technology, mobile applications, cybersecurity, or a related environment.
Expert-level SQL proficiency and experience working with complex relational datasets.
Experience with AWS Athena or a similar cloud-based analytical query engine.
Advanced Tableau or equivalent BI platform experience.
Strong understanding of relational databases and data modeling.
Experience analyzing software product telemetry, application usage, or operational event data.
Experience working with large-scale datasets in cloud environments.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with minimal supervision.




Preferred


Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis, data exploration, and automation.
Experience in cybersecurity, mobile applications, and/or SaaS.
Knowledge of data governance and data quality practices.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and workflows for automating reporting and analysis.




Success In This Role

Success in this role means becoming a trusted analytics partner across the organization. The Senior Data Analyst will deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights; proactively identify opportunities for improvement; and continuously enhance the company's reporting and analytical capabilities.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

As our next Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance & Operations will serve as the primary Power BI specialist supporting our Canadian operations and shared services functions. This role combines data analytics, reporting development, systems integration, and business partnership to improve decision-making across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and Leadership.

You will work with data from multiple ERP and business systems to develop scalable reporting solutions, improve data quality, automate manual processes, and transform complex information into meaningful, actionable business insights. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong Business Intelligence professional who is passionate about analytics, automation, and continuous improvement.




Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Employee Well-being: Focus on employee health and well-being through various wellness programs and initiatives.
Inclusive Workplace: Join an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees are valued and respected.
Technological Leadership: Be part of a company that drives technological advancement and continuous innovation.
High-Impact Opportunity: Help shape the digital future of a growing manufacturing organization while gaining visibility with senior leadership.
Innovation and Growth: Explore new opportunities involving AI, automation, advanced analytics, and digital reporting solutions.




What You’ll Be Doing:

Serve as the primary Power BI subject matter expert for Canadian operations and shared services.
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, data models, KPI scorecards, and executive-level performance reporting tools.
Develop and maintain data models, relationships, measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query best practices.
Enhance existing reporting solutions and identify opportunities to improve reporting effectiveness, accessibility, and user experience.
Create automated reporting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the availability of business information.
Monitor and optimize dashboard performance, data refreshes, and reporting processes.
Maintain reporting documentation, report inventories, and user guides.
Identify opportunities to digitalize and automate manual business and reporting processes.
Use Power BI, SQL, Power Query, Power Automate, and other analytics tools to improve business visibility and operational efficiency.
Extract, transform, and validate data from Oracle, CMS, and other business systems.
Develop and troubleshoot SQL queries and data-extraction processes supporting reporting and analytical requirements.
Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to improve system connectivity, reporting automation, and data accessibility.
Evaluate new technologies and analytics tools that enhance reporting, automation, and decision-making.
Support adoption of reporting solutions through training, documentation, and ongoing user support.
Improve data integrity across ERP, reporting, and business systems through validation, standardization, and process improvements.
Maintain data mappings, reporting structures, and master-data relationships used within Power BI environments.
Partner with Finance, Operations, and IT to establish consistent KPI definitions, business rules, and reporting standards.
Help ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and transparency across multiple plants and business functions.
Support the development and maintenance of reporting governance practices and documentation.
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting requirements through automated reporting solutions and data analytics.
Work with business unit controllers, operations leaders, and management teams to understand reporting needs and business challenges.
Assist with the analysis of business performance, sales trends, operational metrics, and financial results.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning through reporting and analytical tools.
Translate complex business and technical data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.
Respond to ad hoc reporting and analytical requests from stakeholders.




What We Are Looking For:

Experience: Three to five years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting Systems, or a related field.
Education: Degree or diploma in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Finance, or a related discipline.
Power BI Expertise: Advanced Power BI capabilities, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard development, and performance optimization.
SQL Skills: Strong SQL skills with the ability to develop and troubleshoot complex queries.
Systems Integration: Experience integrating, transforming, and validating data from multiple business systems.
Microsoft Excel: Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
ERP Experience: Experience with Oracle, CMS, or comparable enterprise platforms is preferred.
Manufacturing Experience: Previous experience in a manufacturing environment is considered an asset.
Additional Technology Experience: Experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, Cognos, Python, or other analytical programming tools is considered an asset.
Emerging Analytics Tools: Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tools, Copilot, machine learning concepts, or predictive analytics is considered an asset.
Analytical Strength: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform data into actionable business insights.
Communication: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Business Partnership: Demonstrated success translating business requirements into practical reporting and analytical solutions.
Accuracy: Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
Independence: Self-starter who can independently manage multiple priorities and projects.
Continuous Improvement: Passion for analytics, automation, technology, and process improvement.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while consistently delivering high-quality results




What We Offer:

Johnson Electric offers talented people like you the opportunity to grow professionally and personally, surrounded by some of the most dedicated, innovative, and entrepreneurial colleagues you will find anywhere. The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Manage, structure, analyze, and standardize project data to support business and user requirements.
Develop and automate data processes and optimize tools across the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to improve efficiency and data quality.

Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.

Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs

Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.

Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . Description:
Established in 2004, we are a tech pioneer offering world-class adult entertainment and games on some of the internet’s safest and most popular platforms. With the support of an international team of dynamic and collaborative innovators, we are on a mission to enable safe user experiences and empower our communities by celebrating diversity, inclusion, and expression — all while maintaining robust trust-and-safety protocols.

Local talent can thrive in our collaborative office space with the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, while remote team members play an integral role in shaping our dynamic culture from afar. A select number of positions require full-time in office attendance*


The Data Warehouse Services team plays a vital role in our organization. Thrive in a fast-paced environment, where multitasking and adaptability are essential.

5+ years of experience in a similar role.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A career as a Senior Data Analyst in the Financial crime team at National Bank means serving as a Data and Analytics Specialist. This position allows you to have a concrete impact on decision-making and the evolution of the sector's analytical capabilities thanks to your expertise in data analysis, business intelligence and information governance. You will play a key role in transforming data into strategic information, supporting business partners in their decisions and contributing to the evolution of data solutions in a constantly changing environment.




Your job

Understand the needs of business partners and translate them into data requirements and adapted analytical solutions.
Analyze sector data, define business rules and ensure they are documented in order to support rigourous governance.
Prepare and validate reliable data for reports, dashboards, analyses and strategic initiatives.
Work with the it and data engineering teams to develop data platforms and contribute to modernisation projects, particularly on snowflake.
Diagnose data issues, identify their causes and coordinate their resolution to ensure operational continuity.
Produce value-added analyses, make recommendations based on data and communicate the results to the partners concerned.




Your team

The Vice-President, Technology and Data, more specialists work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

Within the Financial crime and regulatory projects sector, you will be part of the FinCrim Data Warehouse team and report to the Senior Manager – it Delivery – Data and Analytics. Our team stands out for its expertise in data engineering, its culture of collaboration and its commitment to developing reliable, high-performance and scalable solutions that support the Bank's financial crime activities and regulatory initiatives. Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.




Prerequisites

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Business Intelligence or a related field.
Over two years of significant experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics in a complex data environment.
Proficient SQL and be able to analyse complex data sets.
Python experience analyzing, profiling or automating data
Ability to transform business needs into data requirements and analytical solutions
Knowledge of modern data platforms, such as snowflake, as well as data modelling concepts, such as Data Vault or dimensional modelling.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Business Acumen, Dashboard Creation, Data Cleansing, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data pipeline, Data Validator, Data Vaults, Data Visualization, Exploratory Data Analysis, Microsoft SQL Server, Python, Risk Data and Analytics, Snowflake, Teamwork

Your benefits
In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment
We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Drug Intelligence is a leading Canadian health care data market research company with a 30+ year history. We specialize in providing relevant information, data and insights about serious and complex diseases from various therapeutic areas to our clients in the pharmaceutical industry.




As a Data Analyst at Drug Intelligence, you will be joining a dynamic team in a working environment that embraces high quality standards, initiative, creativity, and collaboration.




Important: to be considered for this position, in addition to the LinkedIn application we require candidates to fill out a 2, step, 20-min survey. You will automatically receive a link (by email) to complete the cognitive assessment (step 2) within 5 min of submitting the Predictive Index Assessment (step 1).

Link to survey: https://assessment.predictiveindex.com/bo/5PWK/Drug-Intelligence-Data-Analyst




Salary: $70,000-75,000 annually

 

Key Position Responsibilities:

 

Execute routine data processing tasks, including validation and transformation of data collected in a variety of formats into an analysis-ready format for other teams.
Extract, structure, and analyze relevant information from specific data sets, both recurring and on an ad-hoc basis, to meet client needs.
Own maintenance of existing data processes using Python and T-SQL (Azure): updating code to support new data elements and new analyses as requirements evolve and creating new data processing scripts as new projects arise.
Build and maintain data collection forms across multiple platforms (e.g., JotForm, Qualtrics).
Translate business and project requirements into data requirements with autonomy.
Become a subject matter expert on existing processes and work closely with data engineers to identify and help design solutions for process improvement and automation.
Collaborate with team members and cross-functionally on multiple simultaneous projects.




Desired Experience:

 

1-2 years of experience working as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, or in a similar role, with strong foundational skills in Python and SQL.
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent preferred.
Strong knowledge of Python (including Pandas) and SQL, especially for data manipulation and analysis.
Strong understanding of data warehousing methodologies and ETL concepts.
Experience with Azure SQL Database or a similar cloud database platform.
Strong project management and time management skills.
Effective multidisciplinary problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with data collection forms (e.g., JotForm, Qualtrics) would be a plus.




What Will You Get Out of This Role?

The chance to build strong analytical and problem-solving skills by troubleshooting real data processing issues that arise in day-to-day operations.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

At Roofr, building a powerful user experience starts with data. As a Senior Data Analyst at an early-stage, high-growth company, you’ll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights that shape product decisions, drive strategy, and improve the customer experience. You’ll have a direct impact on how we use data to grow, and help influence the roadmap for how analytics evolves at Roofr.

This role sits at the intersection of data analytics and business, ideal for someone comfortable moving between modeling data, building dashboards, and advising senior leadership on growth opportunities.

What You'll Get to Do:


Partner directly with business and product owners to shape roadmaps, prioritize features, and measure success
Build an AI-first business intelligence platform to supercharge self-serve analysis
Deliver actionable insights on user behavior, market trends, and business performance to marketing, revenue and product teams.
Lead sales and marketing analytics by defining KPIs and optimizing our acquisition funnels.
Tell compelling data stories to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences
Transform, clean, and model raw data using DBT to create reliable, analytics-ready datasets
Take ownership of our analytics foundation, inheriting existing models (DBT) and data warehouse structure (Snowflake) to clean, improve, and scale them alongside a Senior Analytics Engineer.


What You'll Bring to the Role:


7+ years of experience in data analysis and/or data science, ideally on sales, marketing, and growth analytics at a SaaS company
Expertise hacking AI/ML and automation tools for growth purposes, on top of using Claude, Cortex and other AI tools to streamline analytics workflow
Proficient in BI tools like Metabase, Sigma, Tableau, Omni, or Looker
Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, PostgreSQL)
Hands-on experience with DBT for managing the Transform layer of ELT pipelines
Ability to work cross-functionally to define metrics, create dashboards, and ensure data quality
A strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and accuracy


Who You Are:


Loves transforming messy data into clean models and insights
Thrives at bringing structure to chaos and able to find focus while juggling multiple projects
Lead with intent and proactively bring ideas to our partners and stakeholders
Eager to elevate your team and organization to new heights
A strong communicator with great presentation skills
Analytical with a demonstrated ability to utilize data to make informed decisions
A critical thinker who doesn’t settle for the status quo


Compensation Band: $130,000.00 - $140,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:


1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
Flexible time off
80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
RRSP/401k match
Generous Parental Leave policy


🤝 Perks:


We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
Home office setup stipend
Internet and phone allowance
Remote first culture
Weekly Friday paydays!

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Ethics and Compliance
Description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:


Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program



What are your contributions to the team?


Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide clear visibility into Ethics & Compliance metrics, trends, and risks (e.g., investigations, hotline, third-party risk, training).
Integrate and analyze data across multiple Ethics & Compliance datasets, creating a unified view to support decision-making and oversight.
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify anomalies, patterns, and potential indicators of misconduct or non-compliance.
Design and optimize data pipelines, data models, and automation processes to improve scalability, timeliness, and reliability of compliance data.
Partner with cross-functional teams (including Legal, HR, Audit, Risk, IT) to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights.
Enable data-driven investigations by extracting, analyzing, and interpreting relevant data.
Lead the evolution of analytics for our Ethics and Compliance organization, including the development of predictive analytics and forward-looking risk indicators.
Support the Strategy & Governance analyst to translate complex data into clear, business-friendly insights for leadership and stakeholders.



How to thrive in this role?


You have a Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
You have 5–8+ years of experience in data analytics.
You have advanced technical skills in:
SQL and data querying
Data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
You have familiarity with Databricks and programming languages such as Python or R; this would be considered an asset.
You have experience working with multiple, complex datasets and integrating them into cohesive reporting solutions.
You have an analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and hidden risks.
You demonstrate a high level of integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.
You are curious and adaptable, with an interest in advancing into predictive and advanced analytics.
You have the ability to build dashboards and tell a compelling data story to both technical and non-technical audiences.
You have experience working within an Ethics & Compliance, Risk, Audit, or Legal environment, as well as familiarity with compliance-related frameworks and data (e.g., hotline reports, investigations, risk management, policy adherence); this would be considered an asset.



Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

Bombardier is an equal opportunity employer and encourages persons of any race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics to apply.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are currently hiring a Data Analyst to join our Event Analysis and Insight team. Candidates must have a passion for data manipulation and visualization and the ability to think both independently and collaboratively. They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

You’ll Feel Right At Home If You


Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.
Have exceptional attention to detail and data gathering skills
Are great at finding patterns
Are great at presenting findings
Love digging through data in search of clues
Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
Are extremely organized
Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
Have completed a Bachelor’s degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science
Have a good knowledge of Python for data manipulation and visualization
Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
Thrive in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work off hours when necessary


What You’ll Be Working On


Analyzing non-financial post event data in order to gain insight and discover potential issues.
Creating reports and visualizations to help bring forward relevant information to the stake holders.
Collaborating with the development team to improve and/or create the necessary analysis tools.
Creating issue tickets and following up with the appropriate teams.
Participating in the research effort revolving around the trade strategies.
Developing necessary scripts for data gathering and manipulation.

Title: Analyste Power BI F/H
HTML:
Groupe international d’ingénierie, fortil repose sur un modèle indépendant et rassemble plus de 2 500 collaborateurs. Avec 30 agences réparties dans 14 pays, fortil cultive la liberté d'entreprendre et la libération des potentiels.

Contexte

Dans le cadre du soutien aux activités de gestion de projets majeurs et complexes, l’Analyste Power BI contribue à la collecte, au traitement et à la valorisation des données provenant de plusieurs systèmes d’information. Il accompagne les équipes dans la production d’indicateurs de performance, la reddition de comptes et l’amélioration continue des processus de gestion grâce à des solutions analytiques adaptées.

Responsabilités

  • Supporter les opérations liées à l’information de gestion, notamment en matière de reddition de comptes, de suivi de performance et d’analyse de données pour des projets majeurs et complexes;
  • Collecter, transformer et analyser des données issues de différents systèmes afin de produire des rapports de gestion, des tableaux de bord et des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI);
  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord interactifs sous Power BI permettant de faciliter la prise de décision;
  • Effectuer des analyses de données avancées via Excel et des outils spécialisés en intelligence d’affaires;
  • Assurer le suivi et l’analyse des coûts, des échéanciers et de la performance des projets;
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs besoins en matière de reporting et proposer des solutions adaptées;
  • Identifier des opportunités d’amélioration des processus, des outils et des systèmes en place afin d’optimiser leur utilisation et renforcer les contrôles associés;
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de gestion de données et des processus de reddition de comptes.

Profil recherché

  • Formation universitaire pertinente en intelligence d’affaires, analyse de données, administration, gestion de projets, informatique ou domaine connexe (Diplôme d’ingénieur requis) ;
  • 10 ans d’expérience dans un rôle d’analyste de données, analyste BI ou analyste en gestion de projets;
  • Solide expérience dans la création de rapports, l’analyse de données et la production de tableaux de bord décisionnels;
  • Bonne maîtrise de Power BI (modélisation de données, création de rapports, visualisations et exploitation des données);
  • Très bonne connaissance d’Excel et de la suite Microsoft Office;
  • Connaissance des principes de contrôle de coûts et de suivi budgétaire;
  • Expérience dans des environnements de gestion de projets majeurs et complexes;
  • Capacité à analyser des données complexes, synthétiser l’information et présenter des recommandations claires aux parties prenantes;
  • Autonomie, rigueur, esprit analytique et bonnes habiletés de communication.

Les raisons de nous rejoindre

Chez fortil, nous mettons en place des leviers concrets pour accompagner votre évolution et garantir un environnement de travail stimulant :

  • L’accompagnement sur la montée en compétences
  • Un écosystème pour sortir de votre zone de confort
  • La possibilité de devenir associé
  • L’engagement dans des projets associatifs
  • Une politique dédiée à la parentalité

Fortil s’engage en faveur de l’égalité des chances.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap, sans distinction de genre, d’origine ou d’orientation sexuelle.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Description:
About F12: F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms across Canada with a shared vision: to reduce risk and complexity by crafting technology platforms that empower leaders to focus and thrive. We elevate IT conversations from ingredients to outcomes, delivering fully designed solutions with no bad options. If you’re looking for the fast lane into an IT career or want to supercharge your professional development, you’ve come to the right place. At F12, you’ll collaborate with a diverse team and gain exposure to technology services across countless businesses—building a resume rich with experience and accomplishments. Our mission is to elevate our employees by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders. We value humble service, continuous improvement, and hard work—and we’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us.

The Position: Support the Data Operations team by developing reporting solutions, validating data quality, documenting business definitions, and maintaining governed data products. The Data Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and the DataOps team to ensure trusted, consistent, and actionable reporting.

Responsibilities

Reporting & Analytics


Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and scorecards for management and executives
Perform variance analysis between actuals, forecasts, budgets, and targets
Develop and maintain KPIs, measures, and visualizations aligned to business requirements.


Data Quality & Validation


Investigate reporting discrepancies and reconcile metrics across systems.
Support resolution of data quality issues by identifying root causes and documenting findings.
Validate reporting accuracy following deployments, system changes, or business logic updates.


Business Engagement & Requirements


Translate business questions into reporting and analytics solutions.
Partner with business teams to understand operational processes, KPIs, and reporting needs.


Governance & Documentation


Maintain KPI definitions, business glossaries, and reporting documentation.
Assist in semantic model and report certification activities.
Ensure reporting assets align with established governance standards and business definitions.


Data Product & Semantic Model Support


Support development and maintenance of reusable semantic models and views.
Support users in discovering and effectively utilizing certified reports and datasets.


Continuous Improvement


Recommend improvements to reporting, data quality, and analytics processes.
Contribute to ongoing DataOps initiatives that improve efficiency, governance, and data accessibility.


Experience


1-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related field.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for business stakeholders.
Experience working with multiple business systems and datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to translate business requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.


Requirements


Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, formulas, data analysis).
Power BI report development and dashboard design.
Ability to trace data lineage from source systems through transformations to reporting outputs.
Basic to intermediate DAX development.
Basic SQL querying and data validation.
Experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements.
Strong documentation and communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

Technical Skills


Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Semantic Models, Dataflows Gen2).
Experience with HubSpot CRM.
Experience with NetSuite ERP and revenue-related datasets.
Azure DevOps or similar work management platform.
PySpark, Python, or notebook development experience.
Experience working with APIs and data integrations.
Advanced DAX development and performance optimization.
Experience supporting or developing semantic models.


Revenue Analytics & Business Performance


Experience supporting revenue operations, sales operations, or marketing analytics functions.
Understanding of recurring revenue business models.


Governance & DataOps


Experience maintaining data dictionaries, metric glossaries, or metadata repositories.
Experience supporting certification, quality assurance, or report validation processes.
Understanding of modern analytics architectures, including data warehousing, lakehouse, and medallion architecture concepts.
Working knowledge of dimensional modeling concepts including fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.

Title: Analyste des données commerciales et digitales / Business and Online Data Analyst
Description:
Votre mission

Au sein de l'équipe Business Intelligence et Performance, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'analyse de la performance commerciale et digitale de l'entreprise. Grâce à votre expertise analytique et votre maîtrise des outils de reporting, vous transformez les données en informations stratégiques permettant d'orienter les décisions et d'optimiser les performances.

Vous contribuez également à l'amélioration continue des outils, des processus et de la qualité des données, dans un environnement collaboratif et omnicanal.

Principales responsabilités

Analyse et suivi de la performance commerciale


Assurer une compréhension approfondie de la performance globale de l'activité et des principaux leviers opérationnels.
Produire, analyser et présenter les reportings bimensuels et mensuels destinés aux équipes et à la direction.
Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles afin de soutenir les priorités opérationnelles et les décisions stratégiques.
Accompagner les exercices de prévision, les revues d'activité et le suivi de la performance grâce à l'analyse des données.
Garantir la fiabilité, la cohérence et la qualité des indicateurs, rapports et tableaux de bord.


Analyse de la performance digitale


Suivre et analyser les performances des différents canaux digitaux (site web, campagnes médias, SEO, CRM, etc.).
Concevoir, développer et optimiser les tableaux de bord de suivi de la performance digitale.
Veiller à la qualité du suivi et de la collecte des données en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et les parties prenantes concernées.
Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur les performances des campagnes, des promotions et des tendances de marché.
Présenter régulièrement les résultats et recommandations aux équipes métiers et aux partenaires internes.
Participer à des projets digitaux internationaux et transverses.


Gestion des données et amélioration continue


Extraire, analyser, valider et interpréter les données à l'aide d'outils tels que BigQuery et SQL.
Maintenir et faire évoluer les outils de reporting et les processus d'analyse existants.
Répondre aux besoins quotidiens en matière d'analyses et de reporting des différentes équipes.
Contribuer aux projets liés à l'omnicanalité, à la business intelligence et à la transformation de la donnée.
Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d'amélioration visant à optimiser les processus de reporting et la qualité des données.


Profil recherché

Formation et expérience


Formation universitaire en analyse de données, statistiques, informatique, finance, marketing analytique ou domaine connexe.
Expérience significative dans un rôle d'analyse de données, de business intelligence ou de performance digitale.


Compétences techniques


Excellente maîtrise de SQL et de BigQuery.
Solide expérience dans la création et l'optimisation de tableaux de bord via Power BI, Looker ou des outils similaires.
Maîtrise avancée d'Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, formules complexes, automatisations et macros).
Bonne connaissance des outils d'analyse digitale tels que Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager ou équivalents.


Compétences personnelles


Forte capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes.
Rigueur, souci du détail et sens de l'organisation.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en présentation de données.
Capacité à vulgariser des analyses complexes et à influencer la prise de décision.
Aisance à travailler en mode transversal dans un environnement dynamique et omnicanal.
Esprit collaboratif, curiosité et orientation résultats.


Atouts


Expérience dans les environnements e-commerce, marketing digital ou omnicanaux.
Connaissance des outils de visualisation et d'analyse avancée de données.
Expérience dans un contexte international ou multi-marchés.

Your Mission

As part of the Business Intelligence & Performance team, you will play a key role in analyzing and monitoring the company’s business and digital performance. Leveraging your analytical expertise and reporting capabilities, you will transform data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and drive business results.

You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting tools, data quality, and business intelligence processes in a collaborative and omnichannel environment.

Key Responsibilities

Business Performance Analysis & Reporting


Develop a strong understanding of overall business performance and the key operational drivers impacting results.
Produce, analyze, and present bi-weekly and monthly business reports and dashboards for stakeholders and leadership teams.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support operational priorities and strategic business decisions.
Provide analytical support for business reviews, forecasting activities, and performance tracking.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reports, KPIs, and dashboards.
Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to support business growth and operational efficiency.


Digital Performance Analysis


Monitor and analyze digital performance across key channels, including website, media, SEO, CRM, and other digital touchpoints.
Design, develop, and optimize digital performance dashboards and reporting solutions.
Ensure the quality and accuracy of tracking and measurement processes in collaboration with technical teams and relevant stakeholders.
Conduct in-depth analyses of campaign performance, promotional activities, customer trends, and digital initiatives.
Present performance results, insights, and recommendations to business and cross-functional teams.
Participate in global and cross-functional digital projects as required.


Data Management & Continuous Improvement


Extract, validate, analyze, and interpret data using tools such as BigQuery and SQL.
Maintain and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and recurring reporting processes.
Support day-to-day reporting and analytical needs across multiple business functions.
Contribute to omnichannel, business intelligence, and data transformation initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, data quality, automation, and overall analytical capabilities.

Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Marketing Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
Significant experience in a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, Digital Performance, or related analytical role.

Strong proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.
Proven experience building and maintaining dashboards using visualization tools such as Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling, and automation.
Good knowledge of digital analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar platforms.


Personal Competencies


Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.
Ability to influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations.
Comfortable working cross-functionally within a dynamic and collaborative omnichannel environment.
Curious, proactive, and results-oriented mindset.


Assets


Experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, travel, hospitality, retail, or omnichannel business environments.
Knowledge of advanced analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence methodologies.
Experience working in an international or multi-market environment.

Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties

2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Title: Analyste BI senior(e)
Description:
Aperçu

Joignez-vous à l'équipe des systèmes d'affaires et contribuez à transformer des données de projet complexes en informations claires et utiles. À titre d'analyste BI principal, vous collaborerez avec les équipes de projet, les parties prenantes d'affaires et les spécialistes technologiques afin de développer et d'améliorer des solutions d'intelligence d'affaires pour le secteur Grands projets.

Il n'est pas nécessaire de maîtriser toutes les technologies mentionnées ci-dessous. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne possédant de bonnes bases en BI, de solides capacités d'analyse et le désir d'apprendre et d'évoluer avec l'équipe.

Votre rôle


Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de les traduire en solutions BI concrètes.
Concevoir des modèles de données, des rapports et des tableaux de bord qui transforment les données brutes en informations pertinentes.
Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL, des processus de transformation de données et des solutions de production de rapports.
Contribuer au développement, à l'amélioration et à la maintenance des solutions Power BI.
Soutenir la qualité, l'intégrité et la fiabilité des données utilisées pour les rapports et les analyses.

Collaborer avec les développeurs, les analystes d'affaires, les chargés de projet et les responsables d'affaires.
Recommander des améliorations concrètes aux tableaux de bord, aux méthodes de production de rapports et aux pratiques de BI existantes.
Contribuer, lorsque pertinent, à l'automatisation des processus d'affaires et de production de rapports récurrents.


À propos de vous


Baccalauréat en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologies de l'information ou dans une discipline connexe, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinente.

Expérience avec des données provenant de plusieurs sources, par exemple des bases de données, des fichiers, des feuilles de calcul, SharePoint, des applications d'entreprise ou des plateformes infonuagiques.
Expérience en soutien de solutions, du développement jusqu'à la production.
Compréhension des pratiques de qualité, de gouvernance, de sécurité et de gestion des accès'aux données.

Microsoft Power Automate pour l'automatisation de flux de travail ou de processus d'affaires.

Microsoft SQL Server.

SharePoint et intégration d'applications d'entreprise.
Autres plateformes infonuagiques de données et d'analytique.
Conception d'entrepôts de données ou méthodes avancées d'intégration de données.
Connaissance pratique de SQL et des bases de données relationnelles.
Capacité à comprendre les besoins d'affaires et à les traduire en solutions techniques ou analytiques claires.
Solides capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'organisation.
Capacité à communiquer efficacement et à collaborer avec des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
Capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en contribuant au travail d'équipe.
Curiosité et volonté d'apprendre de nouveaux outils et domaines d'affaires.
Approche collaborative et souci du service à la clientèle.
Capacité à expliquer clairement des sujets techniques.
Bon jugement et souci du détail.
Approche pragmatique et orientée vers les solutions.
Intérêt pour l'amélioration continue et le partage des connaissances.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Us

At CAA Club Group, we are passionate about keeping our Members safe - whether they are on the road, at home, or travelling abroad. As a trusted Member-based organization, we provide products and services that are essential to Members’ safety and peace of mind. With over 2.6 million Members across Ontario and Manitoba, we advocate on issues such road safety and infrastructure, the environment, seniors’ mobility, and consumer protection. Associates share in each other’s successes, drive change and support each other while cultivating a great working environment to deliver on what is best for our Members. CAA SCO Systems & Services Inc is a member of the CAA Club Group of Companies.

Who We Are

Are you ready to join an award-winning, purpose-driven culture? Welcome to the CAA Club Group of Companies (CCG), where purpose leads to passion!

At CCG, we are committed to delivering an exceptional Associate experience. We offer:


Work-life harmony with access to an award-winning holistic wellness program,
Continuous learning through our robust corporate curriculum and education reimbursement program,
Incredible rewards, travel incentives, and product and service discounts,
Pay-for-performance and best-in-class recognition programs, and
Competitive benefits that include a defined contribution plan, personal spending account, and so much more.


Join our growing team where everyone belongs!

Position Details

What You Will Do


Create comprehensive and automated BI & Reporting solutions, while focusing on the front-end interface in Power BI.
Participate in the stakeholder requirement workshops/meetings and ensure business requirements are adequately captured in SOW.
In collaboration with BI Developer, support development of data solutions, including data models, data lifecycle management, data access and reporting elements.
Analyze complex data sets from various database servers and systems to identify insights and trends shaping in each LOB, functional area, and CCG enterprise.
Translate analysis into self-serve Power BI dashboards, including visuals, slicers, and measures with a focus on storytelling and user experience.
In collaboration with BI Developer, create mockup reports for proof-of-concept reviews.
Support lines of business in a variety of analytical needs including development of robust analytical plans, statistical analysis, key performance indicators, benchmarking, data visualizations, routine, and ad hoc reporting.
Utilize machine learning techniques to proactively identify opportunities for transforming descriptive to predictive analytics.
Provide analytics support on key projects/initiatives aligned to business or organizational strategies.
Create technical documents for all newly built data/reporting solutions.
Serve as a subject matter expert across Finance and assist users with reporting and analysis activities and tools, including ad hoc reporting.
Support end-user training, testing, documentation, and roll-out of reports.
Maintain knowledge of business processes and application design and understand cross-functional business relationships and their use of information.
Work in conjunction with other internal teams on collaborative projects, including data analytics initiatives.
Keep current on emerging tools and techniques and grow knowledge of the business.


Who You Are


Undergraduate degree or post-secondary education in quantitative field (Computer Science, Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Economics, etc.).
Microsoft Power BI or appropriate Analytics certification is desirable.
3+ years of experience developing Power BI dashboards ensuring security, architecture, governance, and performance meets outlined objectives.
3+ years of experience working with databases and warehouses, with hands-on expertise in SQL-Server (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS tabular models).
3+ years of experience in analytical languages, including DAX, M, BEx, Power Query, etc.
Familiarity with ML concepts, frameworks, and libraries along with the ability to execute these in Python/R is considered a strong asset.
Experience working with SAP BI/BW/BPC is considered a strong plus.
Attention to detail with high aptitude for problem-solving.
Excellent communication skills, proven ability to discuss BI solutions at the appropriate level of detail with all levels of the organization.
Ability to adjust to changing priorities and participation in multiple projects.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access).


Please note that we may use AI tools to help us through the recruitment process.

Our Commitment

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with all applicable Provincial Human Rights and Accessibility Legislation. CCG will provide accommodations to job applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please notify us and we will work with you to meet your needs.
