Title: Business and Data Analyst
Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Business & Data Analyst to support the launch and growth of our consumer lending business in Canada.

This is a key role in building our data and analytics capabilities from the ground up. The successful candidate will initially play a hands-on role in establishing our data, BI and reporting foundation, and will progressively take on broader business analytics across customer acquisition, application and conversion, product performance, operations, customer lifecycle and overall business performance.

The ideal candidate combines a strong quantitative and analytical foundation, hands-on data capabilities, and strong business sense. You should be comfortable working directly with data, building dashboards and reporting solutions from scratch, identifying the drivers behind business performance, and translating analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.

Experience in consumer lending, fintech, banking or other credit-related businesses is highly preferred.




Key Responsibilities

1. Business Intelligence & Reporting

Build and develop the company's BI and reporting capabilities from the ground up.
Develop and maintain dashboards and recurring reports covering key business and operational metrics.
Establish and maintain a consistent KPI framework and business performance reporting structure.
Extract, consolidate and transform data from multiple sources to support business reporting.
Automate recurring reporting processes and continuously improve reporting efficiency and accuracy.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate them into practical data solutions.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency and reliability of key management reports and dashboards.

2. Data Management & Analytics

Use SQL and other analytical tools to extract, clean, transform and analyze data from multiple sources.
Build reliable datasets and analytical tables to support reporting and business analysis.
Conduct data quality checks and identify data gaps, inconsistencies and anomalies.
Develop a strong understanding of data structures, business definitions and relationships across key systems.
Work with Technology and other cross-functional teams to improve data availability, quality and usability.
Support the development of data processes and analytical infrastructure as the business grows.

3. Business Performance Analytics

Analyze end-to-end business performance across customer acquisition, applications, conversion, funding, repayment and operations.
Monitor key business metrics and identify trends, anomalies and opportunities.
Analyze acquisition channels and marketing campaigns to understand customer acquisition and conversion performance.
Analyze the application funnel and identify key customer drop-off points and conversion drivers.
Conduct cohort, segmentation and trend analysis to understand changes in business performance over time.
Analyze loan origination, loan volume, average loan size, revenue and other key business metrics.
Conduct root-cause analysis and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.

4. Product & Customer Analytics

Analyze customer behavior and performance across the customer journey, from acquisition and application through funding and repayment.
Analyze product performance, customer segments, conversion rates and customer behavior.
Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, application experience and product conversion.
Support Product and Business teams with data-driven analysis for new products, features, processes and initiatives.
Conduct customer segmentation, cohort analysis and other analytical exercises to identify customer trends and business opportunities.
Support A/B testing and other data-driven initiatives where appropriate.

5. Business Decision Support

Partner closely with Business, Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance and Technology teams to support data-driven decision making.
Translate complex data and analytical findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
Provide ad-hoc analysis to support strategic and operational business decisions.
Proactively identify emerging business trends, operational issues and opportunities through data analysis.
Prepare analytical materials and insights for management discussions and business reviews.
Go beyond reporting what happened to understand why it happened, what it means for the business, and what actions should be taken next.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or above in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or another quantitative discipline.
3–5 years of relevant experience in business analytics, data analytics, BI, product analytics, marketing analytics or a related analytical role.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to work with complex datasets and conduct structured analysis.
Strong hands-on experience with SQL and data extraction, transformation and analysis.
Experience building dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau or similar BI tools.
Strong Excel skills and experience with data manipulation and analysis.
Strong understanding of data cleaning, data transformation and data quality management.
Demonstrated ability to translate data into meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.
Strong business acumen, with the ability to understand the business context behind the numbers and identify the underlying drivers of business performance.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working independently and taking ownership in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience in consumer lending, fintech, banking or other credit-related businesses.
Experience analyzing lending or financial services data.
Experience with customer acquisition, marketing analytics, product analytics or application funnel analysis.
Experience with loan origination, customer lifecycle or repayment data.
Experience with Python, R, SAS or other analytical programming languages.
Experience with data modeling, ETL or modern data platforms.
Experience with A/B testing, cohort analysis or customer segmentation.
Experience building BI and analytics capabilities in a new or rapidly growing business.




What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is strong with numbers, comfortable with data, and genuinely interested in the business.

The ideal candidate is not simply a reporting analyst who tells us what happened. You should be able to look at the data and ask:

Why did application or conversion rates change?
Which acquisition channels are performing best, and why?
Where are customers dropping off in the application journey?
Which customer segments or products are performing differently?
What operational issues are affecting customer experience or business performance?
What opportunities can we identify from the data?
What should the business do differently based on the analysis?

You will have the opportunity to play a key role in building the data-driven foundation of a new Canadian consumer lending business from 0 to 1, while working closely with senior management and multiple business functions.

At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

We are seeking an experienced Senior Analyst to join our dynamic Business Intelligence team. The Senior Analyst will play a pivotal role in driving marketing strategies, optimizing campaign performance, and maximizing ROI through advanced analytics and insights generation. This position offers an exciting opportunity for an analytical thinker with a passion for marketing to make a significant impact within our organization.

What You'll Do Here:

Lead the development and delivery of strategic reports and insights, translating complex data into actionable recommendations that drive business growth and marketing optimization.
Conduct advanced analysis and modeling using both primary and secondary research methods to uncover trends, opportunities, and performance drivers.
Act as a strategic partner to cross-functional teams, providing data-driven recommendations to support key business initiatives and decision-making.
Develop and optimize sophisticated dashboards and reporting frameworks using BI tools to enable leadership with real-time, actionable insights.
Ensure data governance and compliance, collaborating with technology, product, and data engineering teams to maintain data integrity and regulatory standards.
Drive process improvements and innovation, identifying opportunities to enhance analytical capabilities, streamline workflows, and implement best practices.
Manage and consolidate data from diverse sources, ensuring comprehensive and high-quality inputs for business analysis and strategic planning.
Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members, fostering knowledge sharing and skill development across the team.
Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, leveraging insights to provide thought leadership and shape future business strategies.
Lead stakeholder engagements, effectively communicating insights, recommendations, and complex data concepts to non-technical audiences at various organizational levels.

You'll Need To Have:

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data analysis, or related roles. Marketing agency work experience preferred.
Experience with DSPs, Paid Media, and social media platforms preferred.
Experience in executing brand tracking and Brand Lift research preferred.
Experience in Google Cloud Platforms and BI tools such as Looker and Looker Studio preferred.
Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Python, R, SQL, or similar scripting languages.
Experience with marketing analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or similar tools.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas to non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and a passion for problem-solving and continuous improvement.
This role has an annual salary range of $80,000 to $95,000.  This range reflects the full scope and progression of the role, from building capability to operating with sustained impact at a higher level. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits and total rewards package designed to support our team as they grow with us.
Where an offer falls within this range is determined through the interview process. Candidates are benchmarked by the hiring team based on role scope, relevant experience, skill alignment, and expected impact, using consistent and objective criteria.  Compensation Philosophy:
At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.
Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact. AI in Recruitment: Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

Title: Business Insights Analyst
Description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:




BCU Financial is seeking a motivated and analytical full-time Business Insights Analyst to join the Product, Sales & Marketing team. Reporting to the Manager, Product, Sales & Marketing, the role supports data-driven decision-making by analyzing member, product, sales, marketing, channel, and operational data. The analyst develops reports, dashboards, and performance insights that help leadership monitor results, identify trends, and measure organizational performance. 




Working primarily with Product, Sales & Marketing and collaborating with Finance, Operations, Technology, and Member Service teams, the Business Insights Analyst transforms data into actionable business intelligence that supports planning, performance management, member growth, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate combines strong analytical capability, attention to detail, business curiosity, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:




Business Analytics & Insights

Analyze member, product, channel, marketing, sales, and operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities. 
Perform routine, ad hoc, and exploratory analyses in support of business initiatives and operational priorities. 
Interpret findings and develop clear, actionable recommendations for management and business partners. 
Conduct root-cause analysis to investigate performance variances, emerging issues, and business challenges. 
Prepare analytical summaries, presentations, and briefing materials for management and senior leadership. 




Business Decision Support

Provide analysis and performance information to support management decisions, operational reviews, and strategic initiatives. 
Assist with business cases, forecasting exercises, budgeting activities, and project evaluations. 
Evaluate the performance and business impact of products, services, campaigns, programs, and process enhancements. 
Participate in cross-functional projects by contributing analytical expertise, measurement frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations. 




Member & Market Analysis

Conduct member segmentation, demographic, behavioural, and lifecycle analyses to support growth and engagement strategies. 
Monitor member acquisition, retention, product adoption, channel utilization, and service usage trends. 
Analyze member behaviours and product utilization to identify opportunities to strengthen member experience and relationships. 
Research competitor activity, financial services trends, and market developments to support planning. 
Prepare comparative analyses and benchmarking reports on market position, member trends, and product performance. 




Data Management & Quality

Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other business teams to ensure the availability and reliability of data sources.
Investigate data discrepancies and recommend corrective actions to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistency.
Maintain documentation of reporting methodologies, calculation logic, business definitions, and analytical processes.




Performance Reporting & Dashboard Development

Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, recurring reports, and business intelligence tools based on approved business requirements. 
Collaborate with business owners to define, track, and report on approved key performance indicators and operational metrics. 
Produce weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for management and leadership teams. 
Monitor performance against established targets and highlight significant trends, exceptions, and areas requiring attention. 
Automate and streamline reporting processes to improve efficiency, consistency, and data accessibility. 
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of reporting outputs and underlying data sources. 




Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

Partner with business teams to understand operational challenges, analytical needs, and reporting requirements. 
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Provide guidance to business users on interpreting reports, dashboards, performance metrics, and analytical findings. 
Assist users in understanding reporting tools and dashboard functionality. 
Encourage effective use of performance information and analytics across the organization. 




Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automation, and predictive analytics. 
Recommend enhancements to data visualization, KPI frameworks, and analytical methodologies. 
Remain current on business intelligence tools, analytics practices, financial services trends, and industry developments. 
Contribute to initiatives that strengthen organizational reporting and analytical capabilities. 




Success Measures

Accurate and timely reports, and analytical summaries.
Clear identification of trends, exceptions, and areas requiring management attention.
Improved visibility into member, product, sales, marketing, and operational performance.
Effective support for business planning, performance monitoring, and decision-making.
Strong collaboration with stakeholders and clear communication of findings.
Continued improvement in reporting consistency, data quality, and dashboard usability.




QUALIFICATIONS:




Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
Three or more years of experience in business analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or performance measurement. 
Experience analyzing business data and translating findings into practical recommendations. 
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI tracking tools. 
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and practical experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, attention-to-detail, and communication skills. 
Ability to present data and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
Experience working with business systems and information sources to extract, organize, validate, and analyze data. 




Preferred Assets

Experience in financial services, banking, credit unions, insurance, or another regulated industry. 
Experience supporting product, sales, marketing, member experience, or business performance initiatives. 
Experience with member or customer analysis, market research, forecasting, trend analysis, or business case development. 
Experience with CRM systems, business intelligence platforms, or enterprise reporting solutions. 
Experience with Power Query, data modelling, or DNA’s CRM BI tool. 
Knowledge of SQL, data warehousing concepts, or statistical analysis techniques.
Experience working in member-focused, community-based, or culturally diverse organizations.




COMPENSATION:




Salary Range: $68,000 - $82,000 annually




Compensation for this role will be determined based on experience and qualifications. BCU Financial also offers a competitive and comprehensive beneﬁts package.

Please note that while we thank all applicants for their interest in a career with BCU Financial, only those chosen for an interview will receive further communication.




BCU Financial Group is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. BCU Financial Group provides accommodation during the recruitment process upon request. Requests received relating to accommodation will be addressed conﬁdentially.




About BCU Financial:




BCU Financial is a member-owned ﬁnancial cooperative dedicated to improving the lives of its members and their community. As part of the growing Ontario-based BCU Financial Group, it provides Ukrainian-Canadians with diversiﬁed ﬁnancial services and products.




BCU Financial Group offers a compelling alternative to traditional banking through its various divisions. BCU Financial provides a no-fee personal chequing account, along with savings accounts, loans, mortgages, credit cards, and online banking to its members. The broader BCU Financial Group also encompasses BCU Wealth Management and BCU Insurance, serving clients with investment and insurance services respectively, and supports the community through BCU Foundation and its donors. BCU Financial, together with its BCU Wealth Management division, currently oversees $1.2 billion in assets.




Underscoring its commitment to building a strong community, BCU Financial Group provides generous sponsorship funding annually to a wide array of Ukrainian community-based projects and activities. The Credit Union and its member-supported charitable institution, BCU Foundation, provide sponsorship funding of over $1 million annually for community organizations, charity fundraisers, student scholarships, cultural events, and educational projects.

Job Title: Manager, Data Analytics

Data Analyst plays a critical role in enabling enterprise-wide data-driven decision-making by managing and advancing McKesson’s data assets. This position is responsible for identifying, capturing, analyzing, and organizing data to support strategic and operational objectives. The role ensures adherence to information governance standards and leverages advanced analytics to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that inform key business decisions. The analyst designs and maintains relational databases, creates dashboards and reports, and implements statistical models to guide decision-making. Collaborating with governance teams, data stewards, and business stakeholders, this position drives improvements in data quality, accessibility, and usability while influencing best practices across the organization.

Job Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do:


Manage and advance the data fabric to organize, integrate, and deliver enterprise data assets.
Design, create, and maintain relational databases and data systems, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Implement and apply statistical models to identify trends, patterns, and relationships that support decision-making.
Contribute to the management of central data stores and metadata, establishing and enforcing quality expectations.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, including automation and procedural enhancements for data entry and validation.
Develop and implement techniques for data collection, accuracy, and management, ensuring compliance with governance standards.
Accountable for data accessibility, profiling, and reporting of quality issues, driving remediation strategies.
Collaborate with data governance, stewards, and business systems to propose and implement solutions for data quality improvement.
Recommend analytics opportunities and best practices, influencing enterprise adoption of advanced analytics.
Ensure development of solutions that enable actionable insights, supporting strategic and operational decision-making.



What We’re Looking For: Minimum Requirements:


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced degree preferred.
Typically requires 7+ years of relevant professional experience advancing data programs, including quality management, integration pipelines, and cloud data warehousing for scalable analytics.



Critical Skills/Experience:


Advanced capability in data modeling and database design for complex analytical systems.
Proficiency in data quality management programs, including accuracy, completeness, and timeliness checks.
Advanced capability in cloud data warehousing and performance optimization for large-scale analytics.
Proficiency in metadata management and lineage documentation for compliance and governance.
Ability to implement advanced data integration pipelines and monitor data flow reliability.
Competence in Business Function Knowledge, Customer & Business Driven, Problem Solving, Building Relationships, Adaptability, Digital Acumen, and Creativity.
Clear written and verbal communication tailored to both business and technical audiences.



Technical Expertise:


Advanced experience leveraging Databricks, Snowflake, and SQL to develop scalable analytical datasets, models, and reporting solutions.
Strong proficiency with Power BI to deliver executive-ready dashboards, KPIs, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to partner closely with business stakeholders to frame problems, identify opportunities, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
Experience supporting commercial, pricing, customer, product, or portfolio analytics with an understanding of how insights drive business performance and decision-making.
Proven ability to work independently in ambiguous environments, balancing technical execution with strategic business consultation to deliver measurable outcomes.

Title: Analyst, Business Analytics
Description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As a member of the Client Account Management Business Integration team, you'll work in a fast-paced banking operations and collections environment where you'll make a meaningful difference in our clients' lives. As an Analyst, Business Analytics, you'll build strong relationships with internal partners, understand their business reporting needs, and deliver tailored business intelligence insights that support informed decision-making. You'll create meaningful reporting and analysis that helps teams understand performance, identify opportunities, and improve outcomes. In this role, you'll support multiple initiatives at once, balancing competing priorities while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and service. You'll also help enhance reporting processes and contribute to a more efficient, data-driven client experience.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed


Reporting and analysis - Create reports, dashboards, and business commentary that highlight performance, trends, successes, and opportunities for improvement. Use data to uncover patterns and provide insights that help partners make informed, data-driven decisions.
Advanced analytics - Apply and continue developing your skills in advanced analytics, including time-series forecasting, regression analysis, and classification methodologies, to deliver more meaningful business insights.
Automation - Lead end-to-end automation of scheduled reporting and workflows, from data preparation and cleanup to final output and presentation. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen reporting accuracy.
Relationship building - Partner with teams across the business to build collaborative relationships, provide subject matter expertise, and clearly communicate analysis, insights, and recommendations.
Leveraging technology - Explore and adopt new tools that support faster, more accurate delivery. Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to team automation goals and continuous improvement.


Who You Are


You can demonstrate experience in Alteryx, Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft Excel macros, SAS, and Structured Query Language (SQL) to build, maintain, and improve reporting and self-serve data workflows. It's an asset if you hold a certification in Alteryx or Power Automate.
You know that details matter. You notice things that others don't. Your critical thinking skills help to inform your decision making.
You love to learn. You're passionate about growing your knowledge. You have a strong sense of curiosity.
You're passionate about people. You find meaning in relationships and surround yourself with a diverse network of partners. You connect with others through respect and authenticity.
You're goal oriented. You're motivated by accomplishing your goals and delivering your best to make a difference. You can manage competing priorities and stay focused in a fast-paced environment.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.


What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential.


We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive compensation, a banking benefit*, wellbeing support and additional offers such as employee and family assistance programs and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.

CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com

Title: Senior Analyst, Data & Analytics
Description:
Permanent Full Time

The Senior Data Analyst leads analytical framing, experimentation, business analysis, value realization, stakeholder engagement, and solution delivery support for AI-enabled business initiatives, helping teams turn complex or ambiguous opportunities into practical, measurable outcomes.

Working closely with AI Enablement leads, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, business stakeholders, and technology teams, this role translates business opportunities into measurable AI use cases and guides the evaluation, implementation, and adoption of AI solutions through evidence-based analysis and recommendations.

The successful candidate combines strong analytical skills with business acumen, acts as a trusted analytics partner, and bridges technical and business stakeholders to help AI initiatives deliver practical, measurable value while supporting consistent and repeatable delivery practices.

What you will do:


Lead the translation of complex or ambiguous business opportunities into clear AI use cases, analytical questions, success measures, and measurable outcomes that can be tested and evaluated.
Own practical analytical approaches, including experiments, pilots, measurement frameworks, reporting, and interpretation, to assess whether AI-enabled solutions are delivering value.
Build confidence in AI solutions by guiding data collection, validation, testing, quality assurance, and performance monitoring activities.
Partner with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to identify source-system data, manage it through the data lifecycle, and develop analytical products that support AI-enabled solutions.
Turn analytical findings, business context, and evaluation results into clear recommendations that influence stakeholder decisions about AI opportunities, adoption, prioritization, and next steps.
Support adoption and repeatable delivery by developing workshops, training, job-aides, measurement practices, and other materials that help teams understand and apply AI solutions effectively.


What you will bring:

Required


Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Business, Engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5+ years of experience applying data, analytics, business analysis, or digital enablement practices to solve business problems and improve outcomes.
Experience translating business needs into analytical questions, success measures, requirements, and practical recommendations.
Experience designing or supporting experiments, pilots, performance measurement approaches, or value realization assessments.
Experience working with business stakeholders and technical partners to define requirements, interpret findings, and support implementation decisions.
Proficiency with analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI, SQL, or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of data platforms, programming, or cloud-based analytics environments such as Azure, Databricks, Python, or comparable tools.
Experience working in Agile or iterative delivery environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, collaboration, and subject-matter credibility rather than formal authority.
Experience providing guidance, peer support, or informal coaching to analysts or multidisciplinary partners.
Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and communication skills.
Ability to bridge technical and business audiences effectively.
Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. This is a personal security status that is required as a condition of employment before an employee can gain access to Protected B information, assets or work sites as outlined by the Government of Canada  website.  The cost of submitting these checks will be covered by Canada Life.


Preferred


Experience supporting AI, machine learning, generative AI, automation, or advanced analytics initiatives.
Exposure to AI governance, responsible AI, privacy, or data governance practices.
Experience supporting proof-of-concepts, pilots, or adoption activities for emerging technology solutions.
Strong foundation in research methods, measurement design, evaluation methodologies, or benefits realization.


The base salary for this position is between $80,400- $130,400 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Title: Senior Fraud Analyst Rogers
Description:
Looking to join a growing financial services team? Rogers Bank, a subsidiary of Canada's leading wireless, cable and media company, is expanding and seeking passionate individuals to develop and implement innovative financial solutions and experiences. The bank offers unique cash-back benefits and financing options for Rogers purchases using cutting-edge technology. Interested? Take the next step and consider this opportunity to make a meaningful impact with Rogers Bank.

Who We Are Looking For

As a key member of the Fraud Strategy team, the Senior Fraud Analyst performs detailed trend analysis and makes business critical recommendations to enhance performance and reduce fraud loss exposure for both external and internal fraud so that the Bank operates within its risk appetite.

The role proactively evaluates program performance, with the goal of identifying and assisting in the delivery of process improvements to drive operational efficiencies, new system capabilities, and enhanced service delivery to Rogers Bank customers.

What You'll Do


Assist in the development and performance monitoring to optimize fraud prevention and detection while maintaining a balanced approach between mitigation and risk appetite
Proactively identifies trends, draws meaningful conclusions, and delivers change recommendations at a strategic and tactical level.
Develop strong knowledge of fraud delivery platforms to articulate enhancement requirements based on industry best practices and business needs, ensuring that solutions are operationally and technologically sound and can be integrated into business processes.
Leverage industry tools and provide insights to monitor and minimize fraudulent credit card transactions across the entire account life cycle, including originations, authorizations and account reissue.
Perform regular analysis of fraud losses, transaction activity, and monitor fraud-related metrics and investigate unusual trends, data discrepancies to identify key drivers, emerging risks, and opportunities for fraud prevention.
Assist with developing, analyzing, distributing fraud reporting, and translate business requirements into data solutions and provide results with meaningful and actional information
Support the development and improvement of reporting processes, including data validation, script automation, and enhancements to reporting efficiency and accuracy.
Partner with cross-functional teams, including Fraud Operations, Finance, Acquisition, Credit Risk, third-party vendors to support data and reporting needs, identify and address emerging threats and provide data-driven analytics and insights.


What You'll Bring


University or master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or related quantitative discipline
Demonstrated work experience in data analytics, business intelligence, financial services, or credit card industry. Working knowledge of TSYS TS2, CardGuard, Determinator, Broadcom/Arcot, MasterCard Connect system, and credit card
fraud detection systems is considered as asset.
Proficient in utilizing analytical tools and programming languages to perform data extraction, preparation, manipulation, analysis, and visualization, including SQL, Python, Power BI, and Excel, and understanding of relational databases
Working knowledge of developing performance dashboards, reports, and business scorecards
Proven Ability to extract and interpret data; Providing meaningful insights and actionable recommendations from data
Experience in leveraging scheduler programs to automate reporting functions and improve process efficiency
Detail oriented, analytical, organized, and self-sufficient.
Ability to adapt and reprioritize in a fast-paced, changing work environment and work on multiple complex initiatives simultaneously


What’s in it for you?

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including


Competitive salary & annual bonus
Competitive & flexible health and dental benefits, pension plan, RRSP, TFSA, and Stock matching programs.
Discounts Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
Paid time off for volunteering
Company matching contributions to charities you support
Growth & Development Opportunities
Self-driven career development programs (E.g. MyPath program)
Rogers First priority in applying to internal roles of interest
Wellness Programs
Homewood employee & family assistance program
Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) & Virtual therapy sessions
Low or no-cost fitness membership with access to virtual classes
Our commitment to the environment and diversity
Work for an organization committed to environmental protection
Strong commitment to diversity and inclusion with employee resource groups supporting equity-deserving groups including groups representing People of Colour, 2SLGBTQIA+, Indigenous Peoples, Persons with Disabilities and Women. We all bring something different, and we know what makes us different makes us great.

If you are selected to move forward in the recruitment process, here is what you can expect

15-minute phone screen with your recruiter, an interview with Hiring Manager, a final round virtual interview with Director of the team. Best of luck!

To protect our people, brand and assets, a pre-employment background check will be conducted. As part of our selection process, all candidates must clear a criminal background check. Additionally, a credit check and drivers abstract may be required depending on the role.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Team

The Data team within Global Finance & Risk Technology (GFRT) provides enterprise-level analytics, data services, governance support, and operational data management for Global Finance initiatives. The team plays a critical role in supporting financial close processes, financial reporting, data migration initiatives, system implementations, and ongoing operational activities while ensuring the delivery of high-quality Financial Data Management, Data Analysis, Data Quality, and Data Governance services across the organization.

Role


We are seeking a Data Analyst to support business operations through data analysis, reporting, process improvement, system implementation, and operational support activities.
The role is responsible for delivering analytical insights, managing data migration initiatives, supporting financial and operational processes, and developing solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and control effectiveness.
Working closely with business stakeholders, operations teams, finance partners, and technology teams, the position plays a key role in maintaining data integrity, supporting system transitions, and ensuring successful business outcomes.
The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise in data engineering, programming, data analysis, data modeling, and database design with a solid understanding of finance, accounting, and operational processes.
This individual must be highly analytical, proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working effectively with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Technology, and Vendor teams. Experience supporting system implementations, data migrations, financial reconciliations, and process automation initiatives is highly desirable.


What will we expect from you?

Data Analysis & Reporting


Collect, validate, analyze, and interpret data from multiple business systems.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support decision-making.
Conduct ad hoc analysis and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.
Monitor data quality, identify anomalies, and investigate discrepancies.


Process Improvement & Automation


Identify opportunities to streamline and automate operational processes.
Develop and maintain reporting, reconciliation, and analytical solutions.
Support the implementation of process enhancements, system upgrades, and operational efficiencies.
Create and maintain process documentation, user guides, and operational procedures.


Data Migration & System Implementation


Support data migration initiatives involving the transition from legacy systems and local ledgers to enterprise platforms, including PeopleSoft 9.2 (PS92).
Coordinate data extraction, validation, transformation, and loading activities.
Establish and validate historical balances and reference data within the new system environment.
Perform reconciliation activities to ensure completeness and accuracy between source and target systems.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to resolve migration and conversion issues.
Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), parallel runs, production readiness, and go-live activities.
Provide post-implementation support, including issue investigation, defect resolution, process stabilization, and end-user assistance following deployment.


Stakeholder Management & Governance


Partner with business, operations, finance, and technology teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and management.
Support audit requests, control testing, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Maintain strong governance and control practices over data, reporting, and operational processes.


Operational Support


Support day-to-day operational and financial processes.
Prepare, review, and coordinate special entries, adjustments, corrections, and related operational transactions.
Investigate, resolve, and escalate operational issues as required.
Perform reconciliations and exception analysis to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end operational activities.

Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field.
3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, operations support, technology, or a related field.

SQL and data analysis
Microsoft Excel and data manipulation
Reporting and dashboard development

Database concepts and data structures
Data validation, reconciliation, and quality control processes
Software development or data engineering fundamentals
Experience through work, internships, co-op placements, or academic projects with:
Data analysis and reporting
Large datasets and data-driven decision-making
Process improvement or automation initiatives

Ability To


Analyze data and identify trends, issues, and anomalies
Translate business requirements into analytical solutions
Support testing, implementation, and operational activities
Learn new technologies and business processes quickly
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment.

Python, ACL, SAS, VBA, or similar scripting and automation tools

ETL tools (DataStage, Informatica, or equivalent)
OFSAA or other financial data management platforms

Chart of Accounts (CoA/CoFA) design and financial hierarchies
Regulatory reporting and risk data environments

PeopleSoft 9.2 (PS92) or comparable ERP platforms
Experience supporting:
Financial system migrations and ledger conversions
Financial Close processes
Audit and regulatory compliance initiatives

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to resolve complex data and operational issues.

Title: Senior Analyst, Wealth Growth & Analytics
Description:
Role Summary

The Senior Analyst, Wealth Growth & Analytics is responsible for supporting BMO Wealth Management's growth objectives through data-driven insights, performance reporting, lead generation analytics, and business intelligence solutions. This role partners closely with Wealth business leaders, sales teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to monitor key performance indicators, identify growth opportunities, and deliver actionable recommendations that drive client acquisition, client engagement, and revenue growth.

The successful candidate will manage end-to-end analytics processes supporting Wealth lead generation programs, performance measurement frameworks, sales effectiveness reporting, and strategic business initiatives. Leveraging advanced analytical techniques and data visualization tools, the Senior Analyst will transform complex data into meaningful insights that enable informed business decisions and contribute to measurable business outcomes.

This role requires strong business acumen, analytical expertise, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Accountabilities

Wealth Performance Reporting & KPI Management


Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting solutions that monitor Wealth business performance across client acquisition, sales activity, referrals, lead conversion, client growth, and revenue outcomes.
Produce recurring executive and management reporting packages, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery.
Track and analyze key business performance indicators and emerging trends to identify opportunities and business risks.
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews through insightful performance commentary and recommendations.
Develop automated dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI and other visualization tools.



Lead Generation & Program Analytics


Support end-to-end analytics for Wealth lead generation and sales enablement programs.
Measure program effectiveness across key stages including targeting, lead generation, sales activity, conversion, and revenue outcomes.
Identify opportunities to improve lead quality, sales effectiveness, and business results.
Partner with business stakeholders to establish success metrics and measurement frameworks for growth initiatives.
Evaluate program performance and provide recommendations to optimize future business strategies.



Business Insights & Strategic Analytics


Analyze complex client, sales, and business performance data to identify actionable insights and growth opportunities.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support executive decision making and strategic planning initiatives.
Translate analytical findings into clear business recommendations and practical actions.
Support business case development, opportunity sizing, and performance forecasting activities.
Leverage multiple internal and external data sources to provide a holistic view of business performance and client behavior.



Stakeholder Partnership & Delivery Excellence


Collaborate with Wealth business partners, sales leaders, marketing teams, technology teams, and data partners to understand business needs and translate requirements into analytical solutions.
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders at varying levels of the organization.
Ensure reporting and analytics solutions align with business priorities and governance standards.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through process automation, enhanced reporting, and analytical innovation.



Data Management & Technical Development


Develop, maintain, and automate datasets and analytical processes using SAS, SQL, and Python.
Integrate data from multiple sources to support campaign and lead analytics.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities.
Support implementation of new data sources, reporting capabilities, and automation opportunities.
Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and operational standards.
Maintain documentation and support sustainable analytical processes.



Qualifications


4+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, performance reporting, sales analytics, financial services analytics, or related field.
Experience supporting business growth, sales performance, lead generation, or client analytics initiatives.
Proven ability to translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Experience building dashboards, reports, and visualizations that support executive decision making.
Experience working with Salesforce and lead management processes.
Strong understanding of campaign measurement, client targeting, audience segmentation, and performance optimization.
Familiarity with cloud-based data and analytics environments is an asset.
Strong communication, presentation, storytelling, and business writing capabilities is preferred.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.



Required

Technical Skills


Advanced SAS/SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Strong proficiency in Power BI, including dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience with Python for advanced analytics and data manipulation.
Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel skills.
Strong understanding of data structures, data quality, and reporting best practices.



Preferred


Experience working with Wealth Management, Banking, or Financial Services data.
Knowledge of Salesforce and sales pipeline reporting.
Experience with cloud-based analytics environments and modern data platforms.

Title: Workforce Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Workforce Intelligence Analyst – Markham, ON. - Full Time – ID# 7200

Are you ready to make an impact in the major Capital Projects Industry? Join PTAG, a leading Project Management Advisory & Services firm, recognized across North America for helping world-class clients deliver major capital projects successfully.

We are seeking a Workforce Intelligence Analyst to support our growing team in Markham, ON. In this role, you’ll play a key part in driving project excellence, collaborating with industry leaders, and ensuring high-quality outcomes across complex initiatives.

About PTAG

At PTAG, we help our clients plan, manage, and execute their most challenging projects with innovation, integrity, and collaboration.

Our mission is to help our clients achieve successful delivery and efficient operation of their capital projects.

Our vision is to support global leaders in the selection, planning, and execution of their major initiatives.

Our Values Include


Safety: The safety of our employees, suppliers, and clients is always the top priority.
Collaboration: We build true partnerships with clients and service providers.
Leadership: We elevate project performance through the application of best practices.
Accountability: We take responsibility for every aspect of our engagements.
Client Satisfaction: We strive for 100% satisfaction on every project.
Integrity: We believe in open and transparent communication at all levels.


Role & Responsibilities

The Workforce Intelligence Analyst reports directly to Senior Director, Workforce Development and works closely with Senior Advisors. The role combines workforce analytics, data management, business intelligence, and statistical analysis to identify workforce trends, skill and competency gaps, talent availability, capacity constraints, and future workforce requirements.


Design and build the initial data architecture for the labour intelligence data lake, structured around the KSBA framework (Knowledge, Skill, Behaviour, Attitude) and aligned to NCCER, CII, PMI, and AACE credentialing standards.
Build and maintain data pipelines that ingest, clean, and structure competency and availability data from disparate sources into a consistent, analysis-ready model.
Apply data science and statistical methods — forecasting, clustering, classification, and other predictive techniques.
Define and maintain data standards, taxonomies, and definitions across every source feeding the data lake, and document architecture and lineage clearly.
Embed data capture protocols directly into Pillar 1 advisory engagement templates so every demand profile, gap analysis, sourcing plan, and training outcome is captured systematically from the first client engagement onward.
Own data quality and completeness against the practice's KSBA-scored records targets.
Partner directly with Senior Advisors to ensure competency-level data is structured and captured correctly at the source, and translate analytical findings into plain-language input they can use with clients.
Work with Legal and the COO to implement the four-tier data classification.
Lay the data-architecture and analytics groundwork workforce intelligence dashboard.
Track and report data lake growth, quality, and coverage against the practice's milestone gates.
Train and support Senior Advisors and other internal users on how to query, interpret, and apply the data lake and any early dashboards or models


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Human Resources, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Minimum 8 years of experience in workforce analytics, people analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, labour-market intelligence, data science, or a related field.
Experience analyzing large and complex datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience working with workforce, project-resource, competency, or labour-market data is preferred.
Experience within engineering, construction, infrastructure, utilities, energy, manufacturing, or other project-based industries is considered an asset.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience with Python and/or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, automation, and predictive analytics.
Strong experience with Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and visualization platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Understanding of data modeling, relational databases, data warehouses, data lakes, ETL processes, and data integration principles.
Knowledge of descriptive statistics, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, classification, trend analysis, and predictive analytics.
Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, ERP, PMIS, workforce management, or related enterprise systems is an asset.


Core Competencies


Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to interpret complex information and identify meaningful workforce trends.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong business acumen and understanding of how workforce capacity affects organizational and project performance.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong commitment to confidentiality, responsible data use, and data governance.


Salary Range for Role $ 150 -$155 + bonus

Compensation at PTAG varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience.

Why Join PTAG?

At PTAG, you’ll be part of a dynamic, growing consulting firm that values professional development, collaboration, and innovation.

Opportunity to work on major infrastructure and capital projects.


Exposure to industry-leading clients and partners.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
Flexible work environment and opportunities for advancement.
Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP).
A culture that values safety, accountability, and excellence.


PTAG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Title: Inventory Analyst
Description:
Ontario Medical Supply is a Leading Distributor of medical equipment, supplies, and services for healthcare organizations and home healthcare clients across Ontario. Specializing in long term care, assisted living, retirement and home health care. Ontario Medical Supply is partnered for success with Royal Drugs. Royal Drugs is a healthcare company providing specialty pharmacy, infusion therapy, and retail pharmacy services. Together, we work towards supporting optimal health outcomes and better quality of life.




Come Join Our Team!




Purpose:

In this role the Inventory Analyst will be the analytical foundation for our inventory and planning operations. Your work will significantly influence strategic and operational decisions by transforming raw data into insights, actionable dashboards, and supply chain strategies. You will help improve service levels, optimize inventory management, and enhance ERP data integrity.




Position: Inventory Analyst

Location: Ontario Medical Supply. – Mississauga (2785 Skymark Ave, Mississauga, ON L4W 4Y3),

No. of Positions: 1

ATR:#5188

Type: Full Time, Permanent

Salary: $53,200-$60,000/year




This job posting is for an existing vacancy




Job Responsibilities:

Data Analytics & Insights

Perform in-depth analysis on inventory, purchasing, demand forecasts, and supply chain KPIs.
Identify patterns, risks, and opportunities to improve efficiency, service levels, and cost performance.
Develop simulation and what-if analysis for key planning scenarios.




Reporting & Dashboards

Design, automate, and maintain dashboards (using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar) for inventory performance, order fulfillment, supplier reliability, and system optimization metrics.
Prepare weekly and monthly reporting packs for leadership, identifying key variances and root causes.




Planning Support

Support demand and replenishment planning by providing accurate, data-backed inputs.
Collaborate with purchasing and warehouse teams to align stock levels with demand trends and customer requirements.
Assist in safety stock analysis, min/max planning, and ABC categorization.




ERP & Master Data Integrity

Assist in ensuring the ERP system reflects accurate lead times, order quantities, and item attributes.
Partner with the Inventory and Purchasing Manager to enhance master data quality and maintain accurate planning parameters.




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with warehouse, sales, finance, and customer service teams to align operations and mitigate supply chain risks.
Support ad hoc analysis requests from business stakeholders




Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business Analytics, or related field.
APICS/ASCM or other supply chain certification (CPIM, CSCP).
2–4 years of experience in supply chain analysis, inventory planning, or operations analytics.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, advanced formulas); experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
Experience working with ERP systems (preferably in the distribution or medical products sector).
Experience with SQL, Python, or other data tools.
Familiarity with demand planning, S&OP, or inventory optimization methodologies.




Skills:

Candidates must demonstrate strong communications skills (both verbally and written), organization, ability to --negotiate, good mathematical skills, sound judgment and initiative
Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and ability to turn data into decisions.
Must be a highly-motivated, self-driven person who can learn quickly and be comfortable in a fast-paced environment
Proficient in Microsoft Office Tools (excel, pivot tables, Power BI etc.) Use of SAP, WMS, Pronto etc.




Human Resources:

While we thank you for your interest, only select applicants will be contacted regarding the position.




Ontario Medical Supply is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer committed to providing diversity and accommodations for applicants upon request at any stage of the recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and the Ontario Human Rights Code. All applicants must make their requirements known when contacted.




The company reserves the right to close the competition based on business need and a sufficient pool of candidates who have applied.




AI will be used in the recruitment process.

  • University Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Business or other relevant fields
  • 1-2 years of experience in a similar role translating data into relevant and actionable business insights
  • The ability to define problems, collect and synthesize large amounts of data, form complex queries, establish facts and draw valid and actionable conclusions
  • Intermediate knowledge of SQL, BigQuery, Looker Studio
  • Basic knowledge of Python, R is an asset
  • Strong attention to detail and critical thinking skills to ensure data accuracy and quality
  • A curious mindset to continually explore new ideas and willingness to ask clarifying questions to navigate ambiguity, while being a strong self-starter
  • Strong communication, critical thinking and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to stay on top of a dynamic and fast-moving business

Title: Analyst, Walmart Services – Insights & Reporting (WFS)
Description:
Position Summary...The Analyst, Insights & Reporting will support the Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) Account Management team by generating data-driven insights and identifying opportunities the team can act on to grow seller adoption, performance, and program participation. This role will also partner closely with Campaigns & Events teams to ensure WFS-enrolled items are properly featured, in-stock, and positioned for success across all major campaigns and seasonal events throughout the year. The ideal candidate is analytically curious, comfortable working across dashboards and datasets, and confident using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, and reporting.

What You'll Do...


Generate actionable insights and opportunity recommendations for the WFS Account Management team, surfacing seller-level trends, program gaps, and growth levers they can act on directly.
Partner with Account Management to translate insights into prioritized outreach lists, program enrollment targets, and seller engagement strategies.
Collaborate with Campaigns & Events teams to plan ahead of the annual events calendar, ensuring WFS-enrolled items are adequately featured, represented, and inventory-ready for every major campaign and seasonal moment throughout the year.
Monitor business performance and key metrics across WFS programs, proactively flagging trends, anomalies, and risks to relevant stakeholders before they become issues.
Support ad-hoc analysis requests from Account Management and cross-functional partners, turning raw data into clear, actionable narratives and recommendations.
Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify emerging opportunities for WFS sellers and surface them to Account Management.
Assist in preparing business reviews and presentations that summarize performance, insights, and recommended next steps for leadership and stakeholders.
Partner across Account Management, Campaigns & Events, Strategic Account Management, and Product teams to make sure WFS priorities are represented in planning calendars and event roadmaps.
Leverage AI tools to support research, analysis, automation, and day-to-day productivity.


Qualifications


1-3 years of experience in account management, analytics, business operations, insights, or account/program support, preferably within retail, CPG, 3PL, logistics, e-commerce, or marketplace environments.
University degree, MBA Preferred
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
Hands-on experience building or maintaining dashboards in Looker, Tableau, and/or Power BI.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SQL, R, and/or Python is a plus.
Comfortable leveraging AI tools to support research, analysis, automation, and productivity.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to work cross-functionally with Account Management, Campaigns & Events, and other partner teams.
Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent insight requests and stay ahead of a fast-moving events and campaigns calendar.


Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

The pay range for this position is $64,700.00 - $88,990.00. Pay will be determined based on relevant experience.

Description:
Enercare Inc. is one of Canada’s largest home and commercial services companies servicing over one million customers across Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Alberta, British Columbia, Quebec and New Brunswick. Enercare is the Experts at Home, operating under several brands including Enercare, HydroSolution, and Pioneer Plumbing & Heating.

A proudly Canadian-owned company, we are the Experts at what we do and deeply care about our customers. We value a diverse, collaborative culture, and take pride in our commitment to health and safety, and knowing our work serves and supports our communities every day. No matter your role, we invest in making sure you have opportunities to grow, learn, and become the Expert you want to be.

If you are ready to become one of our Experts, we would love to hear from you.

Role: Business Analyst

Status: Regular, Full Time

Reports to: Senior Manager, Business Markets Strategy and Analytic

Department: Builder Division

Location: Markham

Compensation: $69,136 - $110,618

Please note that the compensation range listed includes base salary and potential incentive pay. Incentives such as bonuses are not guaranteed and depend on individual performance and company results. Actual compensation within the range will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

Summary

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Business & Data Analyst to join our team. This role is ideal for someone early in their analytics career who is eager to learn and contribute to data-driven decision-making, reporting, and process improvement initiatives. You will support senior analysts and business stakeholders by collecting, analyzing, and visualizing data to uncover insights and drive operational efficiency.

Responsibilities


Assist in gathering, validating, and organizing data from various sources including Azure SQL databases and Excel
Conduct basic data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in business operations
Ensure data accuracy and completeness in reports and dashboards
Develop and maintain SQL databases to supporting reporting requirements
Lead the development of dashboards and KPI scorecards using Power BI
Create visually engaging and user-friendly reports to communicate insights to business users
Help maintain and update existing reporting tools and templates
Assist in preparing financial and operational reports, including cost analysis and forecasting
Contribute to the development of simple financial models under guidance
Participate in evaluating business needs and identifying opportunities for data-driven improvements
Support preparation of month end deliverables to Finance and understanding the key business drivers to explain variances and anomalies
Document current workflows and identify inefficiencies through data and stakeholder input
Support small-scale process improvement initiatives and automation efforts
Apply design-thinking and user-focused approaches to improve data usability and accessibility
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Continuously develop skills in SQL, Power BI, and data modeling
Learn from senior team members and participate in training and mentorship opportunities


Qualifications


Post-secondary education in Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
3-5 years hands on experience using Microsoft Business Intelligence Stack with primary focus on Power BI
Working knowledge of SQL and experience working with databases, warehouses and data lakes in Azure SQL DB
Integration environment, incl. utilization in Logic Apps, Function Apps, Functions, and API Management.
Knowledge of DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) is a must.
Experience in modelling and data visualization; working with different data schemas and BI implementation methodologies.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, charts, graphs)
Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
Good communication and collaboration skills
Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
