Title: Senior Analyst
Description:
Agency

RAPP

Job Function

Data and Analytics

Job Subfunction

Data Science and Analytics

Job Description

WHO WE ARE:

We are TRACK – a member of the RAPP family– world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As a global, next-generation precision marketing agency we leverage data, creativity, technology, and empathy to foster client growth. We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.  

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

How We Do It

At TRACK, our fearless super connectors help to create value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning. 

Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients. 

Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets. The TRACK team makes up 100 of those.

Your Role

As a Senior Analyst, you will be responsible for contributing to campaign reporting and dashboarding projects that help our clients understand how their CRM marketing is performing and help them answer strategic questions about their customers using data.

The Analyst leverages data visualization, data manipulation and statistics knowledge to inform our CRM experience and testing strategy and evaluate impact of our marketing programs.

We seek an individual who is detailed and data driven – and who will continuously seek out new ways of working focusing on opportunities for automation and the use of AI.

We’re looking for a true teammate – someone willing to lend a hand, no matter the ask, so that we can all succeed together. We love crafting exciting, conceptual campaigns, but we are also passionate about bringing excellence to the day-to-day brand communications that our clients rely on. That’s how we make ourselves invaluable and earn their trust.

This role requires navigating fast-paced, client-focused environments with multiple deadlines and conflicting priorities.

Your Responsibilities


Contribute and/or lead client reporting and analysis projects
Create campaign labeling and tracking
Create timely and accurate reporting
Deliver insights that inform strategy and drive measurable outcomes.
Work closely with internal teams, clients, and partners to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
Analyze marketing and customer data to measure campaign performance, identify trends, and provide data-driven insights to optimize marketing strategies and improve ROI.
Build client-ready dashboards.
Manage your workload and identify risks.
Present complex analytical findings in a clear, engaging manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure high standards for data quality, integrity, and privacy across all client work.
Stay current on analytics tools, technologies (including AI) and industry trends; champion innovation and continuous improvement.


Required Skills


Undergraduate degree in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or related quantitative discipline
At least 3 years of analytics experience, preferably 1+ years with an Advertising, Marketing, Analytics, or Digital Media firm
Demonstrated experience with customer data, media & marketing measurement and CRM analytics. An understanding of core marketing analytics concepts including email, SMS and Web metrics.
Advanced Excel skills
Proficiency with analytics and data visualization tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, Power BI).
Advanced level SQL programming skills. Familiarity with Python.
Hands-on skills in statistical analysis and/or modeling (regression, segmentation, forecasting, etc.)
Extensive knowledge of database marketing principles and database structure
Presentation skills, data storytelling and the ability to simplify and package complex ideas for presentation and into client-ready documents.
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Natural curiosity and an aptitude for continuous learning.
Demonstrated ability to effectively maintain focus while working on multiple complex projects and to work with minimal supervision.


Our Perks


Generous PTO policy
Comprehensive health and dental plans
Paid personal and sick days
Birthday day off
Hybrid work model
Tuition reimbursement program
Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning
Telecoms monthly allowance
RRSP company match
Referral bonus


Our Hybrid Work Model

TRACK's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, with in-office attendance the rest of the week from our Toronto office.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy. The salary range for this role is $75,000-$85,000. Salary range 75,000-100,000

Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Link to Recruitment Privacy Notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-notice/

Title: Senior Analyst, Data Analytics & Automation Solutions
Description:
The successful candidate will leverage automation, AI and analytics to solve business problems for our Wealth stakeholders. Understands and articulates the business case of business questions and the estimated value being delivered. Designs analytics and automation solutions leveraging tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot, and AWS AI capabilities. Identifies trends and patterns to address identified business questions and provide insights through reporting and data visualization techniques. Works with other data and analytics professionals to optimize, refine, automate and scale analysis into repeatable analytics solutions and decision support tools.

Builds various reporting dashboards using the most appropriate data extraction, data cleaning and data visualisation techniques.

Provides value through insights, reporting and data visualization techniques. Selects, configures and implements analytics solutions for consistency and repeatability.

Researches and applies continuous improvement in data visualization by identifying trends and patterns to transform raw data into actionable business insights.

Works with different teams, management and stakeholders to enhance the usability and aesthetic appeal of data analytics solutions deployed in the organization.

Translates business needs to technical specifications and evaluates existing data visualization systems in order to improve them.

Develops data visualizations of "large" amounts of data that facilitate the intuitive presentation of data to decision makers.

Documents data flow, systems and processes to improve the design, implementation and management of business/group processes.

Develops tools and delivers training programs for use of reporting tools and self-serve analytics by non-analytical end users; may include delivery of training to audiences.

Focus is primarily on business/group within BMO; may have broader, enterprise-wide focus.

Exercises judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems within given rules.

Works independently on a range of complex tasks, which may include unique situations.

Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.

Foundational level of proficiency:
SAS
SQL.
PowerBI.
Copilot, Copilot Studio.
Github, Github Copilot.
Anaconda.
Python, PySpark.
AWS.
Power Automate, Power Apps.
Data visualization.
Data storytelling.
Data mining.
Creative thinking.
Problem Solving.
Intermediate level of proficiency:



Creativity.


Insights development and design.
Verbal & written communication skills.
Collaboration & team skills.
Analytical and problem solving skills.
Data driven decision making.
Typically between 4 - 6 years of relevant experience and post-secondary degree in related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience, however, strong new graduates with a post-graduate degree in with a math, physics, engineering or computer science degree will be considered.
Technical proficiency gained through education and/or business experience.

$55,500.00 - $120,000.00

Title: Analyste de données et de rapports
Description:
Entreprise: GCL

Service: Strategic Execution

Catégories d’emplois: Poste permanent à temps plein

Modèle de travail: Hybride (2 jours au bureau)

Langue: Le ou la titulaire de ce poste travaille en anglais.

L’opportunité :

Nous sommes une coopérative canadienne de services financiers de premier plan engagée à promouvoir activement une société durable et résiliente, et notre équipe est essentielle au succès de cette stratégie. C’est pourquoi nos gens sont notre priorité. Nous offrons une culture d’entreprise vivante et des occasions de perfectionnement qui permettent à notre équipe d’exploiter tout son potentiel et de concrétiser notre raison d’être. Et le meilleur : vous travaillerez avec des personnes qui se soucient vraiment de vous, de notre clientèle et de nos collectivités.

L’analyste de données et de rapports, vous jouerez un rôle clé en soutenant la prise de décision liée aux projets et aux portefeuilles, grâce au développement, à l'administration et à l'optimisation de solutions de gestion des données, de reporting et de portefeuilles de projets. Vous concevrez et développerez des modèles de données, des solutions de reporting et des tableaux de bord interactifs répondant efficacement aux besoins de l'entreprise, afin de fournir des informations pertinentes pour la planification et la gestion stratégique, financière et de portefeuille. Nous vous invitons à nous rejoindre pour contribuer à façonner l'avenir de la gestion de projets au sein de notre organisation !

Comment vous créez un impact :


Administrer et assurer la maintenance de la plateforme de gestion de portefeuille de projets (PPM Pro), notamment la configuration du système, la gestion des flux de travail des utilisateurs, l’intégration des rapports ainsi que le soutien continu aux utilisateurs et à la plateforme.
Concevoir et développer des modèles de données basés sur SQL, des solutions de production de rapports et des tableaux de bord interactifs Power BI afin de soutenir l’intelligence d’affaires, l’analyse des données et la prise de décisions éclairées.
Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes pour recueillir et documenter les exigences relatives aux données, aux tableaux de bord et aux rapports
Concevoir de manière autonome des solutions de rapports en mettant à profit les outils de l’entreprise (p. ex. MSTR, PowerBI) pour permettre une analyse et une communication narrative efficaces.
Procéder à des essais approfondis et à des pratiques de rapprochement sur les données et les indicateurs
Fournir un soutien à l’équipe d’analytique d’affaires pour la distribution en matière de communication des données et des rapports, y compris les essais et suggestions d’améliorations
Produire l’information et l’analytique pour soutenir les demandes opérationnelles ponctuelles.
Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes recommandées.
Capable d’effectuer de façon autonome des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques à l’aide des méthodes recommandées afin d’améliorer les flux d’information et la visibilité des données de projets. Possède une solide compréhension des cycles de vie des projets ainsi que de leurs impacts sur les activités, les ressources et les résultats organisationnels


Pour joindre notre équipe :


Vous possédez de 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en production de rapports de projet, en planification ou en gestion de portefeuille.
Vous avez une mentalité d’ingénieur et une passion pour l’analyse et l’assemblage d’informations complexes afin de fournir des analyses factuelles et fondées sur les données.
Vous avez de l’expérience avec les outils et langages d’analyse descriptive (MicroStrategy, PowerBI, Excel, SQL, SAS, Python, R, etc.).
Vous avez la capacité d'effectuer du codage ou de la programmation simple à des fins de rapports.
Une expérience de travail avec des outils de gestion et de planification de projets (p. ex., Planview, Clarity, Monday.com, Oracle, SAP, etc.) constitue un atout.
Vous avez fait des études postsecondaires en actuariat, en mathématiques, en statistique, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.
Vous possédez d’excellentes facultés de communication, de gestion du temps et de résolution de problèmes; attention aux détails.


Comment vous brillez :


Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.
Vous faites appel à votre esprit critique afin de cerner les problèmes et de proposer des solutions de façon proactive.
Vos solides compétences en communication vous permettent de transmettre clairement les messages.
Vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe et vous partagez vos connaissances afin de soutenir vos pairs.


Ce que vous devez savoir :


Si votre candidature est retenue, nous procéderons à la vérification de votre solvabilité et de vos antécédents judiciaires comme condition d’embauche.


Comment vous en bénéficiez :


Occasions de formation et de perfectionnement vous permettant de bâtir votre carrière.
Horaire de travail flexible et congés rémunérés pour subvenir à vos besoins et à ceux de votre famille.
Approche globale à l’égard de votre bien-être, programmes de santé physique et mentale et culture solidaire en milieu de travail.
Journées de bénévolat rémunérées pour redonner à votre collectivité.
En plus de nos salaires concurrentiels et de nos programmes incitatifs, les employées et employés admissibles bénéficient également d’un programme de rémunération globale complet, y compris des régimes d’épargne-retraite collectifs et une assurance collective (p. ex., assurance soins médicaux, mieux-être, soins dentaires, invalidité et vie), du soutien en santé mentale et un programme d’aide aux employés et employées.


Renseignements sur les salaires

Échelle salariale de 60,574 $ à 100,956 $

Le montant du salaire de la candidate ou du candidat retenu est déterminé par Co-operators, à sa discrétion, et varie en fonction de plusieurs critères, notamment : les conditions du marché local, la région géographique et les facteurs pertinents liés au poste, comme les connaissances, les compétences, les aptitudes, l’expérience et la formation.

Les employées et employés peuvent également avoir la possibilité de participer à des programmes incitatifs et de gagner une rémunération supplémentaire en fonction de leur rendement individuel ou de celui de l’entreprise, ou d’autres mesures commerciales.

Title: Business and Data Analyst
Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Business & Data Analyst to support the launch and growth of our consumer lending business in Canada.

This is a key role in building our data and analytics capabilities from the ground up. The successful candidate will initially play a hands-on role in establishing our data, BI and reporting foundation, and will progressively take on broader business analytics across customer acquisition, application and conversion, product performance, operations, customer lifecycle and overall business performance.

The ideal candidate combines a strong quantitative and analytical foundation, hands-on data capabilities, and strong business sense. You should be comfortable working directly with data, building dashboards and reporting solutions from scratch, identifying the drivers behind business performance, and translating analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.

Experience in consumer lending, fintech, banking or other credit-related businesses is highly preferred.




Key Responsibilities

1. Business Intelligence & Reporting

Build and develop the company's BI and reporting capabilities from the ground up.
Develop and maintain dashboards and recurring reports covering key business and operational metrics.
Establish and maintain a consistent KPI framework and business performance reporting structure.
Extract, consolidate and transform data from multiple sources to support business reporting.
Automate recurring reporting processes and continuously improve reporting efficiency and accuracy.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate them into practical data solutions.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency and reliability of key management reports and dashboards.

2. Data Management & Analytics

Use SQL and other analytical tools to extract, clean, transform and analyze data from multiple sources.
Build reliable datasets and analytical tables to support reporting and business analysis.
Conduct data quality checks and identify data gaps, inconsistencies and anomalies.
Develop a strong understanding of data structures, business definitions and relationships across key systems.
Work with Technology and other cross-functional teams to improve data availability, quality and usability.
Support the development of data processes and analytical infrastructure as the business grows.

3. Business Performance Analytics

Analyze end-to-end business performance across customer acquisition, applications, conversion, funding, repayment and operations.
Monitor key business metrics and identify trends, anomalies and opportunities.
Analyze acquisition channels and marketing campaigns to understand customer acquisition and conversion performance.
Analyze the application funnel and identify key customer drop-off points and conversion drivers.
Conduct cohort, segmentation and trend analysis to understand changes in business performance over time.
Analyze loan origination, loan volume, average loan size, revenue and other key business metrics.
Conduct root-cause analysis and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.

4. Product & Customer Analytics

Analyze customer behavior and performance across the customer journey, from acquisition and application through funding and repayment.
Analyze product performance, customer segments, conversion rates and customer behavior.
Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, application experience and product conversion.
Support Product and Business teams with data-driven analysis for new products, features, processes and initiatives.
Conduct customer segmentation, cohort analysis and other analytical exercises to identify customer trends and business opportunities.
Support A/B testing and other data-driven initiatives where appropriate.

5. Business Decision Support

Partner closely with Business, Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance and Technology teams to support data-driven decision making.
Translate complex data and analytical findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
Provide ad-hoc analysis to support strategic and operational business decisions.
Proactively identify emerging business trends, operational issues and opportunities through data analysis.
Prepare analytical materials and insights for management discussions and business reviews.
Go beyond reporting what happened to understand why it happened, what it means for the business, and what actions should be taken next.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or above in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or another quantitative discipline.
3–5 years of relevant experience in business analytics, data analytics, BI, product analytics, marketing analytics or a related analytical role.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to work with complex datasets and conduct structured analysis.
Strong hands-on experience with SQL and data extraction, transformation and analysis.
Experience building dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau or similar BI tools.
Strong Excel skills and experience with data manipulation and analysis.
Strong understanding of data cleaning, data transformation and data quality management.
Demonstrated ability to translate data into meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.
Strong business acumen, with the ability to understand the business context behind the numbers and identify the underlying drivers of business performance.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working independently and taking ownership in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience in consumer lending, fintech, banking or other credit-related businesses.
Experience analyzing lending or financial services data.
Experience with customer acquisition, marketing analytics, product analytics or application funnel analysis.
Experience with loan origination, customer lifecycle or repayment data.
Experience with Python, R, SAS or other analytical programming languages.
Experience with data modeling, ETL or modern data platforms.
Experience with A/B testing, cohort analysis or customer segmentation.
Experience building BI and analytics capabilities in a new or rapidly growing business.




What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is strong with numbers, comfortable with data, and genuinely interested in the business.

The ideal candidate is not simply a reporting analyst who tells us what happened. You should be able to look at the data and ask:

Why did application or conversion rates change?
Which acquisition channels are performing best, and why?
Where are customers dropping off in the application journey?
Which customer segments or products are performing differently?
What operational issues are affecting customer experience or business performance?
What opportunities can we identify from the data?
What should the business do differently based on the analysis?

You will have the opportunity to play a key role in building the data-driven foundation of a new Canadian consumer lending business from 0 to 1, while working closely with senior management and multiple business functions.

Title: Transformation Analyst
Description:
At Environmental 360 Solutions Ltd. (E360S), we don’t just manage waste - we redefine the industry. Fueled by an ambitious and innovative entrepreneurial vision and decades of leadership, we’re building a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable future. Our team is made up of driven professionals who thrive on challenge, embrace technology, and never stop learning. If you’re looking to do work that matters - where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your impact is real - you’ve come to the right place.




The Transformation Analyst provides the analytical backbone of the transformation program, delivering analytical support and dashboard development for both the broader business and the transformation initiatives themselves. This role builds interactive KPI dashboards that measure business and initiative performance, surfaces insights and flags that drive action, and applies AI and analytics tools to make reporting faster, sharper, and more predictive. The role works closely with the Transformation Finance Lead, IT, workstream leads, business stakeholders, and SMEs to ensure dashboards reflect accurate, well-governed data from approved data sources.




Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain interactive KPI dashboards tracking both business and transformation initiative performance (financial, operational, and milestone-based).
Partner with the Transformation Finance Lead, workstream leads, and business stakeholders to define KPIs, metrics, and underlying data sources across both the business and the transformation program.
Leverage AI and analytics tools to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks within business and program data.
Build automated flagging and alerting logic that highlights at-risk KPI and business metrics, along with a recommended call to action defined according to SME rules and logic.
Support data collection, cleansing, and integration across multiple source systems spanning business and transformation reporting needs.
Prepare analytical support and visuals for business stakeholders as well as SteerCo and Board reporting.
Prototype and pilot AI-enabled tools that support the Transformation Office's operations and broader business reporting (e.g., automated reporting, natural-language dashboard querying).
Partner with IT to ensure dashboards are built on approved, well-governed data sources.
Ensure data integrity, governance, and consistent metric definitions across all business and transformation dashboards.
Continuously refine dashboards and reporting based on stakeholder feedback and evolving business and program needs.




Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or BI development roles.
Proficiency with BI/dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and SQL.
Experience with AI/ML tools or LLM-based analytics solutions is a plus.
Prior experience in a transportation and / or environmental waste environment.
Experience building L1, L2, and L3 interactive dashboards for all levels of management and business functions




Key Skills & Competencies

Strong analytical rigor. Able to validate data quality and challenge inputs rather than building dashboards on unverified numbers.
Skilled at translating ambiguous or conflicting stakeholder requests into clear, well-defined KPIs and metric logic.
Working knowledge of AI/ML and automation tools, with the judgment to know where they add real value versus where they add complexity without benefit.
Ability to build flagging/alerting logic that produces genuinely actionable insights, not noise or false positives that erode stakeholder trust.
Strong data governance instincts, insisting on approved, well-documented data sources rather than convenient but unreliable ones.
Comfortable partnering with IT to resolve data access, integration, and quality issues
Ability to present data-driven insights persuasively to both business and transformation stakeholders, tailoring the message to the audience.
Adaptable and proactive. Able to iterate dashboards quickly based on feedback without losing consistency in underlying metric definitions.
Comfortable operating with incomplete or evolving requirements, typical of a fast-moving transformation environment.




This is more than a job - it’s your opportunity to be part of something bigger. At E360S, we’re setting new standards, transforming communities, and advancing the industry with every step forward. Bring your expertise, your curiosity, and your drive. Let’s build a sustainable future we can all be proud of. Apply today and discover what’s possible when purpose meets progress.

Title: Data & Reporting Analyst
Description:
Company: CGL

Department: Strategic Execution

Employment Type: Regular Full-Time

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in office)

Language: This role operates in English.

The Opportunity

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

As a Data & Reporting Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting project and portfolio decision-making through the development, administration, and optimization of data, reporting, and project portfolio management solutions. You will design and develop data models, reporting solutions, and interactive dashboards that effectively addresses business reporting needs to support delivering meaningful insights for strategic, financial and portfolio management and planning. We invite you to join us and help shape the future of project management within our organization!

How You Will Create Impact


Administer and maintain project portfolio management platform (PPM Pro), including system configuration, user workflow management, reporting integration, and ongoing system support.
Design and develop SQL-based data models, reporting solutions, and interactive Power BI dashboards to support business intelligence and decision-making.
Able to work closely with business and technology partners to gather and document requirements for Data, Dashboard, and reporting needs around the organization's projects and initiatives.
Autonomously manage and design reporting assets through enterprise tools (ie. Project Management tools, Excel and PowerBI) to enable easy and effective analysis and reports.
Produce data and analytics to support ad-hoc requests on strategic and operational projects and initiatives with expert knowledge to extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Able to autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods to improve information flows and views of project information with a solid understanding of project life cycles and impacts



To Join Our Team


You have 2-5 years of experience in a project reporting, planning or portfolio management.
You have an engineering mindset with a passion for puzzling information together to provide fact-based analysis.
You are an expert in Microsoft Tools (i.e. Excel and Powerpoint) and knowledgeable on analytics tools and languages (e.g. MicroStrategy, PowerBI, SQL, SAS, Python, R, etc).
You have the ability to do simple coding/programming for reporting.
Experience working with of project management and planning tools e.g. Planview, Clarity, Monday.com, Oracle, SAP etc.)is an asset.
You have a post-secondary education in Actuarial, Mathematics, Statistics, computer sciences or any other relevant field.
Strong communication, time management, problem solving and attention to detail skills.



How You Will Succeed


You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.
You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions.
Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.



What You Need To Know


You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.



What’s in it for you?


Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.



Salary information

Expected salary range $60,574 to $100,956

The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.

Employees may also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn additional compensation tied to individual and/or business performance, or other business metrics.

Permanent Full Time

The Senior Data Analyst leads analytical framing, experimentation, business analysis, value realization, stakeholder engagement, and solution delivery support for AI-enabled business initiatives, helping teams turn complex or ambiguous opportunities into practical, measurable outcomes.

Working closely with AI Enablement leads, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, business stakeholders, and technology teams, this role translates business opportunities into measurable AI use cases and guides the evaluation, implementation, and adoption of AI solutions through evidence-based analysis and recommendations.

The successful candidate combines strong analytical skills with business acumen, acts as a trusted analytics partner, and bridges technical and business stakeholders to help AI initiatives deliver practical, measurable value while supporting consistent and repeatable delivery practices.

Lead the translation of complex or ambiguous business opportunities into clear AI use cases, analytical questions, success measures, and measurable outcomes that can be tested and evaluated.

Required

5+ years of experience applying data, analytics, business analysis, or digital enablement practices to solve business problems and improve outcomes.

Experience designing or supporting experiments, pilots, performance measurement approaches, or value realization assessments.
Experience working with business stakeholders and technical partners to define requirements, interpret findings, and support implementation decisions.

Working knowledge of data platforms, programming, or cloud-based analytics environments such as Azure, Databricks, Python, or comparable tools.
Experience working in Agile or iterative delivery environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, collaboration, and subject-matter credibility rather than formal authority.
Experience providing guidance, peer support, or informal coaching to analysts or multidisciplinary partners.
Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and communication skills.
Ability to bridge technical and business audiences effectively.

Title: Senior Analyst - CX Automation Intelligence & Insights
Description:
This is a hybrid role to our Toronto HelloFresh Headquarters Office

Work with HelloFresh in Toronto and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Toronto office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

The role

As a Senior Data Analyst at HelloFresh, you will anchor the data strategy driving our aggressive, automation-first transformation. Our Global Customer Experience (GCX) team’s mission is to understand our customers’ journeys and empower market leads with insights and intelligent solutions that improve satisfaction, retention, and efficiency. We are moving fast to scale our self-serve rate, achieve 100% chatbot coverage, improve CSAT, and launch real-time, proactive incident communications via in-app CRM channels.

We need a strategic thought partner for our Product, Engineering, and CX Automation teams who brings a high bar of technical rigor. In this role, you will own our core automation analytics architecture (chatbots, voicebots, agent-assist AI, and customer self-reporting tools), dive deep into GenAI conversational landscapes, and translate complex log data into actionable roadmap strategies. If you love solving open-ended problems and want to directly shape the experience of millions of global customers, you might just be our missing ingredient.

What You’ll Do


Anchor the data strategy for our entire automation and chatbot analytics infrastructure, serving as the sole embedded analytics lead within the Global CX department.
Proactively monitor user intents and trends to diagnose system bugs early and establish standardized, organization-wide KPIs for bot containment and NLP accuracy.
Conduct deep-dive analyses of chat transcripts and user journeys, leveraging semantic clustering and LLM evaluation to uncover friction points and tune conversational flows.
Continuously optimize and secure our reporting environment, ensuring data integrity, normalization, and advanced visualization techniques for critical executive decision-making.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, and CX Automation) to translate complex customer log data and system requirements into sustainable roadmap strategies.
Own and deliver core business reporting mechanisms and dashboards, including the Monthly Business Review (MBR) and EBIT reviews.


What You’ll Bring


A passion for driving automation-first transformations and solving complex operational problems within a fast-paced customer experience environment.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL to handle increased domain complexity and secure our underlying reporting architecture.
Experience with next-gen agentic workflow stacks (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to optimize development and analytical speed.
Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining high-visibility BI solutions and dashboards that communicate trends clearly to Directors, VPs, and SVPs.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to lead complex data analytics projects and influence cross-functional partner


Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here


Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.
Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!
Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.
Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.
Growth & Development - We support your career progression, provide development opportunities, and invest in your continued learning through our organization wide L&D fund.
Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!
Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.
Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!


Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

#DATA

Working Conditions

It’s no surprise that as a food company, we use many ingredients that may be considered common allergens (i.e. peanuts, tree nuts, milk, etc.). Whether this role is based out of our headquarters or one of our distribution centers, it is possible that you may be exposed to such allergens in this role. If you have any concerns with being exposed to any particular food ingredients, including meat, please disclose this during the hiring process.

Interested in joining the HelloFresh team? Don’t be chai, apply! Submit your application in PDF format today.

Toronto, ON Pay Range

$85,000—$120,000 USD

Come Join Our Team!

In this role the Inventory Analyst will be the analytical foundation for our inventory and planning operations. You will help improve service levels, optimize inventory management, and enhance ERP data integrity.

Develop simulation and what-if analysis for key planning scenarios.




Reporting & Dashboards

2–4 years of experience in supply chain analysis, inventory planning, or operations analytics.

Experience working with ERP systems (preferably in the distribution or medical products sector).
Experience with SQL, Python, or other data tools.
Familiarity with demand planning, S&OP, or inventory optimization methodologies.

Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and ability to turn data into decisions.

At Fidelity Canada, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. Title: Senior Analyst, Operations
Description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

Provide forward-thinking analysis and direction to promote and instill consistently effective alignment and execution. Review CI operating results to identify key trends and variances and measure production results against budgets and forecasts.

Execute and deliver KPIs, and provide insights on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis to key stakeholders. Prepare timely and accurate divisional business performance reporting for both internal (Board of Directors, senior management) and external (investors, regulators, and auditors) stakeholders

What To Expect


Provide financial, portfolio, and market analysis using data mining and analytics to support Commercial business priorities.
Lead data acquisition and collaborate with internal and external partners to develop actionable business insights.
Deliver timely and relevant performance metrics to Commercial leadership while reducing duplication of reporting efforts.
Identify and implement improvements to data structures and automated reporting processes.
Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of Commercial Insurance initiatives, including KPI enhancements and process improvements.
Track initiative progress, manage risks and issues, and provide regular updates against key milestones.
Maintain governance and oversight of initiative tracking, communications, and escalation processes.
Partner with Finance, Actuarial, and Business Intelligence teams to support performance measurement, reporting, and compliance with governance and regulatory requirements.


What You Bring


University degree in Math/Statistics, Applied Science, Business, or a related program.
5+ years of Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance experience.
Analytical focus and a statistical background are considered assets.
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite is a must-have.
Advanced skills in Excel and PowerQuery, related work experience using Tableau for dashboard creation and trend identification, and prior work experience with GCP BigQuery.
Ability to use data to help inform decisions from the perspective of management and other internal stakeholders.


Salary Range: $59,300-$109,200

About Us

Actual salary for the role may vary depending on work location of the successful candidate and other factors including but not limited to, skills, education, experience, working conditions and the local labour market.

This position is being posted to fill an existing vacancy.

Interested in this role, but don’t meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply! We know from experience that a candidate doesn’t need 100% of the qualifications listed to bring incredible value to our team. We’re actively seeking diverse backgrounds and perspectives to help us make insurance better. At Definity, inclusion, diversity, and equity aren’t just “nice to have” — they’re essential to our success.

What’s in it for you?


Hybrid work schedule for most roles
Company share ownership program
Incentive Program - Eligible employees may participate in various incentive plans which are paid out at the discretion of the company and subject to individual and company performance.
Pension and savings programs, with company-matched RRSP contributions
Paid volunteer days and company matching on charitable donations
Educational resources, tuition assistance, and paid time off to study for exams
Focus on inclusion with employee groups, support for gender affirmation surgery, access to BIPOC counsellors, access to programs for working parents
Wellness and recognition programs
Discounts on products and services


Go ahead and expect a lot — you deserve it.

It’s better here — but don’t take our word for it. Definity was named by Great Place to Work® as one of the Best Workplaces™ in Canada for women, for youth, and for inclusion.

Our inclusive work environment welcomes diversity and supports accessibility. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know by contacting accessibility@economical.com.

As part of Definity’s commitment to reconciliation, we acknowledge that our work, meetings, and travel take place on the lands now known as Canada, and recognize the enduring presence, wisdom, and stewardship of the First Nations, Métis, and Inuit peoples who have long cared for these lands.

Background checks

This role requires successful clearance of background checks (including criminal checks and leadership references).

About The Team

Economical is part of Definity, which includes some of Canada’s most long-standing and innovative insurance brands, including Economical Insurance, Sonnet Insurance, Family Insurance Solutions, and Petline Insurance. Our ambition is to be one of Canada’s leading and most innovative property and casualty insurers. We can’t do that without our people, so we embrace and encourage a culture that’s collaborative, ambitious, rewarding, and empowering.

We offer a flexible, hybrid work experience where employees work from the office and virtually depending on the type of work they are doing and who they are working with. Bring your true self and be a part of our journey. It’s better here.

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

Description:
What We Offer

Branch and Unit

Operational Support / Education and Training Centre




Employment Type

This is a full-time, regular position.




Vacancies

Vacancies: 1

Tentative start date: November 2026




Civilian Posting

Reporting to the Staff Sergeant of the Education and Training Centre (ETC), this position is responsible for designing and conducting custom analyses, program evaluations, and research projects to support strategic decision-making across the DRPS. Key duties include planning and executing methodological research designs; performing literature reviews and environmental scans; developing measures; collecting data through surveys, interviews, and SQL-based extraction; and conducting statistical analyses.




The role also involves presenting findings through tables, visualizations, dashboards, reports, and presentations; formulating recommendations; and translating complex information for internal and external stakeholders. Additional responsibilities include managing and maintaining Learning Management System (LMS) databases, developing and monitoring performance indicators for strategic and training reporting, and disseminating results to executive leadership, committees, members, SOLGEN office and the Police Service Board.




DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Write briefing notes and reports that clearly communicate analysis to a police audience, supporting operational decision-making, resource deployment, and program development.

• Compile, prepare, and submit statistics and information for annual surveys and benchmarking

initiatives such and use of force reporting.

• Conduct custom research and environmental scans to inform operational training decisions, policy development, strategic planning initiatives, and emerging policing training issues.

• Prepare background studies and literature reviews on police training to support evidence-based

decision making.

• Formulate recommendations, present findings, and provide analytical insights to members across the organization.

• Maintain current knowledge of provincial and municipal/regional policies, legislation, and public-safety

initiatives affecting policing.

• Maintain expertise in external statistical data sources.

• Develop and maintain training dashboards and performance-measurement tools by creating KPI's, designing data collection methods, and producing clear visualizations.

• Manage limited organizational data systems and pipelines, including minor database development, supporting data integrity, designing governance protocols, documenting metadata, and resolving data quality issues with subject matter experts.

• Prepare reports for the Police Service Board and SOLGEN office.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with members of the Service, external stakeholders, and other police services.

• Evaluate training effectiveness while measuring the impact of training programs through assessments, feedback and performance metrics, and recommend improvements.

• Analyze incident reports and performance trends to identify emerging risks and recommend targeted training interventions.

• Analyze and compile ongoing statistical data on expiries for training course, ensuring compliance.

• Manage and maintain Learning Management System (LMS) databases to ensure accuracy.

• Other duties, projects, as assigned (individual or group responsibilities).




QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

• Completion of a university degree in a relevant program of study covering research methodology, reasoning and analytical skills, and the analysis and interpretation of policy, statistics and trends, such as Criminology, Social Sciences or Statistics, preferably at the Masters level.

• Minimum one year of experience conducting quantitative and qualitative research, including statistical and trend analysis, survey design and analysis, database management, and the preparation of research summaries, briefing notes, and reports for executive and operational audiences.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with demonstrated ability to analyze, interpret, and present data effectively.

• Demonstrated knowledge and application of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies.

• Proficiency in, and ability to adapt to, statistical and data analysis software such as SPSS, R, or similar analytical tools.

• Proven interpersonal skills and ability to interact diplomatically, tactfully and confidentially with

individuals at all levels of the organization, industry partners and vendors.

• Strong communication skills including verbal, written, listening and comprehension as well as proven ability to provide instruction through training.

• Ability to relay explanations of specialized matters (terminology or expressions) in non- technical

terms.

• Proven ability to analyze and problem-solve technical issues relating to systems, policies, practices and equipment.

• Strong time management, prioritization, multi-tasking and organizational skills.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively as a member of a team as well as the ability to work with a minimum of direct supervision.




Hours

Monday to Friday / Day Shift (may occasionally require flexibility in hours or overtime)




Salary Level

This is starting at Level 7 position $99,850 (2025-2029 Collective Agreement)




Selection

As part of the selection for this position, qualifications and skills listed in the posting will be assessed to measure the suitability of all applicants. Assessments may include, but not be limited to: resume review, skills assessment (s), interview(s), medical assessment, psychological assessment, functional abilities testing and/or background investigation.




Note: If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please advise the Human Resources contact on the posting. Appropriate assistance will be provided pursuant to the Service's Accessibility directive




How to Apply

For direct consideration, applicants must apply online by uploading a cover letter, resume, and certificate proving required education/training. Scan all required documents as one (1) pdf.file and upload when resume is requested.




Human Resources is unable to accept e-mail, FAX, or in-person applications.

Durham Regional Police is an equal opportunity employer.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected will be contacted.




Contact

Applications for the above position will be accepted until 1600 hours on the closing date of this posting. Questions may be directed to Jess McCabe at jmccabe@drps.ca

Description:

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Enterprise Intelligence (EI) team is involved in every aspect of data at EA, using it to deliver valuable insights and solutions for game teams and players. We drive strategy, build data and AI tools, and support personalization, experimentation, and analytics. Join D&I to work with experts dedicated to improving understanding, workflows, and player experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, and quality teams to enhance development quality, product stability and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Communicate with studio stakeholders to identify opportunities where data can better support decision making
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights


What You'll Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD

Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.

Title: ICQA Data Analyst
Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada's top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Solutions team. In this role, you'll help build integrated, reliable, and scalable data solutions that support business decision-making across the organization. Working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Greenhouse, and Dayforce, you'll collaborate with business and technology partners to analyze data, support system integrations, improve data quality, and contribute to impactful enterprise-wide data initiatives. If you're curious, analytical, and enjoy working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, this could be an exciting next step in your career. Our offices operate on a hybrid model with three days per week in-office to support team collaboration.

What You Will Do


Analyze and profile data across enterprise systems to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Support the design and development of scalable data models and data structures for reporting, analytics, and integrations.
Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to define and validate data transformation rules.
Test and validate REST APIs, integrations, and data flows between business applications and data platforms.
Perform data quality, reconciliation, and validation activities to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
Develop and execute test cases for data mappings, APIs, and end-to-end integration processes.
Document data models, mappings, integration requirements, and technical processes.
Participate in Agile delivery activities, including testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
Help identify opportunities to improve data usability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the organization.


What You Bring


3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business systems analysis, data integration, or a related technology role.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing relational data.
Experience working with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Dayforce, Greenhouse, or similar CRM, ATS, HRIS, or SaaS platforms.
Knowledge of relational data modelling concepts and data integration principles.
Experience working with and testing REST APIs, including JSON and API testing tools such as Postman.
Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document requirements, data mappings, testing activities, and technical processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and software development lifecycles.
Experience with Power BI or other reporting and analytics platforms.
Experience with Python or another scripting language.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern data technologies.
Experience working with HR, recruiting, CRM, finance, or other enterprise business data.
Financial services or other regulated industry experience.


The starting salary for this position is $110,000 - $130,000. The starting salary provided reflects the base salary for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation of this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

Title: Data Analyst II, Fraud
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind.

Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders

About the Role:

As a Data Analyst, Fraud, you will be part of Remitly's Identity & Trust Analytics Team. Your mission is to leverage analytical methods to identify, prevent, and mitigate fraud impacting our customers globally. You will develop a deep understanding of Remitly's fraud detection systems, regional risk profiles, and operational processes to improve fraud defenses while maintaining a seamless experience for legitimate customers. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business Management, and Compliance to customize and optimize fraud models and workflows, integrating data from legacy and new platforms. This hybrid role requires 2–3 days per week in the Vancouver office.

You Will:


Become an expert on Remitly's fraud data (e.g. chargebacks, promo abuse, scams, onboarding risk).
Build data-driven models and dashboards to analyze and monitor fraud exposure, balancing customer experience with operational efficiency.
Collect, normalize, and analyze data from legacy prebriefs, transaction logs, and onboarding systems to identify fraud trends and behavior anomalies.
Partner with Business Management and Product to continuously improve customer verification, KYC, KYB and compliance workflows.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure fraud control effectiveness and minimize false positives.
Develop and track risk metrics that quantify fraud exposure, policy compliance, and system performance.
Provide actionable insights and influence the development of fraud detection strategies, tools, and automation.


You Have:


3+ years in an analytics or fraud/risk analysis role within fintech, e-commerce, or digital payments.
Experience with fraud or trust analytics.
Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, economics, or another quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience).
Proficiency with SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large datasets (Python, R, or statistical modeling experience preferred).
Strong understanding of fraud taxonomies (chargebacks, identity theft, scams, onboarding risk, and promo abuse).
Demonstrated ability to distill business problems, develop hypotheses, perform analysis, and communicate clear recommendations.
Excellent data storytelling and communication skills; ability to translate complex findings into business decisions.


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125000. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits


Four weeks vacation
Health Benefits
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
RRSP plan with company match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Life Insurance & Disability
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.Under the Company's current hybrid-work expectations, employees in this position work onsite Tuesday through Thursday each week. Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs, and the Company may modify its hybrid-work expectations from time to time. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer
