Clarity is redefining how private companies and their shareholders access liquidity. Through its institutional-grade platform, Clarity brings together buyers, sellers, and issuers to facilitate secondary transactions in venture-backed, pre-IPO companies, introducing efficiency, transparency, and standardization to an otherwise opaque asset class.

Recognized as one of Canada's fastest-growing companies and backed by leading U.S. investors, Clarity is profitable, well-capitalized, and building a high-performance team to meet growing demand and pursue new market opportunities.

Interested in learning more about life at Clarity? Check out our careers page to see how you can grow with us!

Are you the kind of person who's always raising your hand for the toughest challenge? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments, learn quickly, and want to build a career where finance meets technology?

We're looking for exceptional new graduates and early career professionals to join Clarity a New Analyst. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career by working alongside experienced operators, supporting high-impact initiatives, and gaining exposure to multiple areas of our business. You'll tackle meaningful work from day one, take ownership of real projects, and develop the analytical, operational, and client-facing skills that define top performers in financial services.

The strongest candidates won't just execute — they'll ask great questions, solve problems, and continuously look for ways to improve how we work. You will gain exposure to many aspects of the private securities industry.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Include


Supporting live transactions and marketplace activity across Clarity's business.
Analyzing data, building reports, and generating insights that help drive business decisions.
Partnering with teams across Marketplace, Institutional Markets, Operations, and Client & Transaction Services to deliver exceptional client outcomes.
Maintaining accurate records and workflows using Salesforce and Clarity's internal systems.
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and help implement scalable solutions.
Working closely with experienced team members who will mentor and challenge you as you grow.
Taking on increasing ownership and responsibility as you demonstrate impact.


Required Skills


Recently completed (or are completing) an undergraduate degree in any discipline with an exceptional GPA (transcript required).
A proven track record of excellence, whether through academics, athletics, leadership, entrepreneurship, or extracurricular activities.
Internship, co-op, or work experience where you've demonstrated initiative, accountability, and strong execution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Excel.
Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools to solve complex problems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Curiosity, humility, and a desire to learn quickly in a high-performance environment.
Excited to work in person from Clarity's Vancouver headquarters.


Preferred Skills


Internship or coursework in finance, business, economics, engineering, or another quantitative field.
Experience using Salesforce or other CRM platforms.
Interest in private markets, venture capital, startups, or financial technology.

Title: Senior Research Analyst
Description:
Commercial Real Estate + Technology

Floorspace is a modern commercial real estate brokerage and technology company, building tools that make brokers faster, smarter, and more efficient. We pair a high-performing brokerage team with our proprietary platform, FLO, to redefine how deals get done.




We’re growing quickly—and we’re looking for a Senior Research Analyst who can level up our data, insights, and market intelligence.




About the Opportunity

As a Senior Research Analyst at Floorspace, you’ll be a core part of our research engine—responsible for leading our market data program, building high-quality insight products, and supporting brokers with the information they need to win business and advise clients.

This role goes beyond standard research: you’ll help shape how Floorspace collects, structures, and leverages data across Vancouver’s commercial real estate market. You’ll oversee data integrity across FLO, guide junior analysts, and collaborate closely with both our brokerage and product teams.




What You’ll Be Doing

Market Intelligence & Reporting

Lead quarterly and monthly market research for office, industrial, and retail sectors.
Produce data-driven reports, dashboards, and insights for clients, pitches, and internal visibility.
Monitor leasing activity, construction, subleases, and key market trends across Metro Vancouver.

Data Quality & System Ownership

Oversee and maintain the accuracy of core datasets within FLO (buildings, availabilities, leases, comps).
Establish and refine data standards for research across asset classes.
Improve research workflows and help drive automation and efficiency.

Business Development Support

Prepare insight packages for pitch decks and client proposals.
Identify opportunities in the market for tenant rep outreach, landlord listings, and strategic positioning.
Work closely with senior brokers to frame market narratives and support deal execution with data.

Leadership & Collaboration

Mentor and support junior analysts and interns.
Work cross-functionally with marketing to elevate our market storytelling.
Partner with our product and engineering teams to shape future FLO features that rely on research data.

Special Projects

Lead deep-dive studies (sublease trends, sector-specific analyses, demand patterns, etc.).
Contribute to new research formats such as our “Floorspace Five,” neighbourhood guides, and property analyses.




Who We’re Looking For

You’re not just comfortable with data-you know how to use it to tell a compelling story. You bring strong analytical grounding, an understanding of commercial real estate, and the ability to translate information into actionable insights.

You have:

3–5+ years of experience in commercial real estate research, valuation, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of CRE fundamentals—leasing, market dynamics, submarkets, and asset types.
Advanced proficiency in Excel.
Experience managing datasets and ensuring data integrity.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, especially in synthesizing complex information.
Interest in working closely with both brokerage and product/tech teams.
A proactive, organized, and detail-oriented working style.




Why Join Floorspace?

A tech-enabled brokerage model:

You’ll work within a company where research actually matters - our proprietary tech (FLO) relies heavily on your work and insight.

A collaborative, entrepreneurial team:

Work directly with brokers, marketing, product managers, analysts, and leadership. Ideas are encouraged, and execution is fast.

High-impact role:

Your work will shape our market presence, influence client strategy, and power our internal platform.




Working Conditions

Our head office is located in downtown Vancouver. The team is primarily office-based, with some flexibility for hybrid work.




Compensation

Salary range: $70,000–$90,000, depending on experience.

Includes a performance-based bonus program.




Make an Impact

If you’re energized by data, passionate about real estate, and eager to play a meaningful role in the growth of a modern brokerage, we’d love to hear from you.




Floorspace values diversity and is committed to Employment Equity. Direct applicants only-no agencies. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 

Learn more about us at www.floorspace.ca

Title: Coordinator, Quality Improvement & Analytics
Description:
Salary

The salary range for this position is CAD $38.88 - $55.89 / hour

Job Summary

Fraser Health is seeking a Full Time Quality Improvement and Analytics Coordinator to drive regional mobility, optimize multi-million dollar infrastructure, and pioneer sustainable transit solutions across British Columbia's premier healthcare networks. Use your education and business acumen in this vital operational role. Champion the day-to-day management of the Lower Mainland's consolidated parking portfolio, direct vendor contracts, optimize capital budgets, and lead facility design from blueprint to commissioning.

Detailed Overview

Supporting the Vision, Values, Purpose and Commitments of Fraser Health including service delivery that is centered around patients/clients/residents and families:

The Coordinator, Quality Improvement & Analytics, coordinates security incident reporting systems and data analytics programs for the Fraser Health Authority, Vancouver Coastal Health Authority, Provincial Health Services Authority and Providence Health Care (collectively, the "Organizations"). The Coordinator is responsible for the development, administration and management of the Business Intelligence tools and dashboards, IPS data warehouse and security incident reporting systems administration. Lead the design of methods and of tools in order to achieve consistent and reliable data collection. Responsible for the design and development of IPS data analytics reports for internal and external stakeholders. Leads the data quality control program, including the development of processes, end user education, and automated audits. Provides evidence to IPS senior leadership in support of both capital and operational budget requests. Leads the development and management of quality improvement and program evaluation initiatives within IPS.

Responsibilities


Leads and coordinates the collection, measurement and reporting of key performance indicators for the different IPS business streams. Collaborates with the IPS business streams to assess, plan and prepare statistical analysis for business cases and/or corporate service briefing notes. Coordinates and leads the development of site security statistical reports on quarterly bases, or as required, for dissemination to internal stakeholders.
Leads and coordinates quality assurance audits by reviewing audits for completeness, accuracy and integrity of security reports and aggregate data. Conducts regular audits to monitor business and operational processes and contract performance of contracted security provider. Analyses, compiles and reports on findings to IPS leadership teams, as required.
Responsible for providing data and security resourcing model design input for major projects across the Organizations.
Develops consolidated reports and dashboards (e.g. SSRS, SQL, etc.) that integrate information from a variety of Integrated Protection Services information systems. Summarizes information, provides trend analysis and prepares reports on summary of findings for various levels of stakeholder groups.
Leads and oversees the security incident reporting and data analytics systems. Ensures efficient and effective reporting of security data. Ensures the systems and reporting are in alignment with business processes.
Administers and manages the Business Intelligence tools and dashboards, IPS data warehouse, and security incident reporting systems by developing and designing methods and tools for consistent and reliable data collection. Manages the resources required to maintain those systems.
Reviews, develops and monitors contract and IPS operational staff training initiatives and curriculum for incident documentation. Actively monitors and evaluates staff performance to ensure adherence of data collection protocols. Recommends and implements appropriate staff training and/or orientation to ensure staff are knowledgeable and up to date with current IPS incident reporting process and procedures.
Provides expertise and advice in investigations involving staff related to matters of security or information technology. Plays a lead role in the application of security technology that may be required for sensitive investigations, including those with potential for employee disciplinary outcomes. Supports the development of action plans regarding issues including the investigation and determination of appropriate actions for the Organizations.
Participates in various meetings, committees and task forces to provide expertise and guidance on the reporting of violence prevention categories and other performance reporting related matters.
Leads and coordinates improvements to performance reporting through report automation, introduction of new tools and process improvement.
Leads and coordinates the implementation of quality improvement initiatives, including process mapping, review and testing of any system and application functionalities.
Collaborates with business units in identifying reporting needs, analyzing current procedures, reducing redundancies and ensuring reporting processes support business objectives. Develop statistical reports for various internal and designated external stakeholders to provide performance indicator data and related metrics for review and analysis.
Identifies and evaluates new initiatives, developments and trends in security and emergency management reporting through literature review, contact with peers at other organizations, industry advisory groups, professional associations and attendance at seminars, workshops and education programs. Communicates information and makes recommendations to appropriate IPS management designate. Facilitates the implementation of approved initiatives. Monitors initiatives and recommends and/or takes remedial action as directed.
Responsible for obtaining system and network accounts, and user access permissions for IPS systems.
Provides after hours on-call Manager function for IPS for the Organizations, as assigned.


Qualifications

Education and Experience

Bachelor degree in Criminology, Criminal Justice, Information Technology, or a related field, supplemented with five (5) to seven (7) years' recent related experience in security or crime incident reporting systems and/or business analytics, including experience with Healthcare Security Operations, in a large complex organization; or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

Designation as a Certified Health Care Protection Administrator (CHPA) would be an asset.

Competencies

Demonstrates the leadership practices of the Fraser Health Leadership Framework of Clear, Caring and Courageous and creates the conditions for people to succeed.

Professional/Technical Capabilities


Working knowledge of decision support solutions, information management, business processes, technologies and applications.
Ability to lead, plan, manage, organize, and problem solve.
Demonstrated ability to deal with others effectively.
Demonstrated ability to function effectively in a highly dynamic environment with changing priorities.
Working knowledge of LEAN and/or other related quality principles and their applications.
Ability to prioritize workload and meet deadlines.
Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as a member part of a team.
Ability to operate related equipment including applicable software applications.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.


About Fraser Health

Fraser Health is the heart of health care for over two million people in Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley in British Columbia, Canada, on the traditional, ancestral and unceded lands of the Coast Salish and Nlaka’pamux Nations and is home to 32 First Nations within the Fraser Salish region.

People - those we care for and those who care for them - are at the heart of everything we do. Our hospital and community-based services are delivered by a team of 50,000+ staff, medical staff and volunteers.

We are committed to planetary health and value diversity in the work force. We strive to maintain an environment of respect, caring and trust. Fraser Health’s hiring practices aspire to ensure all individuals are treated in an inclusive, equitable and culturally safe manner.

Together, we are the heart of health care.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
🎨 OpusClip is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 10 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more.

Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024.

Headquartered In Mountain View, We Are a Team Of 100 Passionate And Experienced AI Enthusiasts And Video Experts, Driven By Our Core Values


Be a Champion Team
Prioritize Ruthlessly
Ship fast, Quality Follows
Obsess over customers


Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

About The Role

OpusClip is looking for a product-oriented Data Scientist to help us build trusted metrics, improve data quality, and turn complex product and customer data into clear business decisions.

In this role, you will own critical definitions across feature adoption, weekly active usage, credit consumption, user segmentation, retention, and lifetime value. You will validate reporting data against its source, investigate data-quality issues, and lead analyses that help Product, Finance, and AI teams understand what is working, what is not, and where we should invest next.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable writing SQL, investigating unexpected data, defining metrics with stakeholders, and communicating a clear recommendation.

What You’ll Do

Strengthen data quality and metric governance


Validate reporting tables and dashboards against their source data.
Establish clear definitions, assumptions, sources, and owners for important metrics.
Develop monitoring for duplicate events, unexpected volume spikes, null values, stale data, and reporting discrepancies.
Investigate tracking and data-quality issues across product events and downstream reporting tables.
Help teams distinguish genuine changes in user behavior from instrumentation or pipeline problems.


Lead product and business analysis


Conduct post-launch analyses for major product features and workflows.
Analyze adoption, activation, funnels, retention, segmentation, and user behavior.
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical plans.
Turn findings into actionable recommendations for product and business stakeholders.
Support our data analyst with complex or high-priority analytical requests.


Support retention, LTV, and Finance analytics


Analyze subscriber retention, monetization, and customer lifetime value.
Compare user and revenue behavior across plans, segments, and payment platforms.
Partner with Finance to validate reporting logic and investigate discrepancies.
Communicate assumptions and data limitations clearly when working with financial and payment-related data.


Partner with our AI teams


Support data curation, measurement design, and evaluation for AI-powered product experiences.
Define offline and online success metrics for model-driven features.
Analyze model quality, user behavior, and post-launch business impact.
Partner on experimentation, segmentation, and ongoing performance monitoring.


What We’re Looking For


Typically 3+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, decision science, or a closely related field—or equivalent experience owning work at this level.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, event-level analysis, cohort analysis, and query debugging.
Strong Python skills for analysis, automation, validation, and statistical work.
Experience analyzing product usage, feature adoption, funnels, retention, segmentation, or monetization.
Experience defining and governing metrics, rather than only using existing definitions.
Strong data-validation instincts, including checking joins, duplication, nulls, freshness, source consistency, and tracking changes.
Experience working with event data from Mixpanel, or a similar product analytics platform.
Experience building or maintaining dashboards using tools such as Superset, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
Working knowledge of experimentation, statistical inference, and the limits of causal conclusions.
Strong ownership and the ability to make progress when requirements are ambiguous.
Clear communication skills and experience partnering with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Nice to Have


Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse.
Experience in a product-led SaaS, subscription, consumer software, creator-economy, or AI product company.

Title: Economics and Policy Analyst
Company: The Health Employers Association of BC (HEABC)
Description:
Are you looking to grow your career? Look no further than HEABC, the Health Employers Association of British Columbia. We contribute to the growth and sustainability of the BC health care system.

In office or hybrid work environment – flexibility that suits your needs.
Competitive salary.
Four weeks of vacation, earned in your first year of employment & 13 statutory holidays.
Comprehensive health & dental benefits, with immediate coverage upon starting.
Pension Plan - BC’s Municipal Pension Plan is one of the largest pension plans in Canada and provides secure retirement income to plan members.
Training and development opportunities – HEABC supports your continuing education & growth.
A work environment which values work-life balance, respect, recognition, teamwork, and inclusivity.
The opportunity to make a positive contribution to the BC health care system through your work.


HEABC leads and supports the strategic planning related to human resources and labour relations on behalf of British Columbia’s publicly funded health employers. HEABC is responsible for negotiating provincial agreements for 190,000 unionized health care employees including nurses, physician residents, ambulance paramedics, health science professionals, and more.

HEABC Medical Staff Services leads a coordinated approach to the negotiation of provincial and local medical staff agreements and provides expert advice to health system partners on their relationships with medical staff. Join our highly talented team in a culture of learning, innovation, and visionary thinking. Join our highly talented team in a culture of learning, innovation, and visionary thinking.

The successful candidate may be permitted to work in a hybrid model (combination of in-office and flexible work location) and will live within commuting distance of our Vancouver office.

For more information, visit www.heabc.bc.ca

Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Research and Analysis, the Economics and Policy Analyst (the Analyst) performs technical research work; carries out interpretive and analytical activities; engages in, and conducts complex costing work for, physician contract and Physician Main Agreement negotiations; provides economics assessments, evaluates and develops policy options related to the delivery of and compensation of physician services; prepares and presents reports, and provides advice to the Director to identify potential areas of research, objectives, methodologies and requirements.

This position requires initiative, creativity, critical thinking, attention to detail, quantitative skills, proficiency in analytical methods, and outstanding presentation and writing skills. In this role, you will partner with a wide range of system partners, including senior staff of the Ministry of Health, health authorities and other health system partners. The ideal candidate will have a passion for conducting research that supports evidence-based policy and the diplomacy to develop and maintain strong relationships.

Responsibilities Include


Fosters the development of partnerships between HEABC, health authorities, the Ministry of Health and other health system partners on projects related to the delivery of and compensation for medical services.
Co-develops materials (e.g. briefing notes and presentations) for and/or participates in the meeting program for the Provincial Medical Services Executive Council and other Ministry of Health/Health Authority committees where evidence and materials are required to support local or Provincial-level discussion, policy and decision-making.
Recommends the design of and carries out rigorous methodologies for literature reviews, environmental scans, quantitative and qualitative research.
Manages data collection and designs databases; works with very large data sets and multiple data sources – cleans, organizes, link, and structure data.
Develops, analyses, and interprets various statistical and economic data, research studies, wage and salary surveys, and policy options to support decision-makers with evidence-based, statistically supported, and methodologically consistent advice.
Prepares related presentations, data visualizations, studies, and/or reports that effectively communicate the results of research and analysis, to be used by HEABC and /or MOH.


Required Experience & Knowledge

A master’s degree in economics, statistics, mathematics, business, or a health or social science discipline and at least three (3) years of related research or policy experience, preferably in the health care sector;


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint;
Experience with electronic research databases and analytical software; with proficiency in one or more of the following analytical tools: SAS, R, STATA, Tableau, SQL, or related.
Outstanding interpersonal, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.


Salary Range: $90,770 to $119,135

Typical Hiring Range: $90,770 to $113,462

In determining salary, HEABC considers many factors including the successful candidate’s skillset and experience as well as internal equity. The final salary offer will be at HEABC’s sole discretion and presented as part of a competitive total compensation package.

How To Apply

If you’re looking for a fulfilling and challenging career within a dynamic organization, please submit a cover letter and resume outlining your experience at: https://healthemployersassociationofbc.bamboohr.com/jobs/

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Overview

Remarcable is purpose-built for trade contractors, helping them manage procurement, tools, and warehouse operations with unmatched visibility and control. As we scale across North America, data is at the core of how we deliver on that promise.

As our Data Scientist, you'll partner closely with Data Engineering to design and build out our data lakehouse, bringing data from across the business into one place to power in-platform and internal reporting, sharpen Remarcable's product intelligence, and surface the trends and next-step recommendations that help contractors and our own teams make better decisions.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who's comfortable wearing multiple hats (analyst, scientist, developer) to shape data architecture and build out reporting, models, and insights that drive action and decision-making.

What You’ll Do


Partner with Data Engineering to design the lakehouse's semantic and analytical layers (on top of AWS S3, Redshift, Athena, Glue)
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analyses, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholder
Analyze product, operations, and customer usage data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities that inform product and business decisions
Build models and heuristics that power Remarcable Intelligence (e.g. smart search, recommendation engine, forecasting)
Build out AI/ML data infrastructure - feature engineering, training datasets, and model evaluation - supporting SageMaker and Bedrock workflows
Develop and maintain core analytics supporting company metrics (ARR, churn, NRR, product usage, ROI)
Create customer-facing and internal reporting for customers and internal teams
Design and validate product experiments (A/B tests and other measurement methodologies) to drive data-informed decisions that improve user experience and business outcomes


Who You Are


3+ years of experience in a Data Scientist, Analytics, or similar role
Someone who thrives in a startup - adaptable, resourceful, and motivated by impact.
Strong SQL skills: complex queries, window functions, performance tuning
Proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy)
Experience building dashboards/reporting (e.g., QuickSight, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or custom-built reporting)
Experience with modern data transformation tools (e.g., dbt).
Experience building, validating, and deploying practical ML and heuristic models to solve business problems (e.g. recommendation, trend analysis, scoring).
Bonus: experience with AWS data/ML stack (Redshift, Athena, SageMaker, Bedrock), and/or building recommendation or "next best action" style features

Title: Quantitative Equity Analyst Process Engineering
Description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Equity Analyst to join our Quantitative Equity Team! We are a high-performance team embedded in a top-performing quantitative equity fund that manages over $78+ billion USD in financial assets. We are dedicated to the mission-critical operation of our investment engine—a well-tuned machine responsible for generating key decisions that drive trades and investment insights. Leveraging finance skills and cutting-edge technology, we ensure data quality, continuous process improvement, and operational excellence.

As a core member of our team, you'll collaborate with investment experts to tackle challenging analytical problems, be accountable to ensure accurate and timely trade generation, and drive operational innovation. Based in West Coast Vancouver, we value mentorship, collaboration, and growth in a supportive and innovative environment. Join us to make a significant impact on our investment engine and overall success.

What You Will Do

This is an exciting full-time role for individuals who are passionate about learning the quantitative equity investment management business and excited to tackle a broad range of investment, mathematical, and technology challenges.

You will start with a comprehensive training program, learning about various elements of quantitative equity investment management and our investment process.

You will then continue to a specialized role utilizing data science and process engineering skillsets to accelerate the Quantitative Equities Team’s various investment functions. Your specialized role may involve building, scaling, managing and/or analyzing our quantitative model, portfolios, data assets and optimizers.

You will be supported with coaching and mentorship from senior members of the team.

We are creating the conditions for you to grow your career steadily over time.

Investment Process Management

The team you will be joining is our Investment Process Management (IPM) group within our Quantitative Equities Team. IPM plays a central role in building highly scalable, efficient, and robust process management systems. The processes and infrastructure we maintain are critical in the team’s ability to develop systematic investment insights and generate daily trades to capture these insights in portfolios. The opportunity within the IPM group allows ambitious individuals to drive their career growth within IPM, or across the other functions of the Quantitative Equities Team in Research, Portfolio Construction, or Trading.

Skills

While we take the approach of tailoring the career path for the individual, we have found our functions to cover two main overarching technical skillsets:

Process and Reliability Engineering


Design, implement and test production processes to run the alpha and risk, portfolio optimization and market implementation processes.
Design robust, high performance and effective process orchestration.
Monitor production health and respond to critical issues in a timely manner.
Effectively communicate real-time production issues to portfolio managers, traders and researchers.
Identify computational bottle necks and improve run speeds in production systems.
Collaborate with investment teams to ensure their process needs are being met.
Find and evaluate areas for process improvements.
Assess and evaluate data quality of production processes.
Maintain process repos, clean code and tools within production processes.


Data Science


Construct and run algorithms to explore and assess data effectively.
Validate structured and unstructured data sets for data quality.
Design and test data loaders and security matching processes and specifications.
Perform data analysis and provide data expertise to support researcher’s projects.
Facilitate production machine learning operational pipelines with effective and timely auditing and analysis.
Enable accessibility and clarity within our data assets through robust documentation and data scrubbing.
Develop robust methodologies for assessing and analyzing data in time critical production environments.
Respond to and mitigate vendor data issues effectively in a production setting.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate traditional and alternative data into existing analytical frameworks and decision-making processes.
Present findings and recommendations to key stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.


What You Bring


Analytical Mindset – You think critically and creatively and are adept at balancing intuition with statistical validation.
Financial Knowledge – You possess a thorough understanding of (or strong desire to learn) key drivers of business success, including financial theory, economic models, and corporate financial statements.
Self-Starter – You are motivated and willing to take personal accountability for quality and timeliness of work.
Collaborative Approach – You thrive in a collaborative environment and value shared success. You proactively solicit and provide input and excel at communicating complex and technical concepts.
Time Management – You have the ability to manage and prioritize multiple ongoing projects and daily responsibilities.
Academic Training – At a minimum, an undergraduate degree in finance, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline. Completion of CFA or relevant graduate degree is considered an asset.
Industry Experience – You have a passion for quantitative finance, equity investment, data science or related fields.


We welcome applications from candidates with different levels of experience, including interns, new graduates, and experienced professionals. The base salary range for full-time roles is $125,000 – $200,000 annually plus a competitive performance bonus. Compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume, cover letter, and academic transcript.

Learn more by exploring our website: www.cclimq.com

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

AI may be used to support certain stages of our screening & recruitment process. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment and decision-making.

Title: 26-61 Senior Business Intelligence Analyst (10 months)
Description:
The Opportunity

Supports the Leader in the strategy and operation of Technical Safety BC’s business intelligence program supporting driving operational efficiencies and measurement of organizational strategy implementation. Provides an advanced level of expertise in business intelligence to develop and deliver data and information products for internal and external customers and stakeholders. Independently carries out complex needs assessment, identifies opportunities to optimize use of data and information extracted from internal and external sources, and determines optimal methods to deliver resulting products to meet business needs. Provides day-to-day technical guidance to the Business Intelligence Analyst.

Status: Casual, Full-Time, Union

Number of Positions: 1

Pay Grade: (Grade 18) $61.87/hr

Location: Vancouver or open to any of our BC regional offices

Reports to: Leader, Business Intelligence

As a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst, you will:


Applies an advanced level of expertise in the strategy and operation of Technical Safety BC’s business intelligence program. Provides input to development of corporate strategies to influence change through data, information and knowledge, and participates in implementation and delivery.
Identifies information needs, including situations where clients cannot clearly articulate the need, available solutions fall short, and data is of lower quality. Designs, develops, and delivers complex data and information products that are scalable and accessible to internal and external customers through standard or unique reports and self-serve methods.
Leads and participates in data initiatives that are strictly speaking outside of Business Intelligence, including data definition, data modelling, data quality, information management, and records management.
Applies an advanced level of expertise in experimental design, applying creativity and exploring innovative solutions to address client-specific needs. Tests information products, evaluates findings, and redesigns as necessary to deliver required outcomes. Educates end users at senior levels of the organization on the proper use of BI products.
Supports the Leader in developing a framework of processes, practices and standards to ensure all product development and information sharing is executed with cost-effective, timely, and operationally efficient results. Develops ethical standards on the use of information within the organization. Fosters transparency and ready-access to information, while also establishing the necessary controls to mitigate risks.
Collaborates with the Information Technology and Data Management departments in identifying optimal solutions and delivering information services throughout the organization. Negotiates solutions and scheduling with IT/DM departments while maintaining excellent relationships with the IT/DM departments.
Collaborates with leaders to assess and advise on business intelligence needs, and determines optimal methods and products to support achievement of business objectives. Manages internal expectations and takes action to find common ground for differing agendas and conflicting objectives. Assesses and prioritizes day-to-day requests, applying judgement in the context of organization-wide requirements.
Collaborates with the Leader in providing communication and advice that encourages client behavioural change through use of data and information products. Appropriately addresses use of data and information that does not meet BCSA security, privacy, or ethical standards, with escalation to Leader or Director as necessary.
Supports the Leader in development of reports, presentations and business cases in support of business intelligence program initiatives.
Proactively resolves complex program issues and challenges (e.g. Operations), referring only the unresolved, escalated situations to the Leader for direction.
Conducts research and continuously maintains knowledge and awareness of the business intelligence practices, methods and related industry trends.
Provides day-to-day technical guidance to the Business Intelligence Analyst.



Knowledge, Skills & Experience you have:

Education And Experience

The required knowledge and skills for the position would typically be acquired through a Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or other related discipline and 6 - 8 years of experience in business intelligence in a measurement-intense environment, including experience working within IT teams in the delivery of BI solutions.

Achievement of (or eligible for) a relevant professional designation is also required.

Knowledge And Skills


Advanced practical knowledge of business intelligence concepts and solutions, use of external data, publishing open data, client-specific offerings, report and self-serve methods
Advanced ability to understand and transform user information needs into visually well-designed business intelligence products
Advanced understanding and application of experimental design, combined with creativity and curiosity to explore innovative solutions (evidenced by portfolio)
Advanced and diverse experience in implementing, deploying, and operating BI technology stacks.
Solid business acumen and ethics to assess business intelligence requirements and priorities in the context of differing agendas or conflicting objectives
Advanced understanding of IT systems, databases, and data management including data quality
Advanced communication and interpersonal skills to engage in collaborative dialogue with internal and external customers/stakeholders, establish common ground, and influence change
Solid planning skills to support the Leader in day-to-day operation of the business intelligence program.
Advanced analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills to identify and take action to assess needs, address challenges, and manage change
Basic leadership skills to provide day-to-day technical guidance



Beyond the role:


Community & Wellness – We recognize and respect each other’s diverse needs. We strive to maintain a healthy culture of psychological safety, belonging, and space to prioritize healthy minds and well-being. This includes Wellness Wednesday (meeting free time), flexible paid holidays, a free subscription to the Calm app, and a flexible hybrid work environment focused on connections. Our teams also enjoy giving back to the community, and having fun, whether volunteering in the community, or running together on our Sun Run team. In 2023, Technical Safety BC donated to Crisis Centre BC, Aboriginal Coalition to End Homelessness, BC Wildfire Recovery, PADS, and Rise to Thrive Foundation.
Employee Resource Groups – We have Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) for Mental Health & Wellness, Indigenous Relations & Reconciliation, and Equity Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) to support initiatives we’re passionate about.
Learning & Development – We value giving and receiving feedback, as well as encouraging different ways for us to continuously learn as a company. This can be through lessons learned, wrap up sessions, one-on-one meetings, and team or individual courses, workshops, and conferences. In addition, we offer up to $1500 tuition aid per calendar year to support your education and learning goals.
Compensation & Benefits – In full transparency, you can find our industry-competitive compensation information on our postings. For our regular employees, we have outstanding benefits that include extended health, dental and disability coverage, access to an employee and family assistance program (EFAP), competitive annual paid vacation entitlements, public service defined benefit pension plan, generous top-up allowance for new parents, and time-off for caregiving, moving, and adoption leave. We recently upgraded our mental health benefits to $1500 separate from our non-mental health paramedical services too.



About Technical Safety BC

At Technical Safety BC, we matter to each other. Together, we apply a systems mindset to safety, embrace possibility, and act on what we learn. Our culture empowers and enables innovation and connection. Our environment welcomes diverse perspectives and learning is celebrated. We make decisions based on data and use our expertise to make the safety system equitable for all. 

Our values guide our work.


We see genius in diversity
We foster confidence
We make the complex simple
We adapt



Technical Safety BC is an independent, self-funded organization that oversees the safe installation and operation of technical systems and equipment across the province. In addition to issuing permits, licenses and certificates, we work with industry to reduce safety risks through assessment, education and outreach, enforcement, and research. Through simplification of our initiatives, we promote understanding and engagement, making safety accessible to everyone. As society changes, we create and adopt new ideas, skills, and tools that will enable us to meet the safety challenges of a highly-connected world.

We see genius in diversity and are committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workforce. We recognize that diverse life paths and experiences contribute to the overall qualifications for each role. If you feel that you could excel in this position, but do not necessarily meet the formal requirements, we encourage you to apply.

If you are interested in one of our career opportunities and require accommodation or assistance with the application or recruitment process, please contact us directly at careers@technicalsafetybc.ca.

If you are interested in this position, please apply online by 4:00pm PT on October 2nd, 2026. This opportunity will remain posted until filled; however, priority consideration will be given to those who apply by the deadline. To see a full list of our current opportunities or to learn more about working at Technical Safety BC, please visit our careers page.

Title: Senior Associate, Strategy & Operations - Integrity (International)
Description:
About the Team

The Integrity team is seeking a Strategy & Operations Senior Associate to help reduce fraud costs and drive solutions that safeguard the integrity of our platform. In this role, you'll develop a deep understanding of our three core audiences—Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants—and become a key resource for analyzing behaviors that may indicate risky or abusive patterns. You'll lead investigations into high-risk activity, design data-informed strategies, and implement cross-functional initiatives to mitigate losses while maintaining a seamless and trusted user experience. Most importantly, you'll help strike the right balance between user trust and risk management, ensuring we continue to support growth while protecting the platform.

About the Role

Job Purpose

The Quantitative Risk Analyst supports the design, development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of quantitative risk models that enable effective risk measurement, forecasting, and decision-making across Coast Capital. Working under the guidance of senior team members, this role performs detailed quantitative analyses and contributes to the development of analytical and numerical solutions that assess and monitor a variety of risk types, including credit risk, non-financial risk, stress testing, economic capital, and enterprise risk management. The incumbent leverages strong analytical, programming, and problem-solving skills to support model performance evaluation, risk oversight activities, and the delivery of reliable, well-documented risk models that support business objectives and regulatory requirements.

This role is hybrid remote, with occasional in-office attendance based on business needs. The role may be based out of our Surrey, BC or Toronto, ON office. The team currently meets in office approximately once per month.

Accountabilities


Assist senior team members in the design, development, implementation, validation, performance evaluation, maintenance, and risk oversight of quantitative risk models.
Support the development and maintenance of models related to stress testing, ICAAP, regulatory capital, IFRS 9, economic capital, and RAROC frameworks.
Perform detailed quantitative analyses using risk models and other analytical tools to support risk measurement, forecasting, and decision-making.
Evaluate model performance through monitoring, testing, benchmarking, and validation activities under the guidance of senior team members.
Prepare, maintain, and review model documentation, technical reports, governance materials, and communication packages.
Present findings, analysis, model performance results, and recommendations to team members and other stakeholders.
Develop, maintain, and enhance model source code and analytical tools used to support quantitative risk management activities.
Research and apply academic literature, industry trends, regulatory guidance, and quantitative modelling best practices.
Support data validation, data quality assessments, and model input reviews to ensure accuracy and integrity of modelling activities.
Collaborate with business partners and internal stakeholders to support risk management initiatives and analytical projects.



Skills & Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or another related quantitative discipline; alternatively, a diploma requiring 3–4 years of full-time study with relevant experience.
1–3 years of experience in quantitative analytics, model development, financial analysis, or a related analytical role.
Programming experience using Python or similar analytical tools.
Knowledge of statistical analysis, quantitative modelling techniques, and analytical problem-solving methodologies.
Experience supporting or operating quantitative models in areas such as credit risk (e.g. PD, LGD, EAD models), market risk, liquidity risk, stress testing, regulatory capital, IFRS 9, or economic capital is an asset.
Experience reading and interpreting financial statements is considered an asset.
Ability to communicate complex quantitative and technical concepts in a clear, concise, and effective manner.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and work effectively in a team environment.
Willingness to learn advanced quantitative modelling techniques, risk management frameworks, and industry best practices.
Strong organizational skills and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.

Come work as an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH) on the Richmond Community Administration team. Apply now to join the team!

As an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health you will:


Provide analytical support to the Program team for purposes such as data analysis, statistical reporting, benchmarking activities, developing and generating queries, preparing and compiling reports and technical documents utilizing various software and tools.
Provide confidential administrative and secretarial assistance and research support to the Director and to the IWMS team.
Maintain the Manager and management team’s appointment calendars, coordinate meetings, process and prioritize information, screen, triage and act upon requests and inquiries, including confidential and sensitive information.
Work independently and interface with other Executive Directors, Managers and staff at all levels of the organization.
Effectively partner with other VCH departments and liaises on behalf of the department with external agencies to coordinate the flow of information, keeping the Director apprised of relevant issues and activities.


This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

As per Ministry of Health policy, all health care workers working in publicly-funded health care facilities are required to report their past receipt of certain vaccines or history of certain infections. Collecting these records will allow for offering of any missing vaccines, and for appropriate actions to be taken in the event of any future exposure to a communicable disease or during outbreaks. For all new hires and appointments to Vancouver Coastal Health, you will be asked to provide this information as part of the onboarding process.

VCH is a world class innovator in medical care, research and teaching, delivering service to more than one million BC residents. Comprehensive health benefits package, including MSP, extended health and dental and municipal pension plan
Grow your career with employer-paid training and leadership development opportunities
Wellness supports, including counselling, critical incident and innovative wellness services are available to employees and their immediate families

Vancouver Coastal Health is proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, BC’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers and Canada's Top Employers for Young People in 2026.

Diploma in a related program plus three to four (3-4) years' recent, related experience in a complex health care environment with progressively more responsible secretarial and administrative positions supporting senior level management, experience in information analysis and benchmarking, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

Freybe Gourmet Foods is looking for a data-driven, commercially minded Category Manager to join our team on an 18-month contract.

Develop category strategies that support business objectives.



Support Retail Partners



Deliver category reviews, insights, and recommendations to retail customers.

Recommend assortment, promotion, and merchandising opportunities.



Turn Data Into Action



Manage and analyze syndicated, retailer, and internal sales data.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary

The Department of Psychiatry at the University of British Columbia invites applications for a full-time Research Computing Analyst with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning and scientific computing. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sophia Frangou, President’s Chair in Brain Health, and will receive detailed instructions on assignments. The successful candidate will carry out programming and technical tasks, troubleshoot computational problems, and contribute to the development and implementation of solutions under the guidance of senior members of the research team. Work will be reviewed for accuracy, completeness and timeliness.

The successful applicant will primarily contribute to the CentileBrain Project. This is a computational neuroimaging initiative focused on individual-level brain characterization. It combines large-scale imaging data, normative modelling, harmonization and machine learning. The platform generates individualized centile and deviation scores across the lifespan. The goal is to support precision neuroscience and clinically meaningful individual inference.

Organizational Status

The Department of Psychiatry at the University of British Columbia invites applications for a full-time Research Computing Analyst with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning and scientific computing. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sophia Frangou, President’s Chair in Brain Health, and will receive detailed instructions on assignments. The successful candidate will carry out programming and technical tasks, troubleshoot computational problems, and contribute to the development and implementation of solutions under the guidance of senior members of the research team. Work will be reviewed for accuracy, completeness and timeliness

Work Performed


Oversees the implementation of established machine-learning, artificial-intelligence and statistical methods in research datasets, modifies existing scripts as required using detailed specifications, and recommends computational workflow modifications to the PI.
Performs data preparation, quality control, feature extraction and other defined computational tasks for large-scale research studies.
Integrates multimodal datasets using established analytical procedures and modifies existing code as required to support data compatibility and processing.
Runs and maintains computational workflows on local and high-performance computing systems, including monitoring processing and addressing routine execution issues.
Resolve routine technical problems in code, data processing and computational workflows and escalate new issues for consultation with senior team members.
Provides first-level technical support to research team members using established computational workflows and systems.
Maintains clear documentation of code and script modifications, analytical procedures, software versions, testing results and computational outputs.


Consequence of Error/Judgement

The Principal Investigator will provide oversight for this position. Given the importance of the work to the research program, errors or poor judgment could substantially compromise research quality, delay project completion, and adversely affect future funding opportunities. Inaccurate or ineffective representation of the team’s work could also damage relationships with funding agencies and collaborators. The position therefore requires consistently high standards of accuracy, judgment, efficiency, and communication.

Supervision Received

The successful candidate will work within the broad direction established by the Principal Investigator and research team, with a high degree of independence and minimal supervision. The successful candidate will be expected to exercise sound judgment in carrying out defined responsibilities, collaborate effectively with team members, and proactively identify and bring emerging issues, risks, or unusual circumstances to the attention of the Principal Investigator.

Supervision Given

The successful candidate may assign tasks to students and provide oversight and review of their work.

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of one year of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.


Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications


An undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, statistics or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience with analyses of human neuroimaging MRI data
Strong programming skills
Demonstrated experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence or advanced statistical modelling.
Experience working with high-dimensional or complex biomedical, biological or scientific datasets.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Note: Candidates are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas. We are particularly interested in applicants who combine strong computational skills with the ability and interest to apply them to human neuroscience and biomedical research

Title: Sr Product Data Scientist
Description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Workday stands at a pivotal point in its evolution and growth. As we accelerate our Enterprise AI Transformation we must focus with equal intensity on scaling our execution to enable a rapid speed of continuous innovation for our customers. The Product & Technology (P&T) Operations Analytics & Tools Team develops decision-ready internal products that turn complex organizational data into targeted leadership action. Our vision is to: Power the strategic intelligence that scales how P&T operates with alignment and speed.

About The Role

We're looking for a business, product, and customer-oriented Senior Product Data Scientist to be the analytics partner for the Workday Data Cloud business. This role requires focused passion and excitement unlocking data insights that directly tie to strategic execution.

This role sits at the intersection of Workday's Data Cloud business, partnering directly with the Data Cloud organization (SVP/GM, Product Management, Engineering, and GTM teams) to bring analytical rigor and powerful business insights to a fast-growing, consumption-based product line. You will be the investigatory lead on a number of broad business questions. You will dive into the raw business data, find the root cause, and deliver an opinionated, decision-ready conclusion, not just more data.

You'll need to become a genuine subject-matter expert in Workday Data Cloud's business data landscape, working closely with the Workday Data Cloud GM and Product Management team. Your findings, and the curated data and documentation you produce along the way, should compound: feeding a shared knowledge base that makes the next question easier to answer, for you and for AI-assisted tooling built on top of the same body of work.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as the business analytics domain expert for Workday Data Cloud, providing technical and strategic thought leadership.
Partner cross-functionally across Go-To-Market (GTM) and Product teams to develop end-to-end views of the business, connecting the dots between top-of-funnel demand growth, sales pipeline, and downstream product usage.
Translate complex data models into compelling narratives and stories (including interactive visualizations and executive presentations) that drive organizational clarity.
Operate directly with SVP/GM-level stakeholders, translating a stream of layered, high-velocity questions into structured analysis without needing fully scoped requirements up front.
Translate ambiguous business, data, and platform questions into simple and focused conclusions, independently and with strategic judgment
Support consumption-based pricing and impact analysis for Workday Data Cloud, including sensitivity analysis, exploring new business models and driving business growth
Navigate real data-maturity and instrumentation gaps with autonomy: identifying what already exists, what must be built, and when to escalate.
Contribute well-documented, curated data assets and context back into the shared knowledge base so that analysis compounds over time and can eventually be self-served.
Design and influence Workday Data Cloud internal business data connections, collaborating with Product Management and engineering teams on the design, scalability, and sustainability of associated pipelines.
Leverage strong data ETL and data processing expertise to manage multi-step flows across product telemetry and observability systems
Demonstrate urgency and autonomy in problem-solving, proactively navigating cross-functional teams to identify and implement solutions for both known and emerging business challenges.


About You

You possess a deep interest in grasping the complex challenges that businesses face, and you are excited by solving problems. You have strong business acumen and are outcomes focused. Learning new tools and technologies motivates you. You embody the qualities of an insightful, thoughtful, and reliable teammate - and you expect the same of your teammates. You thrive in a fast-paced, tech start-up like environment where the best ideas win. “Think Like a Scientist” is ingrained in how you work - always hypothesizing, always experimenting, always learning.

You're energized, not intimidated, by building trust, process, and domain expertise in a new, growing business space. You default to curating and documenting what you learn, because you know the same data landscape will get harder questions tomorrow. You're comfortable moving between hands-on data work and strategic, executive-level framing.

Basic Qualifications


8+ years of experience with advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and/or data science
8+ years experience simplifying complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.
6-8 years experience working autonomously in a highly matrixed, collaborative corporate environment.
5+ years experience in business/product analytics, applied data science, or a related quantitative role, ideally supporting a product or platform organization.
5+ years experience in enterprise BI platforms (e.g.,Tableau, Sigma)


Other Qualifications:


Strong SQL and data-modeling skills; comfortable working directly in raw, partially documented, or partially instrumented datasets.
Familiarity with front-end components or frameworks (e.g., React, Node.js, JavaScript) to help collaborate with engineering peers.
Working familiarity with cloud data pipelines/ETL concepts (e.g., Airflow) sufficient to partner effectively with data engineering and platform product management teams.
Experience with SaaS pricing analytics or usage-based/consumption pricing models specifically.
Strong project management skills
Experience applying organizational change management principles
Experience working within an Agile/Scrum framework.
Experience within the SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology industries
Strong communication and data storytelling skills
Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise production-level data science-based products for business decision-making
Experience on AWS stack (Redshift, Sagemaker), scripting languages (Python and R)
Degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or a related field) or equivalent practical experience.
Understanding of product management fundamentals

The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Title: Senior Specialist, Product Management – Attributes & Insights
Description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Specialist, Product Management – Attributes & Insights

Our Purpose

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion (https://www.mastercard.us/en-us/vision/who-we-are/diversity-inclusion.html) for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

About The Team

Mastercard Identity, within the Security Solutions organization, leads the development of products and services that enable global commerce, powers financial inclusion, prevents crime and makes some of the most seamless experiences possible.

As part of Mastercard Identity, the Attributes & Insights team drives the development and management of products, programs, and services focused on deterministic attribute verification. The team delivers significant value across the ecosystem, helping to combat new fraud and address regulatory requirements. Our vision is to deliver a single, rail-agnostic platform and a real-time suite of solutions.

Job Description

Role Overview

The Senior Specialist will support Account Status Inquiry (ASI) as a data-driven product manager focused on understanding customer usage, evaluating product performance, and translating insights into product actions. This role will analyze ASI adoption across regions, customers, segments, and use cases to identify growth opportunities, product improvements, and customer value drivers. The specialist will partner with regional, sales, engineering, and customer success teams to strengthen ASI reporting, support adoption, develop product documentation, and contribute to data-backed business cases for future enhancements. This role will help improve visibility into ASI utilization, identify underpenetrated customer and regional opportunities, and support roadmap decisions that drive adoption, customer value, and product growth.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong product knowledge of Account Status Inquiry and the broader Attribute & Insights suite of products, including customer use cases, product rules, transaction flows, and value drivers

Analyze ASI usage, transaction trends, customer behavior, regional performance, and segment-level adoption to identify growth opportunities, product improvement areas, and customer value drivers

Build and maintain KPI reporting and performance summaries that clearly communicate ASI usage, adoption, revenue opportunities, customer impact, and product performance trends

Translate data insights into product requirements, enhancement recommendations, business cases, best-practice use cases, and customer-facing value narratives

Support customer, regional, partner, and internal product/sales inquiries by using product knowledge and data analysis to diagnose trends, answer questions, and recommend next steps

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support successful product launches, enhancement delivery, reporting improvements, and operational readiness

Create and maintain product documentation, best practices, sales materials, operational processes, and customer enablement content

Required Skills And Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have experience in product management, payments, financial services, analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience analyzing transaction-level, customer, and usage data to inform product strategy. The candidate should possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable product insights.

Experience analyzing transaction-level, customer, or usage data to identify trends, anomalies, growth opportunities, and product improvement areas

Proficiency with SQL, advanced Excel, and dashboarding or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms

Ability to define product KPIs, build performance reporting, and communicate insights that inform product decisions and stakeholder discussions

Familiarity with statistical analysis or data science techniques, including trend analysis, segmentation, hypothesis testing, and data-driven decision making

Product management mindset with the ability to connect customer needs, product capabilities, usage trends, and business outcomes

Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data and product topics for business and technical audiences

Knowledge of transaction processing, card-not-present payments, authorization flows, or network products is a plus

Work Conditions: Some travel required

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.



In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Pay Ranges

Toronto, Canada: $94,000 - $138,000 CAD

Vancouver, Canada: $94,000 - $138,000 CAD
