Company: Export Development Canada | Exportation et développement Canada
Description:
Date limite pour postuler : le 1er octobre, 2026 à 12h HE

Joignez-vous à l'équipe d'EDC !

À EDC, nous aidons les entreprises canadiennes à réussir à l'étranger. Nous leur offrons les outils financiers et l'expertise dont elles ont besoin pour explorer de nouveaux marchés et réduire les risques, dans un seul but : bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce.

Poste : Gestionnaire principal(e), Analyse de l'expérience client et du marché

Type d'emploi : Affectation permanente

Détails de la rémunération :


Expérience client 18 : Les salaires annuels varient généralement de 96 557 $ à 128 743 $, plus une rémunération au rendement, en fonction des qualifications et de l'expérience.


Lieu de travail:


Exportation et développement Canada applique un modèle de travail hybride selon lequel les employés sont tenus de travailler au bureau trois jours par semaine.
La personne choisie peut travailler à partir du siège social d'EDC à Ottawa ou à partir du Carrefour communautaire à Toronto, à Mississauga, à Montréal, à Brossard, à Laval, à Calgary, à Edmonton, à Halifax ou à Vancouver
Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats et candidates admissibles.


Candidats internes, veuillez consulter la page Service Now intitulée « Mouvements internes - ce que vous devez savoir ».

À propos d'EDC

À Exportation et développement Canada (EDC), nous aidons les entreprises canadiennes à réussir à l'étranger. En tant que société d'État à vocation financière, EDC propose des solutions financières innovantes et des conseils d'experts pour aider les entreprises à explorer de nouveaux marchés, à atténuer leurs risques et à se développer.

Pourquoi vous joindre à EDC?


Gamme complète d'avantages sociaux : EDC offre un régime de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux concurrentiel, une bonne conciliation travail-vie personnelle et la chance de contribuer à bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce
Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : EDC offre un régime concurrentiel en ce qui concerne la rémunération et la conciliation travail-vie personnelle : différentes options de travail hybride, trois à quatre semaines de vacances, une période de fermeture, des vendredis d'été raccourcis et les vendredis sans réunion
Perfectionnement professionnel : Profitez de nos occasions d'apprentissage continu, notamment des programmes de formation, des ateliers et de la formation linguistique
Culture inclusive : Intégrez un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif qui lutte pour l'équité en matière d'emploi et valorise la diversité des idées, des forces et des origines pour favoriser la réussite
Programmes de bien-être : Nous offrons des initiatives de bien-être, de l'aide à la santé mentale et des programmes de conditionnement physique pour veiller à votre santé et à votre bonheur
Investissement dans la collectivité : Participez à des activités de bénévolat et donnez au suivant grâce à un éventail de programmes de responsabilité sociale


Aperçu de l'équipe :

Le Centre d'excellence de l'expérience client d'EDC favorise la réussite des exportateurs en veillant à ce que les renseignements sur les clients et les marchés soient au cœur de la stratégie d'entreprise, de la conception des services et de l'amélioration continue. Le Centre rassemble la recherche, l'analyse et la conception de l'expérience afin de créer une approche décisionnelle disciplinée et axée sur le client pour l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Relevant de la ou du gestionnaire, Analyse de l'expérience client et du marché, la gestionnaire principale ou le gestionnaire principal, Analyse de l'expérience client et du marché occupera un rôle de collaborateur individuel principal qui viendra renforcer les capacités d'EDC en recherche quantitative relative aux clients et aux marchés. La personne choisie collaborera étroitement avec le gestionnaire, Analyse de l'expérience client et du marché et le premier conseiller, Analyse de l'expérience client et Stratégie d'expérience client pour veiller à ce que les données de recherche orientent les objectifs stratégiques, les décisions d'investissement et la création de valeur à l'échelle de la Société.

La personne choisie dirigera et soutiendra l'exécution de grandes initiatives de recherche quantitative en consultant la clientèle sur son expérience par de multiples moyens, comme des sondages phares, des programmes d'évaluation de l'expérience, des études de marché, l'établissement de schémas de parcours, des programmes de modélisation et des recherches en marketing. Le poste exige une solide expertise en méthodes de recherche quantitative, en conception d'instruments de recherche, en échantillonnage, en qualité des données, en analyse statistique, en techniques de modélisation et en mise en récit des constats. Dotée d'un bon esprit d'analyse et d'excellentes aptitudes en communication, la personne choisie s'appuiera sur des données primaires, secondaires et opérationnelles; des indicateurs de comportement; et des techniques avancées en analyse des données pour alimenter la stratégie d'EDC, les communications et le développement des programmes; répondre à des questions critiques sur les affaires; relever les moteurs de l'expérience client; et repérer des occasions d'améliorer l'expérience des exportateurs. Tout en développant efficacement des relations, elle devra comprendre les objectifs d'affaires, les traduire en hypothèses de recherche vérifiables et communiquer clairement les implications de l'analyse pour les parties prenantes et les décideurs des échelons supérieurs. Elle devra faire preuve d'une grande rigueur méthodologique, voir à l'intégrité des données, se soucier de la qualité et savoir collaborer avec d'autres fonctions.

Ce que vous ferez :

Stratégie de recherche et établissement de priorités


Façonner le programme de recherche quantitative et en établir les priorités en partenariat avec l'Équipe de l'expérience client, les Services économiques, l'Équipe de la stratégie, l'Équipe de gestion du portefeuille et d'autres équipes d'affaires, afin que les investissements cadrent avec les priorités de la Société et ses besoins en matière de prise de décision
Diriger l'évolution des cadres d'évaluation de la clientèle et du marché, notamment pour la vitalité de la marque, l'indice de confiance commerciale, le NPS et d'autres indicateurs fondés sur des sondages
Cibler les occasions de renforcer les portefeuilles de recherche, les méthodes d'évaluation et les capacités d'analyse en vue d'améliorer la pertinence pour la Société et l'incidence sur les activités
Élaborer des méthodes d'analyse de dimensionnement du marché, de la segmentation et des débouchés qui orientent la stratégie, les considérations économiques, la gouvernance du portefeuille et les décisions d'investissement


Conception et exécution de la recherche


Diriger la mise en œuvre de bout en bout d'initiatives de recherche quantitative complexes sur les clients et le marché dans plusieurs canaux, en veillant à ce que les questions de recherche, la conception, les échantillons, les instruments et les méthodes d'analyse soient adaptés aux besoins

  • Gamme complète d'avantages sociaux : EDC offre un régime de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux concurrentiel, une bonne conciliation travail-vie personnelle et la chance de contribuer à bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce
  • Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : EDC offre un régime concurrentiel en ce qui concerne la rémunération et la conciliation travail-vie personnelle : différentes options de travail hybride, trois à quatre semaines de vacances, une période de fermeture, des vendredis d'été raccourcis et les vendredis sans réunion

About EDC:

At Export Development Canada (EDC), we empower Canadian businesses to succeed globally. As a financial Crown corporation, we offer innovative financial solutions and expert insights to help businesses explore new markets, mitigate risks, and achieve growth.

Why Join EDC?


Comprehensive Benefits: EDC offers a competitive compensation & benefits package, work-life balance, & the opportunity to help make Canada and the world better through trade
Work-Life Balance: EDC offers a competitive compensation package & work-life balance. We have hybrid work options, 3 to 4 weeks paid vacation, a corporate closure period, summer early Friday's & no meeting Fridays

Inclusive Culture: Be part of a diverse and inclusive workplace that champions employment equity & values diversity of ideas, strengths, & backgrounds to succeed

Team Overview:

The Customer Experience Centre of Excellence (CX COE) at EDC advances exporter success by ensuring customer and market insight is foundational to enterprise strategy, service design, and continuous improvement. The CX COE integrates research, analytics, and experience design to create a disciplined, customer centred approach to decision making across the organization.

Reporting to the Manager, CX and Market Insights, the Sr. CX and Market Insights Manager is a senior individual contributor who strengthens EDC's quantitative customer and market research capabilities and partners closely with the Manager, CX and Market Insights and the CX Principal, Insights & Strategy to ensure insights inform strategic priorities, investment decisions, and value delivery across the organization.

The Sr. CX and Market Insights Manager will lead and support the delivery of key quantitative research initiatives across multiple customer experience touchpoints, including flagship surveys, customer measurement programs, market research studies, journey mapping, modeling programs and marketing research studies. The role requires deep expertise in quantitative research methods, research instrument design, sampling, data quality, statistical analysis, modeling techniques and insight storytelling. Defined as an exceptional analytical thinker and communicator, the successful candidate will leverage primary data, secondary data, behavioural indicators, operational data, and advanced analytical techniques to inform EDC strategy, influence communications, program development, answer critical business questions, identify drivers of customer experience, and surface opportunities to improve the exporter experience. Through effective relationship building, the role is expected to understand business goals, translate them into testable research hypotheses, and clearly communicate what the analysis means for senior stakeholders and decision makers. A strong drive for methodological rigor, data integrity, quality, and cross functional collaboration is essential.

What you will be doing:

Research Strategy & Prioritization


Shape and prioritize the quantitative research agenda in partnership with CX, Economics, Strategy, Portfolio, and other business teams, aligning investments with enterprise priorities and decision-making needs
Lead the evolution of customer and market measurement frameworks, including Brand Health, the Trade Confidence Index, NPS, and other survey-based metrics
Identify opportunities to strengthen research portfolios, measurement approaches, and analytical capabilities to improve enterprise relevance and business impact
Build market sizing, segmentation, and opportunity analyses that inform strategy, economics, portfolio governance, and investment decisions


Research Design & Execution


Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex quantitative customer and market research initiatives across multiple channels, ensuring research questions, designs, samples, instruments, and analytical methods are fit for purpose
Program, test, and deploy surveys using the Qualtrics Experience Management Platform, with rigorous quality assurance and adherence to research and data-quality standards
Develop analytical plans and apply advanced statistical techniques—including significance testing, correlation, regression, segmentation, factor analysis, predictive propensity modelling, integrated modelling, choice modelling, journey or pathway analysis, weighting, and driver analysis—to strengthen the credibility and usefulness of findings
Analyze quantitative survey data using SPSS and complementary tools to identify trends, segments, drivers, relationships, and opportunities aligned with business and marketing objectives
Optimize survey design, sampling approaches, metrics, analytical methods, and the integration of research and operational data to improve consistency, statistical validity, and insight quality
Provide methodological direction and quality oversight to external research suppliers, ensuring deliverables meet EDC's standards and business needs


Analysis, Insights Reporting & Storytelling


Integrate primary research with secondary research, operational data, and external market intelligence to create holistic views of customers, markets, and emerging opportunities
Interpret complex datasets, distinguish meaningful patterns from noise, and translate statistical findings into clear, decision-ready narratives and evidence-based recommendations
Analyze customer experiences across stages of the customer journey to answer critical business questions and identify opportunities for improvement
Develop and maintain Qualtrics dashboards and reporting outputs that enable ongoing monitoring, stakeholder consumption, and effective insight socialization
Communicate customer and market insights to business stakeholders and senior leadership through compelling reports, presentations, and storytelling tailored to the audience and decision context
Apply Generative AI and advanced analytical approaches to accelerate synthesis, pattern finding, and storytelling while ensuring responsible, ethical, and high-quality use


Insight Activation & Stakeholder Enablement


Build trusted partnerships with internal stakeholders to understand business objectives, translate them into testable research questions, and ensure outputs address decision-making needs
Influence enterprise decision-making by embedding customer and market insights into strategic planning, CX priorities, marketing decisions, program development, and corporate initiatives
Facilitate the interpretation and application of findings, helping stakeholders understand implications, trade-offs, and recommended actions
Share insights, best practices, and learnings across the organization to strengthen customer and market understanding and build research literacy


Research Practice Leadership & Governance


Establish and uphold research standards, governance, definitions, and best practices to ensure methodological rigour, consistency, comparability, and responsible use of data
Advance EDC's CX and market insights practice by introducing improved methods, tools, and ways of working and by monitoring developments in research and analytics
Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations, findings, and key stakeholder interactions clearly to support transparency, reuse, and continuous improvement
Provide expert guidance, coaching, and constructive methodological challenge to colleagues and partners, strengthening the quality of research delivered across the organization


What we are looking for:


Minimum seven (7) years of progressively responsible experience in quantitative customer insights, market research, CX research, marketing research, or a related insights function, including experience leading complex research initiatives
Postsecondary degree in market research, statistics, social sciences, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
Demonstrated experience designing and leading end-to-end quantitative research, including defining research questions, developing survey instruments, designing samples, assessing data quality, selecting appropriate analytical methods, and communicating methodological limitations
Advanced experience analyzing quantitative data using SPSS or comparable statistical software, including techniques such as significance testing, regression, segmentation, weighting, driver analysis, factor analysis, predictive modelling, or choice modelling
Demonstrated ability to integrate primary research with operational, behavioural, secondary, or market data to generate actionable customer and market insights
Experience developing, managing, or evolving customer, brand, market, or experience measurement frameworks, such as NPS, brand health, customer journey, or longitudinal tracking programs
Demonstrated ability to translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready insights and recommendations for senior leaders and non-technical audiences
Proficiency with survey and reporting platforms such as Qualtrics, including survey programming, testing, deployment, dashboard development, and ongoing reporting
Demonstrated commitment to research rigour, ethics, data integrity, and quality assurance


What will make you stand out:


Bilingualism in English and French
Experience developing market sizing, segmentation, opportunity analysis, predictive modelling, or choice-modelling studies
Experience establishing or advancing research standards, governance, documentation, and best practices
Experience providing methodological direction and quality oversight to external research suppliers or partners
Experience coaching colleagues, sharing research best practices, or strengthening research capability across an organization
Experience applying Generative AI or other emerging analytical tools responsibly, with appropriate attention to ethics, privacy, quality, and data integrity

Description:
About Us:

With over 60 years of industry experience, Gescan has 29 branches located across Western Canada. At Gescan, we leverage our strong global resource base, our local expertise, and our family-oriented values to deliver the best service to our customers and suppliers.

We are a proud member of the Sonepar Group, the world's largest privately-held electrical distributor. The Sonepar Group is present in more than 40 countries with over 45,000 employees. In Canada, we are represented by 6 locally managed electrical and industrial distributors and have over 110 locations with coverage in 9 provinces.

To explore and learn more about Sonepar opportunities, please visit www.career.sonepar.com




What’s In It For You?

You will be joining a market leader with over 40 years of experience to help you elevate your potential.
You will be working for the world's #1 privately held business to business distributor of electrical products and related solutions.
A chance to get involved in the forever growing electrical industry.
We house the largest inventory to better service our customers and deliver on sales commitments.
An opportunity for career development across many business departments within our organization.




Scope

Under the supervision of the Pricing Manager, the primary mandate of the Pricing Analyst is to analyze any trend, from products, categories, customers and suppliers. The analyst will be responsible for the creation, structure and management of the product database.




Responsibilities

Tool development
Develop dynamic pricing tools and models to effectively meet business needs.
Extract, process, and edit reports from Cognos and Power BI (Excel file, Access, pivot tables).
Perform complex analyses of our current pricing, product, vendor customer data using Excel, Power BI, Cognos, and our internal and external databases.
Analyze and interpret market trends in collaboration with internal teams for the purpose of developing competitive pricing strategies;
Analyze data from a variety of sources to better understand pricing strategies, better structure our customer types, and better aggregate our products and suppliers.
Prepare and present the results of the pricing and profitability analysis to management.
Keep abreast of different methods of price analysis, industry trends, and database management
Develop dynamic tools to improve database management.
Participate in the management of the information of the database and ensure the compliance of the information found therein and propose solutions.Team Support
Validate and approve pricing agreements on a daily basis to understand the pricing cycle and support the team as needed.
Assist the team in preparing for IT changes on products, categories, customers and suppliers.
All other related tasks.




Required

Bachelor's degree in administration or related field.
Excellent command of Microsoft Office suite tools (Excel, Access, Outlook, Teams).
Good knowledge of technological tools such as MS VBA/SQL, Python, Power BI, Power Apps.
Knowledge of Cognos (an asset). • A minimum of 1-3 years of experience in the field and/or related field.
Experience in interpretation, data analysis, database management, and dashboard creation.
Programming experience (basic).




Benefits & Perks

We offer a competitive salary, plus a full set of benefits.

Benefits program allowing you to choose from options that best fit you and your dependents’ needs. Benefit options include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Spending Account & RRSP matching.
Employee Assistance Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Discounts and a career path.
Regardless of your benefits program, you will receive company paid Life Insurance, and employee paid disability.

Solides connaissances de l’environnement numérique et marketing (e-commerce), avec une expérience des indicateurs et analyses liés au marketing, au e-commerce ou aux modèles d’abonnement

Solides compétences en matière de présentation et d’expression orale, avec une expérience des présentations devant la direction
Solide expérience des outils de visualisation tels que Power BI (y compris DAX), Tableau, etc.
Solides bases en manipulation de données à l’aide de SQL ainsi que d’Excel avancé (visualisation, tableaux croisés dynamiques, etc.) ; une expérience des macros et/ou de VBA constitue un atout certain
Expérience en analyse web avec des outils tels qu’Adobe Analytics ou Google Analytics
Une expérience en modélisation analytique et dans les langages de programmation associés (R, Python) est un atout

Position Overview

As a Marketing Insights Specialist, you will help connect the dots across various digital and non digital customer touch points at Autodesk that lead to key business outcomes. You will have the opportunity to directly influence Marketing and eComm growth and improve customer experience. This position is highly cross-functional and collaborative, working closely with global stakeholders as well as other teams outside of the immediate organization.

If you are searching for a challenging, yet highly rewarding role with great impact, then read on!

Responsibilities


Take ownership of a variety of Digital, Marketing and eCommerce related analytics projects to support global teams with data, dashboards and insights around standard Subscription customer life cycle elements including acquisition, retention and expansion
Work closely with business partners and team members to explore a variety of topics, such as market opportunity, industry/product journeys, digital contribution, purchase funnel and customer behavior analyses to extract valuable insights
Source, analyze and visualize data using tools to effectively mine and condense insights to tell a concise and actionable story and communicate findings that inform business decisions
Collaborate proactively and effectively with other Autodesk teams to align on metrics and definitions. Identify any gaps in measurements and/or metrics, define the additional reports and analyses required and streamline existing reporting
Encourage self-service and enable stakeholders to better understand data


Minimum Qualifications


3 + years of relevant experience.
Strong logical aptitude with the ability to present complex data as simple, concise, and engaging stories and visualizations that bring insights to the forefront.
Sixth sense for “meaningful data” with the ability to find creative, yet pragmatic solutions to data-oriented problems.
Self-starter, who takes initiative and demonstrated success in working with and influencing stakeholders, business partners cross-functionally.
Positive, can-do attitude – Ability to be flexible and open to changes in requirements, directions or circumstances with minimal need for reorientation


Preferred Qualifications


Solid knowledge of digital and marketing (eCommerce) environment with experience in related Marketing, eComm or Subscription model-based metrics and analytics
Ability to think strategically about real-world business problems in Marketing and co-relate them with underlying data to conduct deeper analyses and identify innovative solutions
Strong presentation and language skills with experience presenting to upper management
Strong experience in visualization tools such as Power BI (including DAX), Tableau etc.
Solid foundation in manipulating data using SQL as well as advanced Excel (visualization, pivot tables etc.), experience with macros and/or VBA is a definite plus
Experience in web analytics with tools such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics
Experience with analytical modelling and related programming languages (R, Python) a plus

Title: Business Analytics Specialist
Description:
Aviso:

At Aviso, we are dedicated to improving the financial well-being of Canadians. As a leading wealth management organization, we are committed to leadership, innovation, partnership, responsibility, and community. Working with talented and energetic professionals who exemplify our values every day, you will quickly notice that our people and dynamic ‘oneaviso' culture sets us apart. If you are looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, find out more about what Aviso has to offer at www.aviso.ca.

The Opportunity:

We're looking to fill an opening for a Business Analytics Specialist to join our Data Science and AI Enablement team.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Data Science and AI Enablement, you will be instrumental in supporting the business analytics functions at Aviso Wealth. Principle responsibilities include updating and distributing Business Analytics reporting and ad-hoc data mining for analysis.

As oneaviso:


We Care - You do the right thing for clients, partners and colleagues. You build trusted relationships, champion service excellence, and contribute to a culture where people feel valued and supported
We Dare -You challenge the status quo with bold ideas and fresh perspectives. You embrace change, seek opportunities to innovate and are comfortable exploring new ways of working
We Share - You collaborate openly and build meaningful relationships. You seek out diverse perspectives, share your knowledge and work together to help colleagues, clients and partners succeed
We Deliver - You take ownership of your work, honour your commitments and focus on delivering meaningful results. You hold yourself accountable and continuously look for ways to improve


What your day looks like:


Produce and distribute business reports for internal and external stakeholders, including ad‑hoc data mining across unstructured and disparate data sources.
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and documentation of all data, reports, assumptions, and methodologies.
Serve as the Asset Management data steward, working with NEI and other providers to validate and maintain high‑quality source data for the data warehouse.
Partner with third‑party data management teams on schema changes and new solutions, including reviewing business requirements, writing technical specifications, and completing system testing.
Influence cross‑functional teams to prioritize Asset Management needs on the data services roadmap, including enhancements to legacy tools.
Apply prescriptive and predictive analytics to strengthen reporting, surface insights to senior leaders, and translate recommendations into action.
Lead research and experimentation as a squad leader to advance DNA strategy within the AI product roadmap


Requirements

Your experience and skills:


Bachelor's degree in a relevant STEM or business field; 5+ years analytics experience in Business Analytics
Certifications in AI/ML or Data Engineering
Experience utilizing Databricks to enable scalable data solutions that support analytics, reporting, and business insights
Experience in federated analytics environments (preferred)
Skilled with SQL, modern BI tools and large, diverse datasets
Working knowledge of Confluence, Jira, and DevOps practices for tracking and documentation
Highly analytical, detail‑oriented, and strong problem solver
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder‑management skills with an ability to anticipate business needs and align analytics with strategic priorities
Clear communicator able to translate complex insights for non‑technical audiences
Canadian Securities Course is an asset
Fluent communication skills in English are required and bilingual skills in French are an asset


Benefits

At Aviso, you will find a dynamic and inclusive culture that rewards innovation and celebrates success.

Here are a few things that set us apart:


Competitive compensation package that rewards and recognizes individual contributions
Excellent health, dental and insurance benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees
Generous vacation time, fitness benefit, parental leave top-up options
Matching contributions to our retirement program
Commitment to the continuous improvement of our staff through learning & development and an education assistance program
Regular social events to foster teamwork


Your Information

By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your provided personal information for the purposes of assessing your qualifications and suitability for employment with Aviso. Your information will be handled in accordance with applicable Canadian privacy laws, including the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and relevant provincial legislation. Your data may be shared with authorized personnel involved in the recruitment process and retained only as long as necessary to fulfill these purposes or as required by law.

Further information is available on the Privacy link on our Career Page - Privacy Policies

Equal Employment Opportunity

Aviso welcomes and encourages applications from all qualified individuals including persons with disabilities. If you require an accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs in all stages of the hiring process.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

No recruiters or agencies, please.

Company Overview:

Aviso is a leading wealth management and investment services provider for the Canadian financial industry, with approximately $145 billion in total assets under administration and management, and over 1,000 employees. We're building a comprehensive, technology-enabled, client-centric wealth services ecosystem. Our clients include our partners, advisors, and investors. We're a trusted partner for nearly all credit unions across Canada, in addition to a wide range of portfolio managers, investment dealers, insurance and trust companies, and introducing brokers. Our partners depend on Aviso for specific solutions that give them a competitive edge in a rapidly evolving, highly competitive industry. Our investment dealer and mutual fund dealer and our insurance services support thousands of investment advisors. Our asset manager, NEI Investments, specializes in investing responsibly. Our online brokerage, Qtrade Direct Investing®, empowers self-directed investors, and our fully automated investing service, Qtrade Guided Portfolios®, serves investors who prefer a hands-off approach. Aviso Correspondent Partners provides custodial and carrying broker services to a wide range of firms. We have offices in Toronto, Vancouver, and Montreal. Aviso is backed by the collective strength of our owners: the credit union Centrals, Co-operators/CUMIS, and Desjardins. We're proud to power businesses that empower investors.

A career with Aviso means being part of a group of talented, energetic professionals who live their values every day, and belonging to an organization dedicated to your success and career development. If you're looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, apply to join our team.

Salary

This position is posted with an expected salary range of $83,000 - $100,000 CAD annually. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate and the requirements of the position.

Description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

Role Overview

The analyst develops reports, dashboards, and data-driven insights using tools such as SQL, Excel, and Power BI to monitor service delivery effectiveness, resource utilization, financial performance, and client engagement health. The role also supports business requirements gathering, testing, and validation activities related to ServiceNow enhancements and process improvements. This position is primarily execution-focused and works under the guidance of management to deliver actionable analysis and platform improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Managed Services Engagement Analytics


Collect financial and utilization data across various business platforms to aid in evaluation and optimization of managed services engagements.
Help identify trends, anomalies, and performance gaps impacting service delivery, profitability, and resource allocation.
Prepare recurring operational and financial performance reports for review by leadership.


Reporting Outputs


Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Power BI, Excel, SQL, and ServiceNow reporting tools.
Develop SQL queries and data extracts to support operational analysis and decision-making.
Validate data accuracy and investigate reporting discrepancies.
Assist in developing standardized reporting and KPI measurement frameworks.
Translate business questions into meaningful data analysis and reporting solutions.


ServiceNow Platform Support


Support administration and enhancement efforts within the ServiceNow platform.
Gather and document business requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
Collaborate with developers and administrators to clarify requirements and validate proposed solutions.
Assist in identifying opportunities for workflow optimization and process automation.
Maintain documentation related to system functionality, business processes, and enhancement requests.


ServiceNow Testing & Validation


Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans and test scripts.
Validate enhancements and defect resolutions against approved requirements.
Document and track testing results, issues, and defects.
Coordinate testing activities with stakeholders and development resources.
Support release validation and post-implementation reviews.


Required Qualifications


Experience supporting, administering, or working within ServiceNow or a similar enterprise workflow platform.
Working knowledge of ServiceNow processes, data structures, reporting capabilities, and platform configuration concepts.
Ability to gather requirements, document business needs, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience conducting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, and solution validation.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate information into meaningful reporting or operational insights.
Basic understanding of financial metrics including revenue, cost management, profitability, and resource planning.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with reporting or business intelligence tools such as SQL reports and PowerBi.
Demonstrated discretion and sound judgment when working with sensitive business, operational, or employee-related data.


Working Style and Success Factors


Collaborative and service-oriented, with the ability to build effective working relationships across business, technical, and leadership audiences.
Detail-oriented and quality-focused, with a strong commitment to accurate documentation, thorough testing, and reliable reporting.
Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities, timelines, and deliverables may shift based on business needs.
Curious and improvement-minded, with an interest in identifying opportunities to streamline processes, improve reporting, and enhance platform usability.
Accountable and proactive, with the ability to follow through on open items, communicate blockers, and support continuous improvement across platform operations.
Handle sensitive operational data with discretion, including charge hour tracking, service line metrics, employee platform usage, and information that may be associated with performance-related reporting.
Partner effectively with global team members, including offshore resources, to coordinate work, share knowledge, and support timely delivery across time zones.
Previous experience working in or with a professional services firm preferred.

Title: New Analyst Program
Description:
Clarity is redefining how private companies and their shareholders access liquidity. Through its institutional-grade platform, Clarity brings together buyers, sellers, and issuers to facilitate secondary transactions in venture-backed, pre-IPO companies, introducing efficiency, transparency, and standardization to an otherwise opaque asset class.

Recognized as one of Canada's fastest-growing companies and backed by leading U.S. investors, Clarity is profitable, well-capitalized, and building a high-performance team to meet growing demand and pursue new market opportunities.

Interested in learning more about life at Clarity? Check out our careers page to see how you can grow with us!

Are you the kind of person who's always raising your hand for the toughest challenge? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments, learn quickly, and want to build a career where finance meets technology?

We're looking for exceptional new graduates and early career professionals to join Clarity a New Analyst. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career by working alongside experienced operators, supporting high-impact initiatives, and gaining exposure to multiple areas of our business. You'll tackle meaningful work from day one, take ownership of real projects, and develop the analytical, operational, and client-facing skills that define top performers in financial services.

The strongest candidates won't just execute — they'll ask great questions, solve problems, and continuously look for ways to improve how we work. You will gain exposure to many aspects of the private securities industry.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Include


Supporting live transactions and marketplace activity across Clarity's business.
Analyzing data, building reports, and generating insights that help drive business decisions.
Partnering with teams across Marketplace, Institutional Markets, Operations, and Client & Transaction Services to deliver exceptional client outcomes.
Maintaining accurate records and workflows using Salesforce and Clarity's internal systems.
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and help implement scalable solutions.
Working closely with experienced team members who will mentor and challenge you as you grow.
Taking on increasing ownership and responsibility as you demonstrate impact.


Required Skills


Recently completed (or are completing) an undergraduate degree in any discipline with an exceptional GPA (transcript required).
A proven track record of excellence, whether through academics, athletics, leadership, entrepreneurship, or extracurricular activities.
Internship, co-op, or work experience where you've demonstrated initiative, accountability, and strong execution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Excel.
Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools to solve complex problems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Curiosity, humility, and a desire to learn quickly in a high-performance environment.
Excited to work in person from Clarity's Vancouver headquarters.


Preferred Skills


Internship or coursework in finance, business, economics, engineering, or another quantitative field.
Experience using Salesforce or other CRM platforms.
Interest in private markets, venture capital, startups, or financial technology.


Compensation: Highly competitive compensation commensurate with experience and contribution.


Vancouver, BC: $65,000-$85,000

Opportunity to participate in ownership of a rapidly growing company through our employee stock option plan.
Comprehensive 100% employer-paid health & dental premiums and a Health/Personal Spending Account for Canadian employees. (An employer-subsidized benefits program is available for US-based team members).

An engaging social calendar, including bi-weekly catered lunches, bi-weekly “Friday bar,” team workouts, annual summer party, and holiday party, two “onsite” all-team retreats each year, semi-annual team-building events, and Clarity Women’s Network events.
Significant opportunities for growth into team leadership and management roles.
Entrepreneurial culture and a small and dynamic team.
Sponsorship, immigration, and relocation for exceptional candidates.

Reporting to the Lead, Data Architecture and Business Intelligence, the Specialist, Data Integration is responsible for the planning, design, development and management of new and existing data warehouse and analytics solutions related to various PHSA programs and services. Applying a broad range of information technology experience, Data Warehousing (DW), Business Intelligence (BI), and clinical and operational knowledge, the Business Intelligence Specialist works with stakeholders to develop analytical products that meet their analytical, reporting, monitoring, surveillance and evaluation needs. This position plans, designs, and develops BI and analytical solutions, including data Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes, data marts, reports and dashboards as part of the overall PHSA Enterprise Data Warehouse. This position ensures the integrity and quality of the data accessible through these solutions, and also manages and maintains the metadata and other product documentations.

What You’ll Do


Architect and implement analytics solutions to develop, enhance and improve analytics and use of data at various PHSA programs and external stakeholders. This includes leading the design, development, documentation and implementation of complex data marts, multidimensional cubes or other semantic models, reports, dashboards and other front-end interfaces.
Architect and implement optimal database schemas and ETL solutions to integrate data from various source systems into integrated linked data marts. Collaborate with other members of the team on conceptual design, development, and implementation of the Enterprise Data Warehouse.
Lead the identification of new data sources and implements data extraction routines from departmental feeder systems. Provide advice and direction on data availability and quality. Consult and problem-solves with feeder departments regarding routine data extracts.
Participate in the development, definition and reporting of performance indicators as related to program operations, access and throughput, for use at the program director and executive level. Liaise on behalf of the agency with external consultants on the provisioning of patient specific data, as well as providing education on analysis and interpretation.
Provide technical expertise in the development of Analytics and Business Intelligence solutions by assessing client needs and requirements, reviewing technical options, determining the design and architecture and leading all levels of the solution development and deployment.
Ensure the designed solutions meet the established architectural, security, and quality standards set by the department by actively engaging peers and lead in design and review processes. Maintain current metadata, definitions and documentation of the solutions.
Maintain familiarity with the latest on-premises and cloud analytics technologies, and an awareness of current clinical and business information system trends and issues. Evaluate and recommend products or methods to deliver analytics and Business Intelligence in an accurate, timely and user friendly manner.
Mentor other developers and team members and provides technical and educational support to end users by developing training materials, delivering training sessions and training trainers.
Represent DARE on committees at various levels with regard to data standards, appropriate usage, availability and quality.


Qualifications

What you bring


A level of education, training, and experience equivalent to a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Health Information Science, Management Information Systems or a related field, plus 3 to 5 years of recent BI, data warehousing, data modelling or analytics experience. Strong understanding of health care system operations and public and population health concepts is definite asset.
Demonstrated knowledge of the historic and ongoing impacts of settler colonialism on Indigenous Peoples in social and health contexts, including supported by significant knowledge of Indigenous-specific mandates, including clear understanding of and commitment to eradicate Indigenous-specific racism and discrimination and embed Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility.
Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of the historic and ongoing impacts of settler colonialism and systemic racism on Indigenous Peoples within social and health contexts. This includes understanding how these factors contribute to current health disparities and barriers to care. Show a clear commitment to identifying, challenging, and eradicating Indigenous-specific racism and all forms of discrimination impacting equity-deserving groups within health care settings. This involves familiarity and understanding Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility recognizing personal biases, institutional barriers, engaging in anti-racism education and training and advocating for systemic change.
Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of legislative obligations and provincial commitments within Data Analytics contexts found in the foundational documents including Truth & Reconciliation Commission’s Calls to Action (2015), In Plain Sight (2020), BC's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (2019), United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP), Reclaiming Power and Place Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women & Girls Calls for Justice (2019), the Declaration Act Action Plan and Remembering Keegan: A First Nations Case Study - BC Human Rights Code, BC Anti-racism Act and how they intersect across the health care system.


Core Competencies


Brings an understanding of the Indigenous specific racism and the broader systemic racism that exists in the colonial health care structure, and has demonstrated initiatives in breaking down barriers and ensuring a safe environment ensuring a sense of belonging to all and informed by Indigenous Cultural Safety.
Awareness of social, economic, political and historical realities of settler colonialism on Indigenous Peoples and familiarity with addressing Indigenous-specific anti-racism, anti-racism and Indigenous Cultural Safety and foundational documents and legislative commitments (the Declaration Act, the Declaration Action Plan, TRC, IPS, Remembering Keegan, etc.).


Skills & Knowledge


Advanced knowledge, and experience in application of best practices of data standards, database design, data architecture and modelling. Expertise in developing ETL solutions, relational and multi-dimensional databases and data marts. Superior database querying, and query optimization skills using Structured Query Language -preferably T-SQL, MDX or DAX or equivalents. Knowledge of experience with BI and visualizations tools such as Microsoft Power BI, and Tableau, and collaboration solutions such as SharePoint. Proven hands-on experience with standard data warehousing and Business Intelligence tools such as Microsoft SQL Server, Integration Services (SSIS), Analysis Services (SSAS), Reporting Services (SSRS), and related development tools and version control tools, or comparable technologies from other vendors. Working knowledge of big data technologies, data science methods and languages such as (Python, R) and Windows and web application development tools and languages is an asset. High level of expertise in Microsoft Office suite of applications.
Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas in simple terminology with internal and external contacts. Demonstrated ability to analyze operational problems and recommend innovative solutions. Strong analytical, problem solving and system analysis skills including the ability to comprehend complex large scale health care environment operational issues and related data/information and present information in concise meaningful ways. Customer focused with ability to facilitate and encourage cooperation between professionals from other disciplines. Ability to understand management reporting and statistical concepts. Ability to educate and lead management staff on the importance of using high quality data for decision making, via business intelligence tools and other means. Self-directed and motivated to learn new tools and technology. Ability to work independently with little direct supervision and as a member of a multi-disciplinary team. Excellent time management skills with the ability to organize and prioritize work. Physical ability to perform the duties of the job. Persistence and a positive attitude are essential given the iterative development cycle and sometimes problematic data integration issues.
Demonstrates a commitment to beginning and/or continuing their personal learning journey related to Indigenous-specific racism and dismantling systems of oppression, as well as addressing racism more broadly. Shows willingness to articulate and share their learning experiences to contribute to a culture of motivation and inspiration among peers.
Demonstrates foundational knowledge of the social, economic, and political realities of settler-colonialism and its impacts on Indigenous peoples and equity-deserving groups within social and health contexts. Understands the impact of social determinants of health-on-health outcomes. Shows a commitment to learning about and upholding legislative obligations and provincial commitments outlined in foundational documents such as the Truth & Reconciliation Commission’s Calls to Action (2015), In Plain Sight (2020), BC's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (2019), United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP), Reclaiming Power and Place: Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women & Girls Calls for Justice (2019), the Declaration Act Action Plan, Remembering Keegan: A First Nations Case Study, the BC Human Rights Code, Anti-Racism Data Act, and the Distinctions Based Approach.


What We Bring

Every PHSA employee enables the best possible patient care for our patients and their families. Whether you are providing direct care, conducting research, or making it possible for others to do their work, you impact the lives of British Columbians today and in the future. That’s why we’re focused on your care too – offering health, wellness, development programs to support you – at work and at home.


Join one of BC’s largest employers with province-wide programs, services and operations – offering vast opportunities for growth, development, and recognition programs that honour the commitment and contribution of all employees.
Access to professional development opportunities through our in-house training programs, including +2,000 courses, such as our San’yas Indigenous Cultural Safety Training course, or Core Linx for Leadership roles.
Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including municipal pension plan, and psychological health & safety programs and holistic wellness resources.
Annual statutory holidays (13) with generous vacation entitlement and accruement.
PHSA is a remote work friendly employer, welcoming flexible work options to support our people (eligibility may vary, depending on position).
Access to WorkPerks, a premium discount program offering a wide range of local and national discounts on electronics, entertainment, dining, travel, wellness, apparel, and more.

Title: Senior Research Analyst
Description:
Commercial Real Estate + Technology

Floorspace is a modern commercial real estate brokerage and technology company, building tools that make brokers faster, smarter, and more efficient. We pair a high-performing brokerage team with our proprietary platform, FLO, to redefine how deals get done.




We’re growing quickly—and we’re looking for a Senior Research Analyst who can level up our data, insights, and market intelligence.




About the Opportunity

As a Senior Research Analyst at Floorspace, you’ll be a core part of our research engine—responsible for leading our market data program, building high-quality insight products, and supporting brokers with the information they need to win business and advise clients.

This role goes beyond standard research: you’ll help shape how Floorspace collects, structures, and leverages data across Vancouver’s commercial real estate market. You’ll oversee data integrity across FLO, guide junior analysts, and collaborate closely with both our brokerage and product teams.




What You’ll Be Doing

Market Intelligence & Reporting

Lead quarterly and monthly market research for office, industrial, and retail sectors.
Produce data-driven reports, dashboards, and insights for clients, pitches, and internal visibility.
Monitor leasing activity, construction, subleases, and key market trends across Metro Vancouver.

Data Quality & System Ownership

Oversee and maintain the accuracy of core datasets within FLO (buildings, availabilities, leases, comps).
Establish and refine data standards for research across asset classes.
Improve research workflows and help drive automation and efficiency.

Business Development Support

Prepare insight packages for pitch decks and client proposals.
Identify opportunities in the market for tenant rep outreach, landlord listings, and strategic positioning.
Work closely with senior brokers to frame market narratives and support deal execution with data.

Leadership & Collaboration

Mentor and support junior analysts and interns.
Work cross-functionally with marketing to elevate our market storytelling.
Partner with our product and engineering teams to shape future FLO features that rely on research data.

Special Projects

Lead deep-dive studies (sublease trends, sector-specific analyses, demand patterns, etc.).
Contribute to new research formats such as our “Floorspace Five,” neighbourhood guides, and property analyses.




Who We’re Looking For

You’re not just comfortable with data-you know how to use it to tell a compelling story. You bring strong analytical grounding, an understanding of commercial real estate, and the ability to translate information into actionable insights.

You have:

3–5+ years of experience in commercial real estate research, valuation, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of CRE fundamentals—leasing, market dynamics, submarkets, and asset types.
Advanced proficiency in Excel.
Experience managing datasets and ensuring data integrity.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, especially in synthesizing complex information.
Interest in working closely with both brokerage and product/tech teams.
A proactive, organized, and detail-oriented working style.




Why Join Floorspace?

A tech-enabled brokerage model:

You’ll work within a company where research actually matters - our proprietary tech (FLO) relies heavily on your work and insight.

A collaborative, entrepreneurial team:

Work directly with brokers, marketing, product managers, analysts, and leadership. Ideas are encouraged, and execution is fast.

High-impact role:

Your work will shape our market presence, influence client strategy, and power our internal platform.




Working Conditions

Our head office is located in downtown Vancouver. The team is primarily office-based, with some flexibility for hybrid work.




Compensation

Salary range: $70,000–$90,000, depending on experience.

Includes a performance-based bonus program.




Make an Impact

If you’re energized by data, passionate about real estate, and eager to play a meaningful role in the growth of a modern brokerage, we’d love to hear from you.




Floorspace values diversity and is committed to Employment Equity. Direct applicants only-no agencies. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 

Learn more about us at www.floorspace.ca

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary

The Department of Psychiatry at the University of British Columbia invites applications for a full-time Research Computing Analyst with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning and scientific computing. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sophia Frangou, President’s Chair in Brain Health, and will receive detailed instructions on assignments. The successful candidate will carry out programming and technical tasks, troubleshoot computational problems, and contribute to the development and implementation of solutions under the guidance of senior members of the research team. Work will be reviewed for accuracy, completeness and timeliness.

The successful applicant will primarily contribute to the CentileBrain Project. This is a computational neuroimaging initiative focused on individual-level brain characterization. It combines large-scale imaging data, normative modelling, harmonization and machine learning. The platform generates individualized centile and deviation scores across the lifespan. The goal is to support precision neuroscience and clinically meaningful individual inference.

Organizational Status

The Department of Psychiatry at the University of British Columbia invites applications for a full-time Research Computing Analyst with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning and scientific computing. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sophia Frangou, President’s Chair in Brain Health, and will receive detailed instructions on assignments. The successful candidate will carry out programming and technical tasks, troubleshoot computational problems, and contribute to the development and implementation of solutions under the guidance of senior members of the research team. Work will be reviewed for accuracy, completeness and timeliness

Work Performed


Oversees the implementation of established machine-learning, artificial-intelligence and statistical methods in research datasets, modifies existing scripts as required using detailed specifications, and recommends computational workflow modifications to the PI.
Performs data preparation, quality control, feature extraction and other defined computational tasks for large-scale research studies.
Integrates multimodal datasets using established analytical procedures and modifies existing code as required to support data compatibility and processing.
Runs and maintains computational workflows on local and high-performance computing systems, including monitoring processing and addressing routine execution issues.
Resolve routine technical problems in code, data processing and computational workflows and escalate new issues for consultation with senior team members.
Provides first-level technical support to research team members using established computational workflows and systems.
Maintains clear documentation of code and script modifications, analytical procedures, software versions, testing results and computational outputs.


Consequence of Error/Judgement

The Principal Investigator will provide oversight for this position. Given the importance of the work to the research program, errors or poor judgment could substantially compromise research quality, delay project completion, and adversely affect future funding opportunities. Inaccurate or ineffective representation of the team’s work could also damage relationships with funding agencies and collaborators. The position therefore requires consistently high standards of accuracy, judgment, efficiency, and communication.

Supervision Received

The successful candidate will work within the broad direction established by the Principal Investigator and research team, with a high degree of independence and minimal supervision. The successful candidate will be expected to exercise sound judgment in carrying out defined responsibilities, collaborate effectively with team members, and proactively identify and bring emerging issues, risks, or unusual circumstances to the attention of the Principal Investigator.

Supervision Given

The successful candidate may assign tasks to students and provide oversight and review of their work.

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of one year of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.


Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications


An undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, statistics or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience with analyses of human neuroimaging MRI data
Strong programming skills
Demonstrated experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence or advanced statistical modelling.
Experience working with high-dimensional or complex biomedical, biological or scientific datasets.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Note: Candidates are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas. We are particularly interested in applicants who combine strong computational skills with the ability and interest to apply them to human neuroscience and biomedical research

Title: Category Analyst Manager - 18 Month Contract
Description:
Help Shape the Future of Food Categories


Freybe Gourmet Foods is looking for a data-driven, commercially minded Category Manager to join our team on an 18-month contract.




In this role, you'll turn market trends, consumer insights, retailer data, and sales analytics into strategies that drive growth. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and key retail customers to identify opportunities, strengthen category performance, and influence business decisions across our portfolio.




If you enjoy uncovering insights, spotting trends before others do, and turning data into action, we'd love to hear from you.


What You'll Be DoingDrive Category Growth



Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive activity.


Identify opportunities for growth, innovation, pricing, and assortment improvements.


Develop category strategies that support business objectives.



Support Retail Partners



Deliver category reviews, insights, and recommendations to retail customers.


Support sales presentations with data-driven storytelling.


Recommend assortment, promotion, and merchandising opportunities.



Turn Data Into Action



Manage and analyze syndicated, retailer, and internal sales data.


Create dashboards, reports, and performance reviews.


Translate complex information into clear recommendations for leadership and cross-functional teams.



Lead Competitive & Market Analysis



Monitor competitor activity, innovation, pricing, promotions, and market trends.


Deliver quarterly category reviews highlighting what is changing in the market and what actions Freybe should consider.



Partner Across the Business



Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Innovation teams.


Support new product launches and business planning with data-backed insights and forecasts.



What We're Looking ForExperience



5+ years of experience in Category Management, Retail Analytics, or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG).


Experience working with retailers and category review processes.


Food industry experience is an asset.



Skills



Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Excellent presentation and communication skills.


Ability to transform data into actionable business insights.


Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.



Technical Skills



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.


Experience with Nielsen, Circana (IRI), or similar syndicated data platforms.


Power BI or Tableau experience is an asset.



Education



Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.


MBA or advanced analytics training is considered an asset.



Additional Requirements



Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle.


Ability to travel as required.


Eligible to work full-time in Canada.


Minimum of 4 days per week in office.



Why Join Freybe?


At Freybe, you'll have the opportunity to influence key business decisions, work directly with leading retailers, and help shape category strategies for some of Canada's most recognized premium food products.




This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytics, strategy, and customer collaboration to make a measurable impact.




Ready to turn insights into growth? Apply today.

As an experienced Data Analytics Consultant this individual will work as part of our data analytics team, supporting clients with requirements gathering, prototyping, development, and support. Client scenarios range in complexity. This individual must have a good blend of people, functional, and technical skills for cross-team collaboration and support. Working with business/project team members to understand the requirements 


Defining BI framework model, semantic layers and Metadata repositories to support reporting and administration 


Developing and managing BI end user presentation layer training and documentation. 


Technical documentation 


Supporting business development efforts (proposals and client presentations) 


Estimating effort for development and support engagements in Data Engineering and related technologies 


Status reporting 


Interacting with various client and management stake holders to get the work completed 


You would represent the company in the market and must reflect the core values of the company which include: 


Continuous improvement as a way of life 


Fair and generous relationships with our people and customers

Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate 


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate 


Azure Databricks Data Engineer Associate - Certifications





Microsoft Certified: SQL AI Developer Associate
















What We Are Looking For  





5+ years hands-on experience in Microsoft Data Stack incl. SQL Server, data warehousing, MS Fabric/Data Bricks


3+ years hands-on experience in Microsoft BI Stack incl. Power BI, SSAS, SSRS, SSIS 


Proficiency in the development and administration of at least one of the following areas: 


Back end data integration and architecture including dimensional data modeling, database design, data warehousing, ETL development (e.g. ADF), and performance tuning, front-end reporting and analytics platforms including OLAP cube design, tabular data modeling.


Strong Data Modeling skills for Star-Schema 


Strong Programming skills in T-SQL, Spark (PySpark, SQL, Scala, etc), DAX, Power Query 


Strong analytical thinking for translating data into informative visuals and reports 


Experience developing visual reports including custom visuals, dashboards and KPI scorecards using Power BI 


The ability to implement row level security on data and have an understanding of application security layer models in the data platforms of SQL Server, Azure, MS Fabric and Power BI 


Foundational knowledge of the following areas: Metadata Management; Master Data Management; Data Governance; Data Analytics 


Good understanding of AI fundamentals.


Certifications required: 


-Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate


-Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate


Strong written and verbal communications skills 













Why Work at MSP Corp  





Benefits package. 


Dynamic work environment. 


Corporate gym discounts. 


Wellness day. 


Opportunities for growth and training.

Title: Senior Specialist, Product Management – Attributes & Insights
Description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Specialist, Product Management – Attributes & Insights

Our Purpose

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion (https://www.mastercard.us/en-us/vision/who-we-are/diversity-inclusion.html) for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

About The Team

Mastercard Identity, within the Security Solutions organization, leads the development of products and services that enable global commerce, powers financial inclusion, prevents crime and makes some of the most seamless experiences possible.

As part of Mastercard Identity, the Attributes & Insights team drives the development and management of products, programs, and services focused on deterministic attribute verification. The team delivers significant value across the ecosystem, helping to combat new fraud and address regulatory requirements. Our vision is to deliver a single, rail-agnostic platform and a real-time suite of solutions.

Job Description

Role Overview

The Senior Specialist will support Account Status Inquiry (ASI) as a data-driven product manager focused on understanding customer usage, evaluating product performance, and translating insights into product actions. This role will analyze ASI adoption across regions, customers, segments, and use cases to identify growth opportunities, product improvements, and customer value drivers. The specialist will partner with regional, sales, engineering, and customer success teams to strengthen ASI reporting, support adoption, develop product documentation, and contribute to data-backed business cases for future enhancements. This role will help improve visibility into ASI utilization, identify underpenetrated customer and regional opportunities, and support roadmap decisions that drive adoption, customer value, and product growth.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong product knowledge of Account Status Inquiry and the broader Attribute & Insights suite of products, including customer use cases, product rules, transaction flows, and value drivers

Analyze ASI usage, transaction trends, customer behavior, regional performance, and segment-level adoption to identify growth opportunities, product improvement areas, and customer value drivers

Build and maintain KPI reporting and performance summaries that clearly communicate ASI usage, adoption, revenue opportunities, customer impact, and product performance trends

Translate data insights into product requirements, enhancement recommendations, business cases, best-practice use cases, and customer-facing value narratives

Support customer, regional, partner, and internal product/sales inquiries by using product knowledge and data analysis to diagnose trends, answer questions, and recommend next steps

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support successful product launches, enhancement delivery, reporting improvements, and operational readiness

Create and maintain product documentation, best practices, sales materials, operational processes, and customer enablement content

Required Skills And Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have experience in product management, payments, financial services, analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience analyzing transaction-level, customer, and usage data to inform product strategy. The candidate should possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable product insights.

Experience analyzing transaction-level, customer, or usage data to identify trends, anomalies, growth opportunities, and product improvement areas

Proficiency with SQL, advanced Excel, and dashboarding or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms

Ability to define product KPIs, build performance reporting, and communicate insights that inform product decisions and stakeholder discussions

Familiarity with statistical analysis or data science techniques, including trend analysis, segmentation, hypothesis testing, and data-driven decision making

Product management mindset with the ability to connect customer needs, product capabilities, usage trends, and business outcomes

Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data and product topics for business and technical audiences

Knowledge of transaction processing, card-not-present payments, authorization flows, or network products is a plus

Work Conditions: Some travel required

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.



In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Pay Ranges

Toronto, Canada: $94,000 - $138,000 CAD

Vancouver, Canada: $94,000 - $138,000 CAD
